text: There was a little girl called Ann who wanted to buy a new toy.
Ann went to the store and saw a bright yellow yacht.
She wanted it straight away and asked her mum.
"Can I buy the yacht?" Ann asked.
"Yes, if you save your money," her mum replied.
So Ann saved up all her money and on Saturday morning, she went back to the store.
She had just enough money to buy the bright yellow yacht.
When Ann got home, she was so happy.
She showed her mum the new yacht and everyone was so proud of her for saving her money.
Ann was so excited about her new toy and she couldn't wait to play with it in the bath.
Ann was so happy with her purchase and she couldn't stop smiling.
She was so proud of her bright yellow yacht!
Once upon a time, a unique dinosaur lived in a wide open field.
He was very friendly and loved to nod hello to all of the animals who lived in the field with him.
Every day, he waved his head at the sunshine and said hello to the trees and birds.
One day, the dinosaur spotted a tiny pink rabbit hopping towards him.
He smiled and nodded at the rabbit.
The rabbit nodded back and smiled too.
Then suddenly, the rabbit jumped up onto the dinosaur's back and started riding him around the field.
The dinosaur laughed and nodded as he raced around.
When the little rabbit hopped off the dinosaur's back, she waved goodbye as she skipped away.
The little dinosaur sat in the field and nodded as if he was saying goodbye too.
The little dinosaur was very happy and he would never forget the unique adventure he shared with the special pink rabbit.
Mabel was so excited.
She had been looking for her lost heel for such a long time.
The bitter cold had made it even harder to find.
She searched around the garden, peering between the bushes and digging in the mud.
Everywhere she looked, there was no sign of her precious lost heel.
That's when she heard a voice calling out.
"Hey you!
I have your lost heel!" Mabel was very happy and ran over to see a little funny shaped creature holding up her heel in its hand.
"This is my heel!
Please give it back," she said.
The creature shook its head and smiled.
"Not until you solve my riddle.
If you do, you can have it back," it said.
Mabel thought hard and eventually came up with an answer.
"The answer is a book!" The creature smiled and handed her the heel.
Mabel was so relieved and thanked the creature for helping her find her heel.
She hugged it before running off happily with her heel.
One day, a little boy named Tim and his dog, Spot, went to the park.
They played catch with a ball.
Spot loved to run and catch the ball in his mouth.
While they were playing, a big boy came over.
He had a fake smile on his face.
The big boy said, "Give me your ball or I will take it." Tim felt scared.
This was a threat!
He didn't want to give his ball away, but he also didn't want the big boy to take it.
So, Tim and Spot paused their game to think.
Tim got an idea.
He said, "Why don't we all play together?" The big boy thought for a moment and then agreed.
They all played catch and had a great time.
In the end, the big boy wasn't mean anymore, and they all became friends.
The moral of the story is that sometimes it's better to share and make friends, rather than fight and be scared.
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named May.
She was three years old and she loved playing in the park with all her friends.
One day, her mommy said to her: "May, it's time for your bath!" May wanted to get in the bath but she was a bit scared.
May's friend Robert had a bathtub, and May wanted one too.
She was so envious of Robert that she asked her mommy if they could get a bathtub.
So the next day, May's mommy took her to the store to pick out a bathtub.
She asked May: "Which bathtub do you want, May?" May picked out a bathtub that was pink with lots of bubbles on it.
She was so excited and couldn't wait to take a bath.
May and her mommy brought the bathtub home and put it in the bathroom.
May said: "I love my new bathtub!" and she jumped in to take a bubble bath.
The end.
Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Jake.
He loved to ride his toy tricycle around the house.
He would make sure to wear his helmet and would pedal as fast as he could.
One day, Jake was outside pushing his tricycle too hard and his foot slipped off the pedal.
He fell off the tricycle and hurt his knee.
He started to cry because it hurt so much.
Mommy heard Jake's cries and came running outside.
She picked him up and saw that his knee was bleeding.
She gave him a big hug and said, "It's ok, Jake.
I'll put a bandage on it so it won't hurt anymore." She kissed his forehead and put a wet bandage on his knee.
After a few minutes, it felt better and he was ready to go again.
Jake gave his mom a big hug and said, "Thank you, Mommy.
I'm ready to ride now!"  His mom smiled and said, "Ok, let's go.
But we have to be careful this time.
No more riding too fast!" Jake nodded and went on his merry way, feeling hopeful and brave.
He pedaled faster and faster, careful not to fall off his tricycle again.
The Little Prince lived in a kingdom far away.
He had a purple cape that was very attractive.
One day, he was feeling quite bold and decided he was going to make a demand of the King.
He gathered his courage and marched right up to the throne.
The King was very surprised to see a small boy in the palace, but he welcomed him in.
The Little Prince said, "I want a purple pony!" The King said he had never heard such an outrageous demand before and he couldn't believe such a little prince could be so daring.
But the Prince stood his ground and would not back down.
So, the King gave in and granted him his wish.
The Little Prince was overjoyed and thanked the King for his kindness.
He ran out of the palace with a smile on his face, eager to jump on the back of his new purple pony!
Once upon a time, there was a hairy monkey who lived in the jungle.
Everyday, he would swing from the trees and play with his animal friends.
But one day, the monkey wanted to go explore something new.
So, he decided to leave the jungle and go on an adventure.
The monkey traveled far and wide, visiting many different places in his travels.
He saw lots of exciting things, but he was happy to come back to the jungle.
So, after a few days, the monkey returned back to his home.
When the monkey got back, all his animal friends were very happy.
They had missed their hairy friend and were glad he had come back safe and sound.
The monkey was also very happy to be back home.
He realized there was no place quite like the jungle.
So, the hairy monkey never left again and enjoyed playing with his friends every day.
Once upon a time, there was a silly cat named Mittens.
Mittens liked to play with a teaspoon.
One day, Mittens was playing with the teaspoon when it fell on the ground and made a loud noise.
Mittens got scared and ran away.
Mittens ran all around the house until he found a cozy spot to settle down.
He found a soft blanket and made himself comfortable.
Mittens felt happy and safe in his new spot.
From that day on, Mittens played with his teaspoon in his cozy spot.
He never let it fall again.
And whenever he felt scared, he knew just where to go to settle down and feel better.
John and his mom were at the grocery store.
John was very excited because it was his first time.
His mom told him to stay close to her.
But as soon as they entered the store, John started to wander around.
John saw lots of interesting things he wanted to check out.
He spotted a big lollipop and pointed at it.
His mom said, ''No John.
We're only here for groceries.'' John nodded, but then he saw some candy and pointed at it again.
His mom shook her head.
She said he had to be fair and buy the groceries first before he got the candy.
John was disappointed, but he understood.
He followed his mom around the store and watched her carefully as she went from aisle to aisle picking out things.
John was very happy when they were done and he got to pick one piece of candy.
His mom smiled and said, ''That's fair, John.''  John smiled back and thanked his mom for the candy.
It was a fun trip to the grocery store!
Once upon a time, there was a powerful frog who lived in a small pond.
The frog had a very sharp rock that he liked to sit on.
One day, a little bird told the frog about a big pond far away.
The frog wanted to go see the big pond, but he was scared to leave his small pond and sharp rock.
The frog thought and thought about the big pond.
He knew that if he could find a way to take his sharp rock with him, he would feel safe.
So, the powerful frog used his strong legs to push the sharp rock all the way to the big pond.
It was hard work, but he did not give up.
When the powerful frog and his sharp rock finally made it to the big pond, he was so happy.
He could swim and play in the big pond and still have his sharp rock to sit on.
The frog learned that even though he was scared, he could do big things with his powerful legs and his sharp rock by his side.
Once upon a time there was a healthy bee.
She flew over to a park to explore.
When she arrived, she was so excited!
She saw people running and playing and having fun.
She flew across the park to see what she could find.
She flew past the swings and the slides, the trees and the flowers.
Eventually, she found a big pond filled with ducks and fish.
She loved it!
She decided to stay and enjoy the peaceful atmosphere of the park for the rest of the day.
When it was time to go home, she happily flew away.
Jill and her mommy found a big, fun park to play in.
Jill was so excited to play on the swings and slides.
She could see a big, green hill too.
Everything looked fit for playing!
When they got to the park, Jill spotted a zebra!
It was the most beautiful zebra she had ever seen.
Mommy said they could go up closer to look at it.
Jill ran up to the fence and stopped, because she wasn't allowed to go too close.
The zebra started running and jumping around!
It was so fun to watch!
Jill and her mommy laughed and pointed and clapped as the zebra played in the grass.
Jill was so happy she had found the zebra to play with.
When it was time to go, Jill hugged her mommy and said goodbye to the zebra.
She couldn't wait to come back to the park and play again.
One day, a little girl named Sue went to the park.
She saw a new slide that was big and shiny.
Sue was excited to play on the slide.
She ran to the slide and climbed up the steps.
Sue saw a little boy named Tim sitting at the top of the slide.
Tim looked scared.
He said, "I need help to go down the slide." Sue smiled and said, "I will help you.
Hold my hand and we will slide down together." Tim held Sue's hand and they went down the slide.
They laughed and had fun.
They went on the slide again and again.
Sue and Tim became good friends and played on the new slide all day.
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily.
She loved to play outside in the sunshine.
One day, Lily was playing with her ball when she accidentally dropped it.
The ball rolled away and Lily couldn't find it.
She felt sad.
But then, the sky turned dark and a big storm came.
Thunder boomed and lightning flashed.
Lily was scared, but then she saw a rainbow in the sky.
It made her happy and she forgot about her lost ball.
After the storm passed, Lily went outside again and found her ball in a puddle.
She was so happy to have it back!
Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy.
Timmy loved to walk around his town and explore new things.
One day, he saw a big factory that he had never seen before.
He was so curious that he decided to walk inside.
Timmy walked and walked through the factory, but he got very tired.
He wanted to rest, but he couldn't find a place to sit.
Suddenly, he heard a loud noise and the factory started to shake.
Timmy was scared and he tried to run out, but it was too late.
The factory exploded and Timmy was hurt.
Timmy's parents were very sad when they heard the news.
They wished that Timmy had never walked into the factory.
From that day on, they made sure to always keep an eye on their little boy.
One day, a little girl named Daisy went to the park with her mom.
The sun was shining, and the sky was blue.
Daisy liked to run and play in the park.
She saw a lot of pretty flowers and wanted to pick them.
Daisy saw a dull flower next to a bright flower.
She asked her mom, "Mom, why is this flower dull and not pretty like the others?" Her mom said, "Some flowers just need more love and care to be pretty.
Why don't you pick it and give it some love?" Daisy picked the dull flower and held it in her hand.
She gave it a little hug and said, "I love you, flower." The dull flower started to become bright and pretty, just like the other flowers.
Daisy was happy, and she learned that love can make things beautiful.
Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Rosy who was very friendly.
One day, Rosy was playing outside when she saw something shining in the grass.
When she took a closer look, she realised that it was a shiny silver coin.
Rosy was delighted and ran towards her house to show her mum.
When Rosy showed her mother the shiny silver coin, they both started to laugh.
Rosy's mum said, "Rosy, it looks like you have found a silver coin.
You must have been very lucky!" Rosy was so happy to have found the silver coin and said, "Maybe I can buy something nice with it!".
Suddenly, Rosy's best friend James came to the door.
He had heard that Rosy had found a silver coin and said, "What are you going to do with it?".
Rosy replied, "I want to buy something nice with it!".
James started to tease her and said, "You won't be able to buy anything.
It's too small!"  Rosy's mum gave a stern look to James and said, "Why are you teasing her like that?
Remember, being friendly is always better than teasing someone." The moral of the story is that being friendly is always better than teasing somebody.
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily.
She loved to play with her toys, especially her teddy bear.
One day, Lily's mommy told her that they were going to visit her grandma.
Lily was excited because she loved her grandma very much.
When they arrived at grandma's house, Lily noticed a big present on the table.
Her mommy told her that it was a gift for grandma's birthday.
Lily wanted to help, so she asked if she could wrap the present.
Her mommy agreed and gave her some paper and tape.
Lily worked very hard to wrap the present.
She made sure it was smooth and pretty.
When she was finished, she was very proud of herself.
Later that day, when it was time to go home, Lily realized that she forgot her teddy bear at grandma's house.
She was very sad because she loved her teddy bear very much.
But her mommy told her not to worry because they would return to grandma's house soon and get her teddy bear back.
And they did!
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily.
She loved to play with her toys and cuddle with her cushion.
One day, Lily's mom brought her a new cushion that she had designed herself.
Lily was so happy and she hugged her new cushion tightly.
"Mommy, this cushion is so pretty!
Did you design it?" she asked.
"Yes, I did!
I'm glad you like it," her mom replied with a smile.
Later that day, Lily and her mom went outside to play in the snow.
The ground was icy and slippery, but they had fun making snowmen and having snowball fights.
And I'm glad you love your new cushion."
It was a sunny day and two teddy bears, named Kelly and Jim, had just come home from the park.
Kelly wanted to play with her toy cars, but Jim was interested in the bookshelf on the other side of the room.
Kelly followed him to the empty bookshelf and tried to take it away from him.
As soon as Jim saw this, he got angry and the two teddy bears started to fight.
They scratched each other with their claws and knocked over books and other toys.
In the end, Jim won the fight and took back the bookshelf.
Kelly was sad but decided to make the best of the situation and helped Jim put the books back in the shelves.
In the end they both hugged and made up with each other.
Once there was a family that didn't always get along.
The brother and sister, Bob and Jane, wouldn't share.
They always wanted to do their own thing.
One day, the family went to a park and saw some people playing football.
The brother and sister felt that they wanted to join in too.
But they were worried they wouldn't be able to work together.
However, the hairy football inspired Bob and Jane to team up and try.
The ball being so hairy made them work together without even thinking about it.
They had a lot of fun and soon became very good at working as a team.
The brother and sister soon found that football was a great way to unite the family and make it stronger.
They all enjoyed spending time together, and soccer was the glue that held them all together.
Once there was a girl who was walking in the park.
She noticed a helpless pigeon on the ground.
She tried to help it but the pigeon was scared and wouldn't move.
So the girl decided to push it gently with her foot.
It worked.
The pigeon flew away.
She felt happy and relieved that she helped the helpless pigeon.
The girl smiled and waved goodbye as the pigeon flew away.
Lily and her mommy were playing outside.
"I'm so excited to play sport," Lily said with a big smile.
Lily's mommy smiled back at her, "I'm excited too!
Let's shake it up!" Lily and her mommy jumped around and shook their arms and legs all around.
Suddenly, Lily saw a person standing nearby.
She asked curiously, "Who is that?" "Oh, that's just Bob," her Mommy said.
"He's being very ignorant and won't join us in our sport." Lily was confused.
"What's 'ignorant' mean?" "It means he doesn't want to play," her Mommy said.
Lily shook her head.
"That's silly!" she said.
"Everyone loves to play!" So, Lily and her mommy kept playing and shaking until Bob finally joined in.
Soon they were all happily jumping around and having fun!
Mia and Leo were twins who liked to play in their room.
They had many toys and books and puzzles, but their favorite thing was the lamp.
The lamp had a bulb that changed colors when they touched it.
Sometimes it was red, sometimes blue, sometimes green, sometimes yellow.
They liked to make up stories about the colors and what they meant.
One day, they were playing with the lamp and the bulb turned purple.
They had never seen purple before and they wondered what it meant.
"Maybe it means magic," Mia said.
"Maybe we can do magic with the lamp." "Maybe it means trouble," Leo said.
"Maybe the lamp is broken and we have to fix it." They argued for a while, each wanting to try their idea.
They pulled and pushed the lamp, but the bulb stayed purple.
"Stop it!" Mia shouted.
"You are hurting the lamp!" "No, you stop it!" Leo shouted back.
"You are making it worse!" They were so loud that their mom heard them from downstairs.
She came up to their room and saw them fighting over the lamp.
"What is going on here?" she asked.
"Why are you yelling at each other?" They both stopped and looked at their mom.
They pointed at the lamp and the purple bulb.
"It's purple!" Mia said.
"It's purple!" Leo said.
Their mom smiled and hugged them.
She explained that the bulb was not ordinary, but special.
It had a sensor that detected their mood and changed colors accordingly.
Purple meant that they were both curious and excited, but also frustrated and angry.
"It's okay to have different feelings," she said.
"But you have to learn to share and listen to each other.
The lamp is not a toy, but a tool.
It can help you understand your emotions and communicate better." She showed them how to touch the lamp gently and watch the colors change.
She asked them to tell her how they felt and why.
They took turns talking and listening, and the bulb changed to different colors.
They saw pink, orange, green, and blue.
They felt happy, calm, and loved.
They thanked their mom and hugged her.
They decided to play with the lamp together, and make up stories that matched the colors.
They settled on the floor, holding hands, and watched the bulb glow.
They felt like they had a magic lamp, but also a friend.
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily.
She loved to eat yogurt with a teaspoon.
One day, she went to the kitchen to get a spoon, but she couldn't find one.
Her mom was washing dishes and saw her looking.
She asked, "Do you need a spoon, Lily?" Lily nodded her head and her mom gave her a teaspoon.
Lily was very happy and said, "Thank you, Mommy!" Her mom smiled and said, "You're welcome, Lily.
You are always so polite." Lily ate her yogurt with the teaspoon and it tasted so good.
She finished it all up and went to play with her toys.
The end.
Once upon a time, there was a lazy cat named Mittens.
Mittens liked to sleep all day and didn't like to play.
One day, Mittens went to the store to buy some milk.
But when Mittens got to the store, he got a shock!
The store was all out of milk!
Mittens was sad and didn't know what to do.
Then, Mittens saw a friendly dog named Spot.
Spot asked Mittens what was wrong and Mittens told him about the milk.
Spot said, "Don't worry, Mittens!
I have some milk at my house.
You can come over and have some." Mittens was happy and went to Spot's house.
At Spot's house, Mittens had some milk and they played together.
Mittens realized that it was fun to play and not be lazy all the time.
Mittens and Spot became good friends and would always help each other out.
The end.
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily.
She loved to play in the forest near her house.
One day, she found a big log on the ground.
It was very heavy, but she wanted to move it.
She pushed and pulled until she finally moved the log to a new spot.
Lily was very happy because she completed a big task all by herself.
She sat down on the log to rest, but then she noticed something.
The log was spoiled!
It had bugs crawling all over it.
Lily didn't want to sit on a spoiled log, so she decided to find a new place to rest.
She looked around and saw a beautiful flower field.
She ran over to it and sat down in the soft grass.
The sun was shining and the flowers smelled so sweet.
Lily was happy she completed her task and found a new place to rest.
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily.
She loved to play in the park with her friends.
One day, while they were playing, Lily saw an unusual animal in the pond.
It was a crocodile!
Lily ran to her friends and said, "Look!
Look!
There's a crocodile in the pond!" Her friends didn't believe her and said, "No way!
There's no crocodile in the pond!" But Lily was sure she had seen a crocodile.
She went to the pond to take a closer look.
When she got there, she saw that it wasn't a crocodile at all.
It was just a big log!
Lily felt embarrassed for making her friends worried over nothing.
From then on, Lily made sure to double-check before telling her friends about any unusual animals in the park.
Once upon a time, there was a mommy, a daddy, and a little girl named Daisy.
Daisy was only three years old, but she was always ready to play!
One of her favorite things to do was sports.
One day, Daisy's dad said that he had a surprise for her.
He took her outside and showed her a new organized sports game.
Daisy was so happy!
She squeezed her dad's hand and said, "Let's play!" So, the two of them ran around, playing the game and having lots of fun.
Daisy loved squeezing the ball, running around and playing.
She was so organized and kept track of it all.
It was her favorite new game.
At the end of the day, Daisy hugged her dad and said, "Thank you for the game.
Let's play it again soon!" Daisy's dad smiled and said, "Of course!
It was so much fun."  And so, Daisy and her dad kept playing sports every day.
They were so happy together.
They were the perfect team!
Once there was a poor family who lived in a small house.
One day they decided to go to the shop to buy some food.
When they got there, they saw that the shop had split into two.
The shop keeper was very sad, because the poor family had no money to help him fix it.
So mum, dad and the children worked together and used their hands to rebuild the shop.
The shop keeper was very thankful for their help!
After a few hours, the shop was fixed and the happy family could buy their food.
It was a good day!
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily.
She loved to play outside in the park, and she especially loved to watch the squirrels.
One day, as she was playing, she spotted a squirrel gathering nuts.
She thought it was so cute!
The next day, Lily brought some nuts with her to the park.
She wanted to give them to the squirrel she had seen the day before.
She waited and waited, but the squirrel didn't come.
But then, as she was about to leave, she heard a rustling in the bushes.
She recognized the sound right away - it was the squirrel!
Lily was so happy to see him.
She gave him the nuts and he ate them right up.
From then on, Lily always brought nuts with her to the park.
She knew they were useful for the squirrels and she loved to watch them eat.
And every time she heard a rustling in the bushes, she recognized it as her little squirrel friend.
Once, there was a strong man who lived in the city.
Everyday, the man went for a walk with his wallet.
One day, the man passed an old man and the old man made a joke.
The man laughed and said, "That was a very funny joke".
The old man replied, "Thank you, I can always make people laugh.
I have many jokes".
Then, he looked at the strong man's wallet and said, "You have a nice wallet, can I see it?"  The man opened his wallet and the old man said, "Ah, now this is a nice wallet".
Then, the old man put a tiny imaginary bug inside the man's wallet and said, "This little bug will bring you lots of luck".
The man was very thankful and thanked the old man.
He kept the wallet with the little bug inside with him and he said goodbye to the old man.
From that day onward, the man always felt strong and lucky.
Once upon a time, there was an ancient man.
He had a big exam to take but he was very scared.
He was very worried he would not pass.
So the ancient man went to his friend.
He asked if his friend could help him.
The friend said yes, and he showed the ancient man a special way to pass his exam.
All the man had to do was to forgive himself.
The ancient man was very happy.
He thanked his friend and he tried the special way.
He felt brave and he was ready for the exam.
On the day of the exam, the ancient man did very well.
He passed the exam and everyone was very happy.
The ancient man was glad he chose the special way and he thanked his friend again.
From that day onwards, the ancient man was happy.
He had learned a very important lesson - to forgive himself.
Davey was creative and loved to explore.
One day he asked his mom if he could go outside to play.
She said yes and wished him luck.
Davey ran outside and soon found a giant cauliflower in the garden.
He was very excited.
He asked his mom if he could have the cauliflower so he could eat it.
She said no because it was too big.
Davey, who was very determined, decided to find a way to cut it.
He asked his mom if he could borrow her scissors.
She reluctantly agreed and he started cutting the cauliflower.
But as he tried to cut, the scissors slipped and Davey accidentally cut his finger.
He started to cry and had to go inside to get a bandage.
His mom was extremely angry and told him never to do anything so risky and dangerous again.
Davey nodded and promised to not be so creative next time.
Lily and Tom were playing hide and seek in the garden.
Lily was the seeker and Tom was the hider.
Lily counted to ten and then looked for Tom.
She saw a big bush with green leaves and smelled something nice.
She thought Tom might be hiding behind the bush.
She walked to the bush and peeked behind it.
She saw Tom sitting on the ground with a bunch of herbs in his hands.
He was chewing on some of them and making funny faces.
"Tom, I found you!" Lily said.
"What are you doing with those herbs?" Tom looked at Lily and smiled.
"I'm eating them.
They taste good and make me feel funny.
Do you want some?" He offered Lily some herbs.
Lily was curious and took a bite.
The herbs were bitter and spicy.
She did not like them at all.
She spit them out and made a yucky sound.
"Tom, these herbs are gross!
Why do you eat them?" Lily asked.
Tom shrugged.
"I don't know.
I just like them.
They make me dizzy and happy.
Come on, let's eat more and play some more." Lily shook her head.
"No, thank you.
I don't want to eat more.
I don't want to be dizzy and happy.
I want to be normal and safe.
These herbs are not good for you, Tom.
They might make you sick or hurt you.
We should stop eating them and tell Mommy." Tom frowned.
"No, I don't want to stop.
I don't want to tell Mommy.
I want to eat more and more.
You are no fun, Lily.
Go away and leave me alone." Lily felt sad and scared.
She did not like how Tom was acting.
She did not want to leave him alone, but he did not listen to her.
She ran away from the bush and looked for Mommy.
She wanted to tell her what Tom was doing and ask for help.
But it was too late.
Tom ate too many herbs and got very sick.
He fell asleep and did not wake up.
Mommy found him and cried.
She called the doctor, but he could not help.
Tom was gone.
Lily lost her brother and her friend.
She wished she had never peeked behind the bush.
She wished Tom had never eaten the herbs.
She wished they had played a different game.
She wished they had a happy ending.
Once upon a time, there was a sad little girl whose heart was full of pain.
She wanted to tell her story, but she felt like no one was listening.
One day, she went out for a walk and stopped at a pond.
The pond was filled with calm, still waters and she felt safe there.
She shared her story with the pond, and it seemed to understand.
"Please help me," she said.
"My heart is full of sadness, and I don't know what to do!" Just then, a soft voice behind her said, "I know how to help you, if you let me".
She spun around, and saw an old woman with kind eyes.
The old woman said, "My shoulder always carries a hidden sadness.
I feel it every day, and it's too heavy to bear.
But I have found a way to suffer less.
Let me help you, too." The little girl was hesitant, but something in the old woman's eyes filled her with courage.
She nodded, and the old woman put her arm around the girl's shoulder.
The girl felt a warmth pass through her body, and suddenly, something inside her heart shifted.
The unfamiliar feeling of lightness filled her.
The old woman winked, and said, "It's easier when you don't carry it alone".
Once upon a time, there was a jolly rabbit named Benny.
Benny loved to hop and play in the forest all day long.
One day, Benny met a little girl named Lily.
Lily was lost and scared in the forest.
Benny asked, "Are you lost, little girl?"  Lily replied, "Yes, I am.
I can't find my way home."  Benny said, "Don't worry, I will protect you and help you find your way home.
But first, let's have a meal together."  Benny and Lily sat down and had a yummy meal of carrots and lettuce.
After their meal, Benny hopped along with Lily and led her safely back to her home.
Lily was so happy to have met Benny and thanked him for protecting her.
From that day on, Benny and Lily became the best of friends and played together in the forest every day.
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily.
She loved flowers and would often pick them from her garden.
One day, she saw a bug eating her favorite flower.
She didn't want that to happen again, so she decided to prevent it.
Lily was very enthusiastic about finding a solution.
She asked her mom for help and they came up with an idea.
They put a net over the flowers to keep the bugs away.
It worked!
The flowers were safe and Lily was happy.
From that day on, Lily made sure to take care of her flowers so they wouldn't get eaten.
She was very proud of herself for preventing the bugs from ruining her garden.
Once upon a time, there was a knight named Jack.
Jack had a sword that he loved very much.
One day, a dragon came and took Jack's sword away.
Jack was very sad and didn't understand why the dragon took his sword.
Jack decided to go find the dragon and get his sword back.
He walked for a long time until he found the dragon's lair.
The dragon was sleeping and snoring very loud.
Jack was scared, but he knew he had to be brave to get his sword back.
Jack crept up to the dragon and took his sword back.
The dragon woke up and started to breathe fire at Jack, but Jack was quick and ran away.
Jack was happy to have his sword back and he understood that sometimes you have to be brave to solve a problem.
Once upon a time there was a little girl named Sarah.
One day, Sarah went to the store with her Mommy.
There were lots of interesting things in the store.
In the fruit section, Sarah saw something very unusual.
It was a big, green fruit with funny stripes.
It was very exciting!
Mommy asked if Sarah wanted to try the unusual fruit.
Sarah said yes and Mommy bought it.
When they came home with the fruit, Mommy helped Sarah cut it open.
There was a special surprise inside.
It was a bright yellow fruit with lots of sweet juice!
Sarah couldn't wait to try the unusual fruit.
She liked it very much.
Next time they go to the store, Sarah will see if there are any other unusual fruits!
Once upon a time, there was a nation with many people.
In this nation, everyone was slow.
They did not like to move fast.
One day, a little boy named Tom wanted to change this.
He thought, "I will make my nation rise and be fast!" Tom went to his friend, Sue.
He said, "I want to make our nation rise and be fast!
Will you help me?" Sue said, "Yes, I will help you, Tom!" They went to the park to practice running.
They ran and ran, and soon, they became faster.
More and more people saw Tom and Sue running in the park.
They wanted to be fast too.
So, they joined Tom and Sue.
The nation started to rise and be fast.
Everyone was happy because they were no longer slow.
Tom and Sue had made their nation rise, and they all lived happily ever after.
Lily and Ben are playing with their toys in the living room.
Lily has a shiny red car and Ben has a big yellow truck.
They like to make noises and pretend they are driving.
"Look at my car, Ben!" Lily says.
"It is so shiny and fast!" "My truck is better, Lily!" Ben says.
"It is so big and strong!" They start to argue about whose toy is better.
They do not want to share or play together.
Lily has an idea.
She sees a bottle of polish on the table.
She thinks it will make her car even shinier and faster.
She grabs the bottle and pours some polish on her car.
"Ha ha, Ben!" Lily says.
"Now my car is the best!" But the polish is not for cars.
It is for wood.
It makes Lily's car sticky and dirty.
It does not look shiny or fast anymore.
It looks silly and sad.
Lily starts to cry.
She ruined her car.
She wishes she did not use the polish.
Ben laughs at Lily.
He thinks she is silly and mean.
He does not want to play with her anymore.
He takes his truck and goes to his room.
Lily is alone in the living room.
She has no car and no friend.
She feels sorry and sad.
She wishes she did not have that idea.
Once there was a large object.
It was so big and heavy that no one could manage it.
All the people in the town tried and tried, but they were too small and weak.
Suddenly one day, a brave little boy ran to the object.
He looked large and strong.
He said he could manage the object.
He grabbed the large object with his hands, lifted it up and put it in the right place.
The people were delighted.
They were so happy they clapped and cheered.
The little boy said, "I'm glad I could manage it".
He beamed with pride and everyone smiled at him.
From then on, the boy was known as the Hero in the town.
He could manage anything!
A girl was feeling very shy.
Every day she would watch other kids playing and wished she could join them.
She knew she was too scared to do it.
One day the girl had a plan.
She was going to be brave and try to make some new friends.
She took a deep breath, gave a little wave, and said "hello" to the other kids.
They all said "hello" back and smiled.
The girl was so happy to have new friends.
She played with them until it was time to go home.
The girl told her parents all about her plan and how it worked out.
Her parents were so proud of her.
From that day forward she was never shy again.
Once upon a time there was a mighty man.
He had a big bike with a big wheel and a strong pedal.
The man decided to push his bike to the top of the hill.
He pushed with all of his might and he huffed and he puffed.
He pushed and he pushed until finally he made it to the top.
The man was so proud of the pedal he had pushed!
Then the man roared in excitement.
"Wheeee!" He shouted, enjoying the view from the top of the hill.
He was so glad he pushed his bike uphill.
Once there was a little girl named Sue.
She was three years old and loved to share.
One day, Sue went to the park with her mom.
She saw a group of children playing and went to join them.
As Sue arrived, she saw the children eating something.
It smelled yummy!
The children saw Sue and waved her over.
She smiled and asked, "What are you eating?" One of the children said, "Try some of our ice cream!
We got it to celebrate the new year." Sue was so excited!
She shared the ice cream with all of her new friends.
They all had so much fun!
The children thanked Sue for sharing and invited her to come back and play with them again.
Sue was so happy and she couldn't wait to come back and share more yummy treats with all her new friends.
Ben and Mia were playing in the park with their big red ball.
They liked to kick the ball and catch it and roll it on the grass.
They were having a lot of fun.
But then a big dog came running towards them.
The dog was barking and growling and showing its teeth.
It wanted to take their ball.
Ben and Mia were scared.
They did not like the dog.
"Go away, dog!" Ben shouted.
"This is our ball!" But the dog did not listen.
It jumped and tried to grab the ball with its mouth.
Ben and Mia held the ball tight.
They made a knot with their arms around the ball.
They wanted to protect their ball.
The dog pulled and tugged and tried to break the knot.
But Ben and Mia were strong.
They did not let go.
They were incredible.
Then they heard a whistle.
It was the dog's owner.
He came running and called the dog.
The dog stopped and ran back to him.
He said sorry to Ben and Mia and put a leash on the dog.
He took the dog away.
Ben and Mia were happy.
They hugged each other and their ball.
They were brave.
They protected their ball.
They untied the knot and continued to play.
They were still having a lot of fun.
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily.
She loved to play with her toys and sing songs.
One day, Lily went to the park and saw a boy playing with a big red ball.
She was excited and asked him if she could play too.
The boy said, "Sure!
Do you want to play catch with me?" Lily nodded her head and they started to throw the ball back and forth.
Suddenly, Lily saw a butterfly and she got very excited.
She ran after it and tried to catch it, but it flew away.
The boy said, "Don't worry, Lily.
Maybe we can catch it next time." Lily smiled and said, "Thank you.
You are a good friend." The boy smiled back and said, "No problem.
Friends always help each other.
Now let's go bow to the flowers and say some nice words to them." Lily and the boy walked to the flowers and bowed to them.
They said, "Hello flowers!
You are so pretty and colorful.
We love you!" The flowers smiled and swayed in the breeze.
Lily and the boy felt happy and continued to play together.
Anna and Ben are twins.
They like to play in the yard.
They have a swing, a slide and a sandbox.
Anna likes to swing high and fast.
Ben likes to slide down and make sandcastles.
One day, Anna wants to try the slide.
She climbs up the ladder.
She is a little scared.
She looks at Ben.
Ben is in the sandbox.
He sees Anna.
"Anna, you can do it!" Ben says.
"I will support you!" Anna smiles.
She feels brave.
She slides down.
She laughs.
She likes the slide.
"Thank you, Ben!" Anna says.
"You are a good brother!" Ben smiles.
He is happy.
He likes to help Anna.
"Anna, you are welcome!" Ben says.
"You are a good sister!" Anna and Ben hug.
They are independent.
They can try new things.
They are also supportive.
They can help each other.
They love to play in the yard.
They are happy.
Once upon a time, there was a rabbit named Bun.
Bun was very sad because he had no friends to play with.
One day, Bun decided to prepare a carrot feast to invite all the animals in the forest.
Bun hopped around the forest to invite all his animal friends.
He invited squirrels, birds, and even a friendly fox.
They all came to the carrot feast and had a great time together.
After the feast, Bun was no longer sad because he had so many new friends.
They all played together and had fun.
From that day on, Bun was always happy and never felt lonely again.
Once upon a time, there was a friendly kitty named Bella.
Bella lived in a big house with a kind family.
Every morning, Bella liked to play in the kitchen while the family ate cereal.
One morning, Bella was playing in the kitchen and noticed something strange.
She saw a big mouse next to the cereal.
Bella was scared, so she quickly ran to the family and warned them about the mouse.
The family was very surprised.
The father grabbed a broom and chased the mouse away.
Afterwards, the father made sure to warn the family to always check for any mice before eating cereal.
Bella was very proud of herself for discovering the mouse first and warning her family.
The family thanked Bella for protecting them.
Once upon a time, there was a little boy called Pete.
Pete was very persistent.
One day he clapped his hands together as hard as he could and made a wish.
He wished for a pipe!
When Pete opened his eyes, there was a tall pipe standing right in front of him.
He couldn't believe it!
What a surprise!
Pete was so excited he clapped his hands together again.
Pete soon realised he could make wonderful music with the pipe.
He played and played with it every single day.
His music filled the sky with happy sounds.
Whenever he played his pipe, Pete would clap his hands in time with the music.
The days passed by and Pete never stopped being persistent.
He kept making wonderful music with his pipe.
And whenever he finished playing he would always clap his hands in delight.
Once upon a time, there was a cute little bunny named Benny.
Benny loved to eat apples.
One day, he decided to invite his friends to a picnic in the park.
He wanted to share his apples with them.
Benny hopped to his friend Timmy's house and invited him to the picnic.
Timmy was excited and said yes.
Then, Benny went to his friend Sally's house and invited her too.
Sally was happy and said she would bring some carrots.
At the picnic, Benny and his friends ate apples and carrots.
They played games and had fun.
Benny was happy that he invited his friends to the picnic.
He realized that sharing his apples made him feel good inside.
Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy.
Timmy loved going to the park and playing with his friends.
One day, Timmy and his friends went to a beautiful restaurant to eat some yummy food.
While they were eating, two boys started to fight over a toy.
Timmy didn't like it when people fought, so he said, "Stop fighting!
Let's share the toy and play together." The two boys stopped fighting and started to play together.
After they finished eating, Timmy and his friends went back to the park to play.
Timmy felt happy that he stopped the fight and made new friends at the restaurant.
Once upon a time, there was a dolphin in the sea.
He swam around in the blue and peaceful water.
He liked to poke around in the sand at the bottom of the sea.
Suddenly, he saw a funny little fish swimming by.
He wanted to play with it, so he poked the little fish with his nose.
The little fish wriggled away, but the dolphin kept poking around in the sand.
He was having lots of fun!
Next, the dolphin decided to look around.
He swam away from the sand and saw an amazing coral reef.
He poked around the colourful coral, touching all the big and small pieces.
He was having a peaceful time enjoying all the wonderful things in the ocean.
The dolphin swam away from the coral and headed to a warm and sunny spot in the sea.
He rested there, feeling the sun on his skin, and poking the water with his tail.
He was so happy and peaceful in the sea.
"Let's organize a fun game!" said Mom.
"Yeah!" said Sally.
Mom got out a big cone and some balls.
She put the cone in the middle of the yard.
"Now we need to throw the balls," said Mom.
Sally threw the first one.
It rolled to the cone.
"That's normal," Mom said with a smile.
"Now you need to try to make all the balls get to the cone." Sally threw all the balls one by one.
They all rolled back to the cone.
"Good job organizing the game, Sally!" said Mom.
Sally felt proud of herself.
She had organized a fun game!
Once upon a time, there was a poor little girl named Lily.
She lived in a small house with her mommy and daddy.
One day, Lily found a shiny piece of candy on the ground.
She was so happy and showed it to her mommy.
"Look mommy, I found a candy!" Lily said.
Her mommy looked at the candy and smiled.
"That's great, Lily.
You can have it as a treat." Lily was so happy and ate the candy with joy.
From that day on, she would always look for more pieces of candy on the ground whenever she went outside to play.
Once upon a time, there was a lazy cat named Mittens.
Mittens liked to sleep all day and didn't like to play.
One day, Mittens saw a big stack of boxes and decided to climb on them.
"Mittens, stop climbing on those boxes!
You might fall and hurt yourself," said the little girl who owned Mittens.
But Mittens didn't listen and kept climbing.
Suddenly, the stack of boxes started to wobble and Mittens fell off!
"Mittens, are you okay?" asked the little girl.
Mittens meowed and rubbed against the little girl's leg.
From that day on, Mittens stopped being so lazy and started playing more with the little girl instead of climbing on boxes.
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily.
She loved to wear her favorite purple dress and play outside in the sun.
One day, she was playing with her friend Timmy when they saw a lot of cars on the road.
"Wow, there's so much traffic today," said Timmy.
"I believe it's because of the big parade," replied Lily.
As they watched the cars go by, Lily pointed to a purple car and said, "Look, that car is purple just like my dress!"  Timmy laughed and said, "You're right, Lily.
It's a purple car!
Do you believe we'll see more purple cars today?"  Lily smiled and said, "I believe we will.
Let's keep watching!"  And so, they spent the rest of the day watching the traffic and looking for purple cars, happy to be together and enjoying the simple joys of childhood.
Once there was a little girl.
She loved to sing.
Every day she would go out and sing at the park.
One day, the little girl was at the park and heard a train.
She was so excited to see it.
It was orange and big and looked like it wanted to play.
She jumped up and down and shouted, "Train!
Train!" The train came to a stop and the little girl got on.
The train ride was so much fun.
Everywhere the train went, the little girl sang.
She sang loud and clear.
People smiled and clapped every time she sang.
Finally the train stopped at a dry park.
There was nothing much to do, except for sing.
So the little girl sang and sang, making the dry park come alive with music.
Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tim.
Tim loved to chew gum.
He always had a pack in his pocket.
One day, Tim went to the store to buy more gum.
He saw a pack he really wanted, but he didn't have enough money.
Tim saw another boy with a pack of the same gum.
He wanted it so badly, he decided to steal it.
He took the gum and ran away.
But Tim's mom saw what he did.
She was very patient and waited for Tim to come home.
When he did, she asked him where he got the gum.
Tim felt guilty and told her the truth.
His mom explained that stealing was wrong and that he should always be honest.
Tim felt bad and promised to never steal again.
From that day on, he always asked for what he wanted and never took things that didn't belong to him.
Once there was a little girl who had very bad teeth.
Every time she smiled, her teeth felt like prickly needles.
Her mom told her that it was time to go to the dentist, so mom and daughter went.
At the dentist, the dentist looked in the little girl's mouth and said, "Oh my!
Your teeth are very bad.
We need to get them fixed." He then put a big, white smock on her and gave her a special cleaning tool.
He said, "This will help supply your teeth with the things they need.
Now, let's brush!" The girl carefully brushed her teeth with the special tool and soon her teeth felt much better and looked so much brighter.
She said, "Thank you for the supply for my teeth.
Once upon a time, there was a mule named Jeff.
Jeff lived in his meadow, where he enjoyed eating sweet grass and playing with his friends.
One day, Jeff decided he wanted to take a walk.
So, he stood up and started walking away from his meadow.
As he walked, he saw a river.
It was sparkling and clean, and it made Jeff happy.
He walked even further, and he soon found a mountain.
He thought it looked very big and majestic, so Jeff decided to stand at the top.
As he began to climb, Jeff noticed something strange.
A big man was standing at the top, and he was staring at Jeff!
Jeff was curious, so he stopped and asked the man what he was doing.
The man said, “I am looking for a strong mule.
Mary and her dad had a fun day playing at the beach.
Mary was so excited that the beach had a big stack of rocks.
She ran over to them and started to part them, one by one.
The rocks were placed in neat rows.
Dad watched her carefully and smiled.
Suddenly, Mary saw a fierce dog running across the beach.
She screamed and hid behind her dad.
The dog saw the stack of rocks and was tempted to play.
Mary was scared, but she watched from behind Dad as the dog walked over and started to part the rocks.
Dad laughed at the sight of the dog.
Mary smiled, too.
The dog had such a fun time playing with the rocks.
He part them around and even tried to make them into bigger stacks.
Mary cheered the dog on and clapped happily.
After the dog had finished playing with the rocks, Mary and Dad walked away with big smiles on their faces.
It had been a fun day at the beach.
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily.
She loved to listen to the birds singing in the trees.
One day, she went for a walk in the park and found a shiny chain on the ground.
It was very long and had lots of links.
Lily picked it up and held it in her hands.
She thought it was very pretty because it was orange.
She decided to wear it as a bracelet and show it to her friends.
They all thought it was very cool and asked where she found it.
Lily told them she found it while listening to the birds.
From that day on, Lily wore her orange chain bracelet everywhere she went and always listened for the birds singing.
Once upon a time there was a bug.
He was small and very fast.
He liked to run and play in the garden.
One day, he saw a dangerous creature.
It tried to steal something.
The bug was scared, so he ran away.
But the creature was faster.
It grabbed the bug and put him in a jar.
The bug was stuck and scared.
Suddenly, a big and friendly animal came.
He roared at the creature and took back the bug.
Then the bug was free to play again in the garden.
The bug was so happy that he had been saved.
He learned a lesson: never trust a dangerous creature.
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily.
She had a big brother who was always bossy and told her what to do.
One day, Lily wanted to play with her favorite toy, but her brother wouldn't let her.
He said she had to wait until he was done playing with it.
Lily didn't like waiting, so she decided to bow down to her brother's demands.
But as she was waiting, she saw her brother accidentally break her toy.
She was very sad and didn't know what to do.
When she told her brother what happened, he just laughed and said it was her fault for not being more careful.
Lily felt very upset and wished she had stood up to her bossy brother.
From then on, she learned to be more assertive and not let anyone push her around.
Once upon a time, a naughty bear lived in a tree.
He liked to eat yummy food, just like everyone else.
One day, he had an idea.
He suggested to the other animals that they should have a picnic.
Everyone said it was a great idea, so they set off to find some food.
The bear found a big melon that he wanted to share out between them all.
The other animals thought this was a great idea too.
But then, the naughty bear decided it was too big to carry.
So he suggested they all eat it right away.
All the animals laughed and started to eat the yummy melon.
They enjoyed every bite.
The bear was so happy that he suggested they do it again the next day!
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily.
She went to the store with her mommy.
Lily saw a toy she really wanted, but her mommy said no.
Lily was very stubborn and kept asking for the toy.
Finally, her mommy said, "Lily, I already told you no.
You need to listen to me." Lily didn't want to listen and started to cry.
A kind lady saw Lily crying and asked her what was wrong.
Lily spoke through her tears and said, "I want that toy, but mommy won't let me have it." The kind lady smiled and said, "Sometimes we can't get everything we want.
But I know a fun game we can play together!" Lily's eyes lit up and she forgot about the toy.
She was happy to make a new friend.
Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy.
Timmy loved to eat candy, and he ate it all the time.
One day, Timmy's mom said, "Timmy, you can't eat candy all the time.
It's not good for you." But Timmy didn't listen.
Later that day, Timmy was watching television when suddenly, the TV stopped working.
"Oh no!" Timmy cried.
"What happened to the TV?" His mom replied, "I think it's broken.
We'll have to get it fixed." Timmy was sad because he loved watching TV.
The next day, Timmy's mom took him to the candy store.
Timmy was so excited to eat his favorite candy.
But when they got to the store, Timmy saw a humble old man sitting outside.
The old man said, "Excuse me, do you have any spare change?" Timmy's mom gave the old man some money, and Timmy saw how happy it made the old man.
From that day on, Timmy realized that it's important to share and help others, instead of just thinking about himself and eating candy all the time.
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily.
She was very curious and always wanted to explore.
One day, as she was playing in the garden, she saw something gleaming in the sun.
It was a nail!
She made up her mind to kick it.
Lily tried to kick the nail, but she couldn't reach it.
She asked her dad to help her.
Her dad said, "Lily, I know you want to kick the nail, but it looks fragile.
You would hurt yourself if you did that."  Lily thought for a moment and then came up with a plan.
She asked her dad if she could use a stick instead of her feet.
Her dad smiled and said, "Yes, that's a brilliant idea!"  Lily grabbed a stick and carefully used it to kick the nail until it moved away.
She was so proud that she had done it all by herself.
From that day on, she knew to be careful when dealing with fragile things.
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily.
She loved to cook with her mommy in the kitchen.
One day, they decided to make hot chocolate.
Lily's mommy poured milk into a pot and put it on the stove.
She asked Lily to stir the milk with a spoon.
Lily stirred and stirred until the milk became hot.
Then, Lily's mommy gave her a cube of chocolate.
Lily was so excited!
She put the cube in the pot and stirred it until the chocolate melted.
The hot chocolate smelled so good!
When it was ready, Lily's mommy poured the hot chocolate into two cups.
Lily said, "Thank you, mommy!" Her mommy smiled and said, "You're welcome, Lily.
You were very polite when you stirred the milk." Lily felt proud of herself for being polite.
They both drank the hot chocolate and it was delicious!
Once upon a time, there was a daisy.
It was a very thin daisy.
The daisy was sad because it was so thin.
One day, it started to rain.
The rain was very soft, and soon it was over.
The daisy was happy!
Its thin stem started to grow and soon it was very strong.
Every day it grew a bit bigger, until it was a tall daisy with lots of happy petals.
All of the petals were very bright and colourful.
The daisy was so happy.
Everyone said it was the happiest daisy that ever grew!
Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim.
He lived in a small house with his mom, dad, and dog, Spot.
One day, Tim found a deep hole in his backyard.
He was very curious and wanted to see what was inside.
Tim called his dog, Spot, and they looked into the hole together.
They saw a little leak coming from the hole.
Tim said, "Spot, let's find out where the leak is coming from!" So, they both went inside the deep hole.
As they went deeper, they found a tiny frog.
The frog was making the leak by crying.
Tim asked, "Why are you crying, little frog?" The frog said, "I am sad because I can't find my way home." Tim and Spot decided to help the frog find its home.
They followed the leak and found the frog's home.
When they reached the frog's home, the frog's family was very happy.
They all started to applaud for Tim and Spot.
Tim felt very proud and said, "We are happy to help you, little frog." Then, Tim, Spot, and the frog family had a big party to celebrate.
From that day on, Tim, Spot, and the frog family became best friends.
They always played together and had lots of fun.
And whenever someone needed help, they were always there for each other.
Tom and Sam were brothers who liked to play cowboys and robbers.
They had a toy pistol that made a loud noise when they pulled the trigger.
One day, they found a real pistol in their dad's closet.
It was filthy and rusty, but they thought it looked cool.
"Let's play with this pistol," Tom said.
"It will be more fun than the toy one." "No, Tom, we can't," Sam said.
"Dad said we should never touch his pistol.
It is dangerous and can hurt us or someone else." "Come on, Sam, don't be a baby," Tom said.
"I know how to use it.
It will be fun.
I will encourage you to be brave and try it." Tom took the pistol and pointed it at a can on the fence.
He pulled the trigger, but nothing happened.
He tried again, but still nothing.
He got angry and shook the pistol.
"Stupid pistol, why won't you work?" he shouted.
Suddenly, the pistol went off with a loud bang.
The bullet hit the can and made a hole in it.
Tom and Sam were shocked and scared.
They dropped the pistol and ran inside the house.
They heard their dad coming home and saw him find the pistol and the can.
He was very angry and worried.
He called them and asked them what they had done.
"We're sorry, Dad," Tom and Sam said.
"We found your pistol and wanted to play with it.
We didn't know it was real and could shoot." Dad hugged them and said, "I'm glad you're not hurt, but you did a very bad thing.
You should never touch a pistol or any other weapon.
They are not toys, they are tools for grown-ups who know how to use them safely and responsibly.
You could have hurt yourselves or someone else.
You should always listen to me and follow the rules.
Do you understand?" "Yes, Dad, we understand," Tom and Sam said.
"We're sorry, we won't do it again." Dad said, "I forgive you, but you have to promise me you will never touch a pistol or any other weapon again.
And you have to do some chores to make up for your mistake.
Now go and wash your hands, they are filthy from the pistol." Tom and Sam nodded and went to wash their hands.
They learned their lesson and never played with a pistol or any other weapon again.
They also learned to encourage each other to do good things, not bad things.
Once upon a time, there was a fragile dolphin.
It was so small and gentle that it was hard to see it when it was swimming in the sea.
But, every day, its size started to increase and it became bigger and bigger.
Each day, it could see and explore more of the ocean.
Soon, it was swimming with its friends, and showing them all of the wonderful ocean life that it found.
Fish, crabs, and even an octopus swam around.
The dolphin was no longer fragile, and it felt strong and powerful.
It kept on increasing in size each day, until one day it even became the biggest one in its group.
All of the other dolphins were amazed by this.
The dolphin was so happy, and it jumped up out of the water and did a flip.
The other dolphins started clapping to show how proud they were.
The dolphin was so glad to be able to grow and explore the big ocean.
From that day on, it never stopped increasing in size and becoming stronger and stronger.
Once upon a time there was a curious little boy called Tom.
Tom wanted to know why the sky was blue and the grass was green, so he asked lots of people.
But no one seemed to know the answer.
Tom was feeling very frustrated and sad.
One day Tom was walking down the street and he saw something sparkly.
He went to take a closer look and he saw it was a puddle of water.
Tom decided to see what would happened if he threw a newspaper into the puddle.
He threw the newspaper into the puddle and watched as it started to soak up the water.
Tom was surprised at how quickly the newspaper soaked up the water.
He smiled in delight and ran inside to tell his mom what he had discovered.
His mom was proud of him and told him that he wasn't ignorant, he had learned something new.
From that day on, Tom never stopped exploring and learning new things.
Once upon a time, there lived a dependable star.
She shined brightly every night and was an important part of the night sky.
One day someone asked the star why she never lied.
She smiled and said it was because she was dependable.
One night, another star came and asked her why she was so dependable.
She said it was because it made her happy.
The other star thought she was silly, so he decided to try lying.
The star tried to lie, but he just couldn't do it.
He was too used to being dependable.
So, he decided to stick to being honest just like the first star.
They both shone together in the night sky, dependable and happy.
Once upon a time there was a girl who went to the beach.
She looked out into the ocean and saw some jellyfish.
It was a bright sunny day, the jellyfish were moving slow in the water.
The girl watched them for a while.
She was amazed at their colors and how they moved so slowly.
Then she had an idea.
She decided to put her toes into the water and see if she could touch one of the jellyfish.
She took off her shoes and slowly stepped into the water.
When she was ankle deep in the water, she saw one of the jellyfish very close to her.
She looked closer and carefully tried to touch it.
As soon as she did, the jellyfish filled the water with colorful sparkles!
The girl was so excited.
She had never seen anything like this before.
She realized that the jellyfish were magical.
She smiled and slowly stepped out of the water.
It was the most wonderful thing she had ever seen.
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lucy.
She had a big, serious job to do.
Her mom asked her to wrap a gift for her friend's birthday party.
Lucy was very excited to help.
But Lucy was not very good at wrapping.
The paper tore and the tape stuck to her fingers.
She tried again and again, but the gift still looked messy.
Lucy felt sad and started to cry.
Her mom came to see what was wrong, but it was too late.
The gift was ruined and they didn't have any more paper to wrap it.
Lucy's friend didn't get a nicely wrapped gift at her birthday party.
Once upon a time, there was a whale swimming in the middle of the sea.
He was startled by a loud splash.
He peered into the water expecting to see something, but nothing was there.
He was frightened, so he decided to sit still, hoping the strange noise wouldn't come back.
Suddenly, he felt a tap on his back and heard a voice.
He quickly turned around and saw a small fish.
The fish said "Hello whale.
Why are you so frightened?" The whale replied, "I thought something was coming to get me." The fish smiled and said, "Don't worry, you're safe here.
Sit and be calm." The whale thanked the fish and sat down.
He felt better knowing that the fish was there and he was no longer frightened.
From then on, the whale and the fish were friends, and they stayed together even when the sea was full of strange sounds.
Lily and Tom are twins.
They like to play with their new toys.
Mom and Dad gave them new toys for their birthday.
Lily has a new doll and Tom has a new car.
One day, they go to the park with Mom and Dad.
They see a big band playing music.
The band has drums, trumpets, and flags.
The band is doing a march.
Lily and Tom want to see the march.
They run to the band.
They want to touch the drums and the flags.
But the band does not like that.
The band says, "Stop!
Go away!
You are making noise!" Lily and Tom are scared.
They scream.
They run back to Mom and Dad.
Mom and Dad hug them.
They say, "It's okay.
The band is not angry.
They just need to play their music.
You can watch from here.
But you cannot touch their things." Lily and Tom nod.
They watch the march from a distance.
They clap their hands.
They like the music.
They forget their scream.
They are happy.
Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy.
Timmy loved to play hide-and-seek with his friends.
One day, Timmy's mom gave him a mask to wear.
The mask was dark and covered Timmy's face.
Timmy put on the mask and ran outside to play with his friends.
When it was his turn to hide, Timmy found a good spot behind a tree.
But when he tried to come out, the mask got stuck on a branch.
Timmy tried to pull the mask off, but it wouldn't budge.
He started to get scared because he couldn't see anything.
Luckily, his friends heard him crying and came to help.
Together, they pulled the mask off and Timmy was so happy to see again.
Once, there was a little bird.
He was so small and his wings so very tiny.
He flew around, looking for something to eat.
One day, a big wind blew and made the little bird scared.
He looked around for a place to keep safe.
Suddenly, he saw a big tree.
He quickly flew to it and nestled into its branches.
The little bird began to feel safe and snug, so he tucked his tiny wings in and went to sleep.
But then, he heard a loud noise.
It was a hawk, looking for something to eat!
The little bird was so frightened and didn't know what to do.
He decided to hide inside the tree, deep down in a hollow branch.
The hawk swooped around, looking and searching.
But it couldn't find the little bird.
Suddenly, the little bird heard a noise.
It was the swish of wings!
Another bird had come to protect him.
The big bird flew around and around, chasing away the hawk.
The little bird was so thankful and happy.
The big bird had protected him and he was no longer scared.
He flew away, back to the sky, feeling warm and safe.
Once upon a time, there was a soldier.
He wore a big hat and a pink shirt.
He was very brave and strong, but sometimes he felt scared.
One day, the soldier was walking in the forest when he heard a loud noise.
He looked around and saw a big bear!
The soldier felt scared and didn't know what to do.
Suddenly, he heard a little voice say, "Don't be scared, soldier.
I will comfort you." It was a little girl with a pink dress.
She hugged the soldier and he felt better.
The soldier and the little girl became friends and walked together in the forest.
They saw many animals, but the soldier was not scared anymore.
He knew that his new friend would always be there to comfort him.
One day, a little red radish rolled away.
He was looking for somewhere to call home.
He rolled and rolled, but nowhere seemed just right.
Then he came upon an ugly old garden.
The radish felt discouraged, so he decided to keep rolling.
But just then the garden grew a smile.
A kind, elderly woman appeared and she said, "Come here, little radish.
This is the perfect place to stay." The radish didn't feel so sure, but the old woman encouraged him.
She said, "This garden is full of beauty, and you will add a special touch to it." Those words filled the radish with warmth, so he listened to the old woman and stayed.
And sure enough, soon the little radish found his place in the garden and brought lots of beauty to the ugly plot of land.
He thanked the old woman for her kindness and support.
And from that day on, the radish was filled with courage and joy, just like the old woman.
Once upon a time, there was a mighty lion named Leo.
Leo lived in the jungle with his friends, the monkeys and the birds.
One day, Leo and his friends decided to go on a trip to the hotel.
When they arrived at the hotel, the receptionist told them that they needed to pay to stay there.
But Leo insisted that they should be allowed to stay for free because they were animals and didn't have any money.
The receptionist explained that everyone needed to pay to stay at the hotel, even animals.
Leo was upset and started to roar loudly.
His friends tried to calm him down and told him that it was important to follow the rules and pay for things that they needed.
Leo realized that his friends were right and apologized to the receptionist for his behavior.
From that day on, Leo learned that it was important to follow the rules and pay for things that he needed.
The moral of the story is that it's important to be responsible and follow the rules, even if we don't always like them.
Once there was a little girl named Yvonne.
She was three years old and loved lollipops.
Every day, her mom would give her a lollipop.
Yvonne enjoyed eating them and it was her favourite treat.
One day, her mom gave her an extra special lollipop.
It was a rare, multi-coloured lollipop.
Yvonne couldn't wait to try it.
But when she licked it, she didn't like the taste!
She scrunched up her face and said, "Mommy, I hate this lollipop."  Her mom smiled and said, "I know, sweetheart.
Not everyone likes the same things.
That's why rare things can be so special — not everyone just likes them.
You should give it to your brother and see if he likes it." Yvonne wasn't happy about it.
But she realised mom was right and gave the lollipop to her brother.
He thanked her and gobbled it up.
Yvonne smiled as she watched him enjoy it.
From then on, Yvonne promised herself to try new and different things.
She wanted to experience all of the amazing, rare flavours the world had to offer!
Once upon a time, there was a baby named Timmy.
Timmy was very little and he loved to play.
One day, Timmy's mommy gave him a bath and then she wrapped him up in a towel to dry him off.
Timmy giggled and wiggled as his mommy dried him with the towel.
After Timmy was dry, his mommy put him in his crib for a nap.
Timmy was very tired and he closed his eyes.
As he drifted off to sleep, he thought about how much he loved his mommy.
He was very thoughtful and grateful for her love and care.
When Timmy woke up from his nap, he felt so much better.
He was dry and cozy in his crib.
He smiled and cooed, knowing that his mommy would always take good care of him.
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily.
She loved to explore the forest near her house.
One day, she saw an elderly woman picking berries.
The woman smiled at Lily and gave her a handful of juicy berries.
Lily thanked the woman and continued on her way.
As Lily walked deeper into the forest, she noticed a strange feeling.
Something was watching her.
She looked around but didn't see anything.
Suddenly, she heard a rustling in the bushes.
She was scared, but she remembered the berries the kind woman gave her.
She ate them and felt brave.
As she continued on, she saw a beautiful tree with a big berry on it.
She picked the berry and ate it, but it didn't taste good.
Suddenly, she heard a loud noise.
It was a bear!
The bear was angry and was coming towards her.
Lily was scared, but she remembered the feeling of bravery from the berries.
She threw the berry at the bear and it revealed a hidden treasure.
The bear was happy and left Lily alone.
Lily continued on her way, feeling proud of herself for being brave.
Ben is a boy who likes to play with his dog, Rex.
Rex is a big dog who can run fast and catch balls.
Ben and Rex are best friends.
They like to go to the park and have fun.
One day, Ben and Rex go to the park with Ben's mom.
Ben's mom has a bag with meat and bread for lunch.
She puts the bag on a bench and tells Ben and Rex to stay near her.
But Rex smells the meat and wants to eat it.
He runs to the bench and jumps on the bag.
Ben's mom sees Rex and shouts, "No, Rex!
Bad dog!
Leave the meat alone!" But Rex is deaf.
He cannot hear Ben's mom.
He only hears his tummy.
He rips the bag and takes the meat.
He runs away with the meat in his mouth.
Ben sees Rex and runs after him.
He calls, "Rex, come back!
Drop the meat!
You are in trouble!" But Rex is deaf.
He cannot hear Ben.
He only sees the meat.
He runs to a hill and eats the meat.
Ben's mom runs after Ben and Rex.
She is angry and worried.
She catches up with Ben and hugs him.
She says, "Ben, are you okay?
Rex is a naughty dog.
He should not take the meat.
He should listen to us." But Rex is deaf.
He cannot hear Ben's mom.
He only feels happy.
He licks his lips and wags his tail.
He loves Ben and Ben's mom.
He thinks they are the best.
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily.
She loved the color purple and always wore a purple dress.
One day, Lily's mommy told her they were going on a tour of the park.
Lily was so excited!
As they walked around the park, Lily saw a big bell.
Her mommy told her that if she rang the bell, something special would happen.
Lily couldn't wait to ring the bell!
Finally, they arrived at the bell.
Lily took a deep breath and rang it as hard as she could.
Suddenly, the sky turned purple!
Lily was amazed and her mommy smiled.
She had known all along that ringing the bell would make the sky turn purple.
From that day on, Lily knew that sometimes things can be even more special than you expect them to be.
She couldn't wait to go on another tour and see what other surprises were waiting for her.
Once upon a time, there was a naughty crane.
He liked to play tricks on his animal friends.
One day, he saw a pretty butterfly and wanted to catch it.
He tried to bow down to catch it, but the butterfly flew away.
The crane felt sad and decided to apologize to his friends.
He went to the pond and saw his friend, the duck.
The crane bowed his head and said sorry.
The duck forgave him and they played together.
From that day on, the crane was not naughty anymore.
He learned to be kind to his friends and they all had fun together.
The butterfly even came back and they all watched it fly around.
The end.
It was a sunny day, and Melissa wanted to walk to the park.
She grabbed her phone, and asked her Mom "Can I go to the park, Mom?" Mom said "Yes, honey, but you must promise me to stay at the park.
No walking away onto other streets, okay?" Melissa nodded, and said "Yes, I promise".
Mom gave Melissa a telephone.
"This is in case you ever need me while you are at the park." She told her.
"If you need me, just call me right away!" Melissa thanked her and went to the park.
Once she was there, she noticed something weird.
There was a big bear walking around!
She watched it for a few minutes, until it disappeared out of sight.
Melissa smiled, happy to have made it to the park safely.
She reminded herself of her promise to her Mom, and went to play.
Tom and Sam are brothers.
They like to play outside with their ball.
One day, they see a girl sitting on a bench.
She looks sad and tired.
She has a big bag next to her.
"Hi, what is your name?" Tom asks the girl.
"My name is Lily.
I am waiting for my mom.
She is in the hospital.
She needs a new lung." Lily says.
"A new lung?
What is that?" Sam asks.
"It is a part of your body that helps you breathe.
My mom has a bad lung.
She cannot breathe well.
She needs a new lung from someone who is generous and gives it to her." Lily explains.
"That is very sad.
We are sorry for your mom." Tom says.
"Can we play with you?
Maybe that will make you happy." Sam says.
Lily smiles and nods.
She puts her bag on the bench and joins Tom and Sam.
They spend a long time playing with the ball.
They laugh and run and have fun.
Lily forgets about her worries for a while.
"Thank you for playing with me.
You are very nice and generous." Lily says.
"You are welcome.
We are happy to be your friends." Tom and Sam say.
They hug Lily and say goodbye.
They hope that Lily's mom will get a new lung soon and be well again.
They also hope to see Lily again and play with her some more.
Tom and Lily liked to play with their toy boat.
They made it sail in the bathtub, in the sink, and sometimes in the puddle outside.
They pretended they were pirates or explorers, and had many adventures.
One day, they wanted to try something new.
They decided to sail their boat in the toilet.
They thought it would be fun to see how fast it could go in the swirling water.
They lifted the lid and put their boat inside.
"Ready, Lily?" Tom asked.
"Ready, Tom!" Lily answered.
They pushed the button and watched their boat sail away.
But then, something went wrong.
The boat got stuck in the hole and the water kept rising.
It spilled over the edge and made a big mess on the floor.
"Oh no!" Tom and Lily cried.
"Our boat!
Our boat!" They ran to get their mom, who was not happy to see the flooded bathroom.
She turned off the water and took out the boat.
She scolded Tom and Lily for being careless and naughty.
She made them clean up the water and dry the boat.
Tom and Lily felt sorry for what they did.
They hugged their mom and said they were sorry.
They promised to never sail their boat in the toilet again.
Mom forgave them and gave them a kiss.
She told them to play with their boat somewhere safe and comfortable.
She suggested the bathtub or the sink.
Tom and Lily agreed.
They took their boat to the bathtub and filled it with warm water and bubbles.
They made it sail again, but this time, they were careful and happy.
They learned their lesson and had fun.
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily who loved to collect shiny rocks.
One day, while playing in the park, she found a beautiful gem on the ground.
She picked it up and put it in her pocket.
As she was walking home, a kind old man stopped her and said, "Be careful, little one.
That gem is very valuable and someone might try to take it from you." Lily thanked the man and promised to keep it safe.
Later that day, Lily's friend Tommy came over to play.
When he saw the gem, he wanted it for himself.
"Give me that gem, Lily!" he demanded.
But Lily remembered the old man's warning and refused to give it to him.
Tommy became angry and started to cry.
But Lily knew she had done the right thing.
She felt proud that she had listened to the old man's advice and protected her precious gem.
The moral of the story is that it's important to listen to the advice of others, even if we feel helpless.
Anna likes to draw and write notes.
She has many crayons and papers.
She makes notes for her mom, dad, and brother.
She puts them in different places.
She wants to make them happy.
One day, she makes a note for her cat, Fluffy.
