She had a family and a friend.
She was happy.
Once upon a time, there was a small boy named Timmy.
Timmy loved to look up at the sky and see all the stars twinkling.
He would point at them and say, "Look, Mommy, stars!" One day, Timmy's mommy told him they were going to design a special surprise for his birthday.
Timmy was very excited and couldn't wait to see what it was.
As they were walking home from the store, Timmy saw a small star on the ground.
He picked it up and put it in his pocket.
"Maybe this will bring me good luck," he thought.
On his birthday, Timmy's mommy gave him a present wrapped in shiny paper.
When he opened it, he saw a beautiful star-shaped balloon.
"Wow, Mommy, you designed this just for me!" Timmy exclaimed.
And as he looked at the balloon, he remembered the small star he found on the ground and knew it was a sign of good luck.
Sara is a girl who likes to play with her cat, Tom.
Tom is a black cat with a long tail.
Sara likes to pull his tail and make him meow.
Tom does not like that.
He runs away from Sara and hides under the bed.
One day, Sara finds a toy mouse that makes a squeak sound when she squeezes it.
She thinks it is funny and she wants to show it to Tom.
She goes to the bedroom and looks for Tom.
She sees his tail sticking out from under the bed.
She grabs his tail and pulls it hard.
Tom jumps out and hisses at Sara.
He is angry and scared.
"Tom, look what I have!" Sara says.
She squeezes the toy mouse and it squeaks.
Tom does not like the noise.
He thinks it is a real mouse that wants to eat him.
He runs away from Sara and the toy mouse.
He looks for a safe place to hide.
Sara follows Tom and tries to make him play with her.
She repeats the same thing.
She pulls his tail and squeezes the toy mouse.
Tom repeats the same thing.
He jumps out and hisses at Sara.
He runs away from Sara and the toy mouse.
He looks for a safe place to hide.
They go around the house like this for a long time.
Sara does not understand why Tom does not want to play with her.
Tom does not understand why Sara does not leave him alone.
They are both unhappy.
Then, Sara's mom comes home.
She sees Sara and Tom running and making noise.
She sees the toy mouse in Sara's hand.
She understands what is going on.
"Sara, stop that!" she says.
"You are scaring Tom.
He does not like the toy mouse.
He thinks it is real.
He does not like it when you pull his tail.
It hurts him.
You have to be gentle and kind to him.
He is your friend." Sara looks at her mom.
She looks at Tom.
She looks at the toy mouse.
She feels sorry.
She did not know she was hurting Tom.
She did not know he was afraid.
She loves Tom.
She wants him to be happy.
She drops the toy mouse and lets go of Tom's tail.
She says, "I'm sorry, Tom.
I did not mean to scare you.
I wanted to play with you.
Can we be friends?" Tom looks at Sara.
He looks at her mom.
He looks at the toy mouse.
He feels calm.
He knows Sara did not mean to hurt him.
He knows she loves him.
He wants to be friends.
He walks slowly to Sara and rubs his head against her leg.
He purrs softly.
He says, "Meow." Sara smiles and bends down to pet Tom.
She says, "I love you, Tom.
You are a good cat.
Let's play something else." Tom nods and follows Sara.
He says, "Meow." Sara's mom watches them and smiles.
She says, "That's better.
Now you are both happy.
And remember, don't repeat the same thing that makes Tom unhappy.
Find something else that makes him happy." Sara and Tom agree.
They say, "Okay." They go to the living room and find a ball of yarn.
They play with it together.
They roll it and chase it and catch it.
They have fun.
They are happy.
They are friends.
Once there was a little boy named Jack.
He was so excited because his mommy was going to show him something special.
She lifted him up and carried him over to a big machine.
It was yellow, shiny and very organized.
Jack was so curious.
He looked at the machine and saw that it had lots of buttons.
His mommy told him that it was a special carrying machine.
She said it could carry him anywhere he wanted to go.
Jack was amazed.
He imagined himself flying around like an eagle.
He pushed the buttons and the machine began to move.
Suddenly, he was soaring through the air.
Later, when he was done, his mommy carried him back safely to the ground.
Jack was so happy.
He couldn't wait to use the machine again.
Mommy smiled and said that if he was a good boy she would let him use it whenever he wanted.
Jack smiled and gave his mommy a big hug!
Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy.
He loved cars and trucks, especially ones with big engines.
One day, he saw a truck with an interesting engine and he wanted to take a closer look.
Timmy walked over to the truck and knelt down to get a better view.
Suddenly, the truck started moving and Timmy couldn't get out of the way in time.
He tried to yell for help, but it was too late.
When Timmy's mom found out what happened, she was very sad.
She knew she would never see her little boy again.
Timmy's friends missed him too and they would often kneel down and talk to him, hoping he could hear them from heaven.
It was a very sad ending to a story about a boy who loved engines.
Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy.
Timmy loved to climb trees.
One day, Timmy saw a really high tree and he wanted to climb it.
Timmy's mom said, "Be careful Timmy, that tree is really high."  Timmy said, "I can do it, Mommy!"  So, Timmy climbed and climbed until he reached the top of the tree.
He looked down and saw his mom tapping her foot.
"Come down, Timmy," she said.
Timmy climbed back down and said, "That was so much fun!
Can we climb another tree tomorrow?"  His mom smiled and said, "Sure, Timmy.
But let's find a shorter one next time."
One day, a little fish named Swimmy loved to swim.
Swimmy was a reliable friend, always there to help.
All the other fish liked Swimmy because he was kind and good at swimming.
Swimmy found a big desk in the water.
He thought it was strange, but he wanted to show his friends.
So he told them to follow him to see the big desk.
They all swam together to find it.
When they got to the big desk, they were all very happy.
They played around it and had lots of fun.
Swimmy was glad he could show his friends the big desk, and they all knew they could count on him.
Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy.
Timmy loved to play with his toys and his dog, Spot.
One day, Timmy's mom noticed that the pipe under the sink was leaking.
She tried to fix it, but it was too hard.
Timmy's dad was at work, so his mom had to call a plumber.
The plumber came and fixed the pipe, but he said it would cost a lot of money.
Timmy's mom was sad because she didn't have enough money to pay the plumber.
That night, Timmy's mom cried because she didn't know what to do.
The next day, the landlord came and said that Timmy's family had to move out because they couldn't pay the rent.
Timmy was sad because he didn't want to leave his home.
Timmy's family moved to a new place, but it wasn't normal.
It was small and dark, and they didn't have enough money to buy new toys for Timmy.
Timmy cried because he missed his old home and his old toys.
The end.
Once upon a time, there was a little boy who was very brave.
One day he decided to go outside and explore the world.
As he balanced on the edge of a bridge, he saw a spoon in the water below.
He wanted to get the spoon, so he carefully climbed down the bridge.
When he got to the bottom, he was very frightened.
He tried to balance on the edge of the water but it was too slippery.
He tried to find something else to hold onto but his hands kept slipping.
Then suddenly a voice called out.
It was his mom!
"Come back honey!
That water is too dangerous for you," she said.
The little boy was relieved.
He reached out his hand and his mom carefully helped him back to the bridge.
Then they went back home together, and the little boy never tried to balance on the water again.
Ben and Mia were playing in their room.
They had many toys and books, but they wanted to find something new.
They saw the closet door and opened it.
Inside, they saw many clothes and shoes, but also a big box.
"What is in the box?" Mia asked.
"Let's see!" Ben said.
He pulled the box out of the closet and opened it.
Inside, there were many hats of different colors and shapes.
"Wow, look at these hats!" Mia said.
She picked up a red hat with a flower and put it on her head.
"I am a lady!" Ben picked up a blue hat with a star and put it on his head.
"I am a hero!" They tried on different hats and pretended to be different people.
They had fun and laughed a lot.
But they did not see that their dad was watching them from the door.
He smiled and walked in.
He was bald and had no hair on his head.
"Hello, my little hat lovers!" he said.
"You look very funny and cute!" Ben and Mia saw their dad and ran to him.
They hugged him and gave him a hat.
"Here, dad, you can have this hat!" Ben said.
He gave him a green hat with a feather.
"Thank you, Ben, this is very nice!" dad said.
He put on the hat and made a silly face.
"Here, dad, you can have this hat too!" Mia said.
She gave him a yellow hat with a bow.
"Thank you, Mia, this is very pretty!" dad said.
He put on the hat and made another silly face.
Ben and Mia giggled and clapped.
They liked their dad's hats.
They spread them on the floor and played with them together.
They were happy.
Tim and Lily were best friends.
They liked to play outside in the park.
One day, it was very cold and windy.
Tim's mom said, "You need to wear a sweater, Tim.
It will keep you warm and cozy." Tim did not like sweaters.
He said, "No, mom.
Sweaters are itchy and ugly.
I don't want to wear one." Tim's mom said, "OK, Tim.
But you might get sick if you don't wear one." Tim did not listen.
He ran outside to meet Lily.
Lily was wearing a sweater.
It was pink and soft.
She said, "Hi, Tim.
Do you like my sweater?
My grandma made it for me.
She said it is a great sweater.
It has a heart on it.
See?" Tim said, "No, Lily.
I don't like your sweater.
It is too girly and silly.
You look like a baby.
Sweaters are dumb.
You should take it off." Lily felt sad.
She said, "But, Tim.
My sweater is warm and nice.
It makes me happy.
Why are you so mean?" Tim said, "Because sweaters are stupid.
Come on, let's go play on the swings." Tim and Lily went to play on the swings.
The wind blew harder.
Tim felt cold and shivery.
He wished he had a sweater.
He saw Lily swinging high and fast.
She looked happy and snug.
He said, "Lily, can I have your sweater?
I am cold and sick." Lily said, "No, Tim.
You can't have my sweater.
You were mean to me and my sweater.
You said you don't like sweaters.
You should have listened to your mom.
She knows what is best for you." Tim felt sorry.
He said, "You are right, Lily.
I was wrong.
I am sorry.
I should have been nice to you and your sweater.
Can you forgive me?" Lily said, "Yes, Tim.
I can forgive you.
You are my friend.
But you still can't have my sweater.
You need to learn your lesson.
Next time, wear a sweater when it is cold.
It will make you feel better.
I recommend it." Tim said, "OK, Lily.
I will.
Thank you for being a good friend.
And for having a great sweater." The moral of the story is: You should listen to your mom and wear a sweater when it is cold.
You should also be kind to your friends and their sweaters.
Sweaters are not dumb.
They are warm and cozy and sometimes have hearts on them.
Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy.
Timmy loved playing outside in the sunshine.
One day, Timmy saw his friend Billy with a red glove.
Timmy asked, "Can I wear your glove, Billy?" Billy said, "Sure, but be wise with it.
Don't slap anyone with it." Timmy put on the glove and ran around, feeling like a superhero.
Suddenly, he saw his little sister playing nearby.
He thought it would be funny to slap her with the glove.
But then he remembered what Billy said and decided not to do it.
Instead, Timmy went up to his sister and said, "Let's play catch with the glove!" They had so much fun playing together and Timmy felt very wise for making the right choice.
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lucy.
She was three-years-old and she was very brave.
One day, she was playing with her friends when suddenly, it became dark outside and it started to rain.
All of Lucy's friends were scared of the dark and the rain and they ran away.
But Lucy was not scared.
She bravely walked up to her house that was next to a tall building.
When she looked up at the tall building, she saw that it was dark inside.
Lucy: What is happening inside the building?
Just then, Lucy heard some people rushing around inside.
She wanted to find out what was going on.
So, she bravely walked up to the building even though it was dark outside.
When Lucy walked inside the building, she saw that everyone was running around doing errands and helping people who needed help.
Lucy felt so good that she wanted to help.
Lucy learned a valuable lesson, even in the darkness and confusion, everyone can help one another and make a difference.
The moral of the story is, no matter how dark and scary a situation might seem, kindness, courage and helpfulness will always prevail.
Once upon a time, there was a wide automobile.
It was big and shiny, and it always stayed parked in the driveway.
Two kids, Jack and Jill, would always let themselves into the automobile when their parents weren't around and pretend to drive.
One day, Jack and Jill let themselves into the automobile and were about to start pretending to drive like they usually did.
All of a sudden, a loud voice came from outside the automobile.
It was the owner of the car!
He asked them what they were doing and the kids were so scared they didn't know what to say.
The owner told the kids that they must pay him a lot of money if they wanted to keep pretending to drive.
Jack and Jill did not have any money, so they had to say goodbye to the automobile and walked away with heavy hearts.
Even though they had done something wrong, they didn't deserve such a bad ending.
Once upon a time, Timmy was walking through the forest.
He was hoping to find something special.
Suddenly, he heard someone whacking something with a hammer.
He looked around, and he saw a little treehouse.
Suddenly, something flew out of the treehouse!
A little bird was carrying something in its beak.
Timmy followed the bird and noticed it was carrying a heavy hammer.
Timmy was excited.
He had never seen anything so special before!
He wanted it.
The bird dropped the hammer and flew away.
Timmy ran and grabbed the hammer.
It was gold, glossy, and spoiled.
It felt magical in his hand.
Timmy was so happy, he shouted, "Thank you!
I will take good care of it!"  Suddenly, a voice from the treehouse called out, "You're welcome!
I hope you will enjoy it!"  Timmy smiled.
He couldn't believe what just happened.
He had hoped for something special and he got it!
He thanked the voice and started walking back home with his hammer.
He couldn't wait to show it to his family.
Once upon a time, there was a little girl who was three years old.
Her mommy took her to the park.
The little girl was so happy to be there.
In the park, the little girl saw a bird.
It was brown and small, and it was eating some food in the grass.
The little girl asked her mommy if she could feed the bird too.
Mommy said, "Yes, you can feed the bird.
Take a few pieces of your sandwich and put them in your hand." The little girl did as mommy said.
She opened her sandwich and put some pieces of it in her hand.
She moved her hand closer to the bird, and the little bird came over and started eating the sandwich.
The little girl was delighted!
Then, the little girl and mommy went for a walk in the park.
As they were walking, mommy pointed out some hidden flowers.
The little girl loved exploring the flowers and discovering all their beautiful colors.
When it was time to go home, the little girl felt so excited.
She knew she had been lucky enough to share her sandwich with a bird, and find hidden flowers in the park.
Lily and Max were restless.
They wanted to play outside, but it was raining.
They looked around the house for something fun to do.
They saw a big box in the corner of the living room.
"What is in there?" Lily asked.
"I don't know.
Let's find out!" Max said.
They opened the box and saw many old things.
There were books, toys, clothes, and pictures.
They searched the box for something interesting.
They found a shiny medal, a soft hat, a broken watch, and a yellow letter.
"Look at this!" Lily said, holding the letter.
"It has a name on it.
Grandma Rose." "Who is Grandma Rose?" Max asked.
"I don't know.
Maybe she was Mom's mom or Dad's mom.
Let's ask them!" Lily said.
They ran to the kitchen, where Mom and Dad were making lunch.
They showed them the letter and the other things.
"Wow, where did you find these?" Mom asked.
"In the big box in the living room.
Who is Grandma Rose?" Lily asked.
Mom smiled and hugged them.
"Grandma Rose was my mom.
She died when I was little.
She was very brave and kind.
She gave me this medal when I was born.
It was from her time in the army.
She wrote me this letter before she went away.
It tells me how much she loves me and how proud she is of me.
It is the truth." Lily and Max looked at the letter and the medal.
They felt sad and curious.
"Can we read the letter?" Max asked.
"Of course.
I will read it to you.
And then we can look at the pictures and I can tell you more stories about Grandma Rose.
She would have loved to meet you." Mom said.
Lily and Max nodded.
They followed Mom to the couch and sat with her.
They listened to her voice and looked at her face.
They felt happy and warm.
They learned more about Grandma Rose and their family.
They forgot about the rain and the boredom.
They found something more fun and important.
They found the truth.
Once upon a time there was a very compassionate man.
He loved animals, and he was always helpful to others.
One day, he heard a loud screaming coming from the woods close-by.
He rushed over to see what was happening.
He came upon an animal stuck in a giant spider web.
The poor creature was scared and in pain.
The man felt so sorry for the animal.
Even though it was dangerous, he carefully pulled away the web and freed the animal.
He then put the poor creature in his pocket and took it home.
Even though he was being kind, he was still worried about the price he might have to pay.
Once home, he placed the animal in an old shoebox and put a blanket on top.
He wanted to keep the creature safe, but he wasn't sure what he should do next.
Suddenly, out of nowhere, a giant wolf appeared.
It jumped up and started to roar.
The man was terrified and started to scream.
The animal in the old shoebox was so scared it started to scream too.
The compassionate man tried to fight back the wolf within him, but it was too late.
The wolf snatched the creature from its shoebox and took off.
The compassionate man screamed in pain and sorrow.
It was too late, the man had paid a heavy price for his compassion.
Mandy had a cup with her name on it.
It was a pale blue mug with pretty flowers.
She loved it so much.
One day, Mandy's mom said: "Let's write your name on this mug, Mandy." Mandy was so excited.
She grabbed a pen and wrote her very long name on the mug.
Mandy looked at her mug.
"Mom, I love it!" she yelled.
Mandy's mom chuckled.
"It looks great, Mandy," she said.
Mandy grabbed her mug and hugged it tight.
From then on, whenever she sipped her favorite drinks, she was proud to drink from her mug with her name written on it.
Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Toby.
She loved to dance and play all day.
She had a band of special friends who she played in the park with.
One day, Toby's friends said to her, "Let's all jump together!" Toby was excited and said, "Yes!
That sounds like a lot of fun!" They went to the park and stood in a circle.
They held hands and jumped together in the warm sunshine.
Toby couldn't help but laugh and smile.
When they had finished jumping, Toby's friends said, "We should do this every day!" Toby agreed and said, "I'm so happy we can jump and play together!"
Once upon a time, there was a brown piece of fabric.
It was so big that it could cover the whole house.
It was so soft and comfortable that the whole family loved it.
Two siblings, Sara and Tim, were playing in their family's livingroom.
Sara held a brown piece in her hands and was very excited.
She said to Tim, "Look, brother!
I wrap this piece around my body and look like a superhero!" Tim smiled and replied, "Let me do it too!" He grabbed the brown piece and quickly wrapped it around his body.
He started running around the house and imagined he could fly.
Sara laughed.
She said, "Now, we both can be superheroes!" The two of them ran around the house, pretending to be superheroes and playing with the brown piece.
Once upon a time there was a kind and compassionate man who lived in the nearby village.
He was a cheerful soul who always tried to encourage others with his kind words.
One day he was walking through the city when he noticed a little girl, about three years old, sobbing on a nearby bench.
He approached her and asked what was wrong.
The girl looked up at him, her eyes full of tears, and quietly said, "My blue balloon floated away.
I wanted it for my birthday." The man's heart melted at her story and he could see how upset the girl was.
He gently put his hand on her shoulder and said, "I understand how you feel, sweetheart.
Let me try to encourage you.
What do you say if I help you get a new blue balloon?" The girl's eyes lit up with a spark of hope and she smiled through teary eyes.
The compassionate stranger then took her hand and they walked to the nearby market where they bought a brand new beautiful blue balloon.
He tied it to her tiny wrist and told her that it was a birthday present from him.
The girl smiled and wrapped her small arms around his neck.
He hugged her back and she thanked him for his kindness before she skipped away with her new balloon, still smiling.
The man watched her until she was out of sight and he smiled, knowing that he had just done something kind.
He was happy
Ben and his dad were walking along a path together.
Ben was very excited, as he had never seen a gate before.
"What is that, Daddy?" Ben asked.
"It's a gate", Daddy replied.
They went closer, and Ben ran his hand over the gate.
The gate felt rough and Ben made a funny face.
"It's not soft like the grass", Ben said.
Daddy agreed and explained that the gate was made out of steel.
He told Ben that the gate was there to keep things safe from strangers who might try to come in.
Ben kept looking at the gate.
Daddy continued to explain what a gate is and why it's important.
Suddenly, Ben noticed that the gate was opening slowly.
He asked his dad what was happening.
Daddy replied, "The gate is opening because someone pushed the button to increase the opening."  Ben was amazed!
He took a few steps back and watched, clapping his hands excitedly.
The gate opened wider and wider until it was completely open.
Ben and Daddy smiled at each other.
Ben had learned a lot about gates today.
Once upon a time, there was a big, happy family.
They lived in a house with a big yard where they played every day.
One day, they decided to go to the park.
The park was very high because it had a big slide and a tall swing.
At the park, they saw a barber who was cutting hair for the children.
The barber was very nice and gave them lollipops.
Suddenly, they heard a loud noise.
It was a boy who was playing with a toy gun and pretended to shoot his friends.
The family didn't like it because it was not nice to shoot friends.
After playing at the park, they went back home and had a nice dinner.
They talked about the fun they had and how they liked the barber.
They also talked about how they didn't like the boy who pretended to shoot.
They decided to teach him to play nicely next time they saw him.
Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a little boy named Tom.
Tom had a big bag of marbles.
He liked to play with them all day.
One day, Tom saw his friend, Sam, playing with his marbles.
Sam had a shiny, green marble.
Tom felt envious of Sam's green marble.
Tom said, "Sam, can I play with your green marble?" Sam said, "Yes, but let's spread our marbles on the ground and play together." So, Tom and Sam spread their marbles on the ground.
They played a fun game, rolling the marbles back and forth.
Tom was happy to play with the shiny, green marble, and Sam was happy to share with his friend.
At the end of the day, Tom and Sam picked up their marbles.
Sam said, "Tom, you can keep the green marble.
We are friends, and friends share." Tom smiled and said, "Thank you, Sam!" From that day on, Tom and Sam played with their marbles together, and they were the best of friends.
Once upon a time, there was a little girl who was very sad.
She wanted to eat her favorite food, pasta, but there was none.
She started to cry.
Suddenly, a magical fairy appeared!
She could see that the little girl was very sad, so she gave her a big bowl of warm pasta.
The girl was so grateful, she stopped crying.
She ate the pasta and felt so much better.
After eating, the little girl gave the fairy a big hug and thanked her for helping her.
The fairy smiled and said, "You are very welcome", before flying away.
The little girl was so happy that she had her favorite food.
And from then on, she was never sad again.
Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy.
Timmy had a new eraser that he loved.
It was blue and shiny, and he used it to fix all his mistakes.
One day, Timmy's little sister came into his room and grabbed the eraser.
She didn't know it was fragile and it broke into tiny pieces.
Timmy was sad, but he knew he could trust his sister to make it better.
Timmy's sister went to their mom and told her what happened.
Their mom said she would try to fix the eraser, but it might not be the same.
Timmy trusted his mom to do her best.
A few days later, their mom gave Timmy a new eraser.
It wasn't the same as the old one, but it was just as good.
Timmy was happy and knew he could always trust his family to help him.
Once upon a time, in a modest pond, there lived a small fish named Fin.
Fin loved to swim all day with his friends.
They would play games and have fun together.
One day, a big bird came to the pond.
The bird was very hungry.
It saw Fin and his friends swimming and playing.
The bird watched them, waiting for the right time to catch one.
Fin's friends saw the bird and swam away to hide.
But Fin did not see the bird.
He kept swimming and playing, not knowing the danger.
The bird saw that Fin was alone and swooped down.
The bird caught Fin and flew away.
Fin's friends came out from their hiding spots and saw what had happened.
They all began to weep, for they knew they would never see their friend Fin again.
From that day on, the fish in the pond learned to be more careful and watch for danger.
They would always remember their friend Fin and the sad day when he was taken away.
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily.
She loved to play outside, but today the sun was too bright.
"Mommy, I need my sunglasses!" Lily said.
Her mom got her sunglasses and put them on her face.
"Now I can play!" Lily said with a smile.
Lily went to the park to play on the swings.
She saw a boy who looked grumpy.
"What's wrong?" Lily asked.
"I lost my favorite rock," the boy said.
Lily wanted to help.
She looked around and found a shiny rock.
"Here you go!" Lily said, giving the rock to the boy.
The boy smiled and said "Thank you!"  Lily kept playing and singing a song.
"Rock-a-bye baby, in the treetop," she sang.
The boy heard her and said "That's a nice song." Lily smiled and said "Thank you!
Want to swing with me?" The boy said yes and they swung together, happy and having fun.
One day, a small cat named Kitty went for a walk.
She saw a shower outside.
It was very big and shiny.
Kitty wanted to play in the water.
She jumped in and got all wet.
She was having lots of fun.
Kitty saw a big button near the shower.
It said "reverse".
She did not know what it meant.
Kitty was very curious.
She asked a bird, "What does 'reverse' mean?" The bird said, "I don't know, let's find out!" Kitty pushed the button.
The water started to go back up into the shower.
Kitty was scared.
She tried to get out, but the water pulled her up too.
The bird tried to help, but it was too late.
Kitty went up, up, up, and never came back down.
Today was a very ordinary day.
John wanted to go outside and play but his mom said no.
Instead, she wanted him to stay inside with her.
John was sad at first, but then he remembered that Mom always had a surprise.
She took out a yummy food and put it on the table.
It was a delicious apple pie!
John was so happy.
He asked his Mom if he could have some pie.
She said yes and he ate it with a big smile.
After eating the pie, John felt very happy and he and his Mom talked and laughed for a long time.
She gave him a big hug and the ordinary day ended with a smile.
Once upon a time there was a boy named Tom.
Tom was three years old and he liked to explore.
One day while Tom was exploring he heard a strange noise.
It was coming from the bushes nearby.
Tom was confused.
Tom slowly walked towards the bushes and peeked in.
To his surprise, he saw a little animal.
Tom was so excited.
"Hello!" Tom said.
The animal didn't answer.
It just stayed still and stared at Tom.
"Are you lost?" Tom asked.
The animal nodded in response.
"Welcome, friend!
I'm Tom.
I can help you find your way home," Tom said.
The animal happily jumped up and down.
Tom and the little animal walked around and looked for the animal's home.
Finally, they found it.
The animal's family welcomed it with hugs and kisses.
Tom said goodbye.
He watched the animal join its family and smiled.
Tom was so glad that he'd been able to help his new friend.
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sarah.
She was playing in the park on a cold day.
She saw something special on the ground.
It was a potato!
She happily picked it up and brought it home.
When she entered her house she was greeted by her mom.
"Where did you get the potato, Sarah?" her mom asked.
"I found it in the park," Sarah replied.
"It was all alone, so I brought it home." Her mom smiled and said, "Let's make it into a big, delicious meal!" So Sarah and her mom peeled the cold potato.
Then they chopped it into pieces and boiled it in a pot.
When the potato was done cooking, they enjoyed it with a big plate of vegetables.
It was the best meal ever!
One sunny day, Timmy and his mommy went outside to play on the lawn.
Timmy saw a tree and wanted to climb it.
"Mommy, can I climb the tree?" he asked.
"Sure, be careful," mommy replied.
Timmy started to climb the tree.
The bark was rough and scratchy on his hands and feet.
"This is hard," Timmy said.
"You can do it," mommy encouraged.
Finally, Timmy made it to the top of the tree.
"Look, mommy, I did it!" he shouted.
"You're a great climber," mommy said with a smile.
They both sat on a branch and enjoyed the view.
Charlie leaned high, up into the attic.
He climbed the ladder and felt the warm air.
It was an adventure!
Suddenly he smelled something funny.
It was coming from a box in the corner.
When he opened it, there was a lazy cat!
It was grey and sleepy and didn't move.
Charlie leaned in close and put out his hand.
The cat just yawned and stayed still.
Charlie thought it was sad and wanted to help it.
He tried to pick it up, but it was too heavy and he couldn't lift it.
Charlie got sad and leaned back against the wall.
He wanted the cat to be happy, but he just couldn't do it.
So he left the attic and went back downstairs, feeling very sad and wishing he could help the cat.
Once upon a time, there was a kitty cat who liked to rest.
Every day, she found a sunny spot and stretched out in the sun.
One day, she saw an open window and thought she'd like to rest there.
She poked her head through the window, and saw a nice, warm corner to curl up in.
The kitty cat was so happy!
She curled up in the corner and purred contentedly.
But then, a strong voice said, “No kitty!
That corner is not healthy.
You won’t rest there.” The kitty cat looked up, and saw the voice belonged to a man.
He smiled and said, “Why don’t you come outside, kitty?
There’s plenty of sunny spots to rest in the garden.” The kitty cat was so excited!
She followed the man outside and found the most perfect spot to rest in the sunshine.
She curled up, closed her eyes, and rested all day!
One day, a little girl named Anna wanted to mail a letter to her grandma.
She was grateful for the nice gift grandma sent her.
Anna put the letter in a box and went to the mail place.
On her way, she saw a big tree.
Anna knew this tree, but today there was something new.
She saw a little bird in a nest.
She thought, "I will come back to see the bird after I mail my letter." Anna went to the mail place and gave the letter to the mailman.
She was happy.
Anna went back to the big tree to see the bird.
The bird was still there.
The bird saw Anna and flew to her.
The bird had a letter, too!
It was a letter from grandma.
Anna was so grateful for the sight of the bird and the letter.
The bird helped Anna feel close to her grandma.
Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy.
Timmy loved animals and always wanted to see an ostrich.
One day, Timmy's mom took him to the zoo to see the ostrich.
Timmy was so excited and he kept asking his mom when they would see the ostrich.
After seeing the ostrich, Timmy and his mom went to a restaurant to eat.
Timmy's mom asked him what he wanted to eat and Timmy said he wanted to cook his own food.
His mom was surprised but happy to let him try.
They ordered a deep dish pizza and Timmy helped put the toppings on.
While they were waiting for the pizza to cook, Timmy's mom asked him what his favorite animal was.
Timmy said, "I like the ostrich because it has big feathers and runs really fast." His mom smiled and said, "I like the ostrich too.
It's a very interesting animal." Finally, the pizza was ready and Timmy and his mom enjoyed their delicious meal together.
Once upon a time, there were two friends, Bob and Sam.
They both liked to explore the world around them.
One day, they went on an adventure and stumbled across something very exciting - a fire!
They had never seen anything like it before and it was very beautiful.
Bob was very scared.
He had never seen a fire before and wasn't sure what to do.
But Sam was brave and walked towards it.
He bent down and put his hand out to see how hot it was.
It was warm, but not too hot.
Then he saw something - it was a box that belonged to someone!
Sam opened the box carefully and saw that it was full of different coloured things.
Some of them were shiny and some of them were sparkly - he had never seen anything like it before.
He called to Bob and Bob slowly came closer.
When he saw the box, he was no longer scared.
He saw how beautiful the things were and wanted to own some of them!
So they both grabbed what they could and put it in the box.
They were so happy that they ran back home.
They told everyone about their adventure and showed them what they had found in the fire.
It was the best thing that ever happened to them!
Once upon a time there was a little girl who dreamed of having a new toy.
Every day she would imagine what her new toy could be.
She imagined the toy being big and colorful.
One day she decided to tell her mom all about her dream.
She excitedly said "Mommy, can I get a new toy?" Her mom smiled and said "Of course you can!"  The next day they went to the toy store and the little girl was so happy.
She had never been to a toy store before!
She looked around and finally saw what she dreamed of: a brand new teddy bear!
She squeezed it tight and told her mom "This is the best toy ever!"  The little girl went home with her new teddy bear and hugged it all night.
She was so happy and thankful she had the chance to make her dream come true.
Once upon a time, in a big jungle, there was a lion who loved to roar.
One day, he found a big rock.
The lion wanted to show everyone how strong he was.
So, he tried to lift the rock with his mouth.
The rock was very heavy, but the lion did not give up.
He tried and tried, but the weight of the rock made him feel dizzy.
The lion's friend, the monkey, saw him trying to lift the rock.
The monkey knew that the lion was very strong, but he also knew that the rock was too heavy.
The monkey had an idea.
He told the lion to stand on the rock and roar as loud as he could.
The lion did what the monkey said.
He stood on the rock and roared very loud.
All the animals in the jungle heard the lion's big roar.
They came to see what was happening.
When they saw the lion standing on the rock, they knew he was very strong.
The lion was happy because he could show everyone how strong he was without lifting the heavy rock.
He thanked the monkey for his smart idea.
From that day on, the lion and the monkey were best friends.
And every time the lion roared, all the animals knew he was the strongest in the jungle.
Once upon a time, there was a farmer named John.
John had a big farm where he grew many things.
One day, John decided to grow some corn.
He dug holes in the ground and put the corn seeds inside.
After a few days, the corn started to grow.
It was so tall and green!
One day, John saw something unusual.
One of the corn plants had a red ear of corn!
John had never seen a red ear of corn before.
He was so surprised and happy.
He picked the red ear of corn and showed it to his family.
They were amazed too.
From that day on, John always tried to grow red corn.
He loved the way it looked and how it made him feel.
He knew that growing corn was hard work, but it was worth it when he saw the beautiful red corn growing in his fields.
Mama and baby bear were out on a search.
Mama bear was carrying a large basket in her hands.
Suddenly, she saw the most yummy honey in the beehive.
She could not believe her eyes; the honey was so delicious!
Mama bear was filled with excitement.
She looked at baby bear, who was still standing beside her, and exclaimed, "Look, baby bear!
We’ve found the most yummy honey!
We will have a feast tonight, I promise!" Baby bear smiled and danced around.
His little tummy was already rumbling with anticipation.
Mama bear carefully collected the honey with her basket and started for home.
As soon as she got home, she got to work, preparing a sweet treat for them with the yummy honey.
They both sat down to enjoy their treat.
Then, with satisfaction, Mama bear said, "We have been supplied with the most yummy honey ever!"  Baby bear smiled, content and happy.
Lily and Tom are friends.
They like to play with toys.
One day, they go to the store with Lily's mom.
The store has many toys.
Lily and Tom see a big box.
The box has a picture of a cell.
A cell is a thing that makes a phone work.
"Look, Tom, a cell!" Lily says.
"I want to see it." "Me too," Tom says.
They open the box.
Inside, there is a cell.
It is shiny and has many buttons.
Lily and Tom want to touch it.
"Can we play with it, mom?" Lily asks.
"No, Lily, that is not a toy.
That is a cell.
It is for grown-ups.
It is very expensive.
Put it back in the box," Lily's mom says.
But Lily and Tom do not listen.
They take the cell out of the box.
They press the buttons.
They make noises.
They think it is great.
"Beep, beep, beep!" Lily says.
"Hello, hello, hello!" Tom says.
They laugh.
They have fun.
They do not see the man who works at the store.
The man is angry.
He sees Lily and Tom with the cell.
He walks to them.
"Hey, you two, what are you doing?
That is not a toy.
That is a cell.
Give it to me.
Now!" the man says.
Lily and Tom are scared.
They drop the cell.
The cell falls on the floor.
It breaks.
It makes a loud sound.
Lily and Tom cry.
"I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I'm sorry!" Lily says.
"Me too, me too, me too!" Tom says.
Lily's mom runs to them.
She sees the cell.
She sees the man.
She sees Lily and Tom.
She is sad.
She is mad.
"Lily, Tom, what have you done?
That was a very bad thing to do.
You did not listen to me.
You did not listen to the man.
You broke the cell.
You have to say sorry to the man.
You have to pay for the cell.
You have to learn to be good," Lily's mom says.
Lily and Tom say sorry to the man.
They say sorry to Lily's mom.
They have no money to pay for the cell.
Lily's mom has to pay for the cell.
She has to pay a lot of money.
She has no money for toys.
Lily and Tom have no toys.
They are sad.
They are sorry.
They wish they had listened.
They wish they had not played with the cell.
They wish they had been good.
Maggie was a little girl who loved to play outside.
Today, she was trying to climb up a hill.
With each step, she struggled, but she kept going.
At the top of the hill was an enormous cone.
Maggie felt a little nervous, but she took a deep breath and started climbing up the cone.
Maggie was exhausted.
Halfway up the cone she stopped to catch her breath.
Suddenly she heard a voice calling her name.
It was her mom.
"Maggie!
Come down from there!
That cone is too high!
You don't need to struggle so much!" Maggie was relieved.
She carefully scrambled down the cone and scrambled back down the hill.
Her mom hugged her and said, "Let's go home and have an ice cream cone as a treat!" Maggie smiled and nodded excitedly.
After all her struggling, she was happy to do something easier.
Once upon a time, there was a little bird named Tweety.
Tweety lived in a tree with his family.
One day, Tweety saw a big bird flying high in the sky.
He said to his mom, "I want to become a big bird too!"  His mom said, "Tweety, you are perfect just the way you are.
You don't need to become anything else."  But Tweety didn't listen.
He tried to fly higher and higher every day to become a big bird.
One day, he flew too high and got trapped in a cage.
He was very grumpy and sad.
A little girl saw Tweety in the cage and felt sorry for him.
She opened the cage and let Tweety fly away.
Tweety learned that it's better to be happy with who you are than to try to become someone else.
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named June.
She loved to explore and find new things.
One day she went on a walk, and she found something special.
She found a model car!
It was so cool - it was bright red, and it even had wheels that spun.
June was so happy that she found her model car.
She showed it to her parents and thanked them for being so polite.
They told June to take good care of it, and to be careful.
June promised that she would.
Every morning, June would take out her model car, and admire it.
She liked to push it around the house, and pretend it was a real car.
She also liked to take it on her long walks.
June enjoyed having a model car to play with.
She was so excited to have a special toy to keep.
She was so grateful that her parents were so polite to let her have it.
Once upon a time, there were two friends, Jack and Jill.
They were playing together in the garden when Jack said: "Let's race, Jill!" Jill thought for a moment, "That's a good idea!" she said.
They ran as fast as they could around the garden, trying to race each other.
When they stopped, they saw an ordinary screen on the wall of the house.
"What is that?" asked Jill.
"It's a TV," said Jack.
"Shall we watch something together?" "Yes, let's!" she said.
They rushed over to the screen and started pressing the buttons until they found a cartoon that they liked.
They both laughed and cheered as they watched the show together, forgetting about their race.
John was a strong, brave boy.
He was always ready for adventures.
Today he put on his special vest for a very important adventure.
It was purple and sparkly and made him feel special.
John set off in search of the most difficult challenge he had ever faced!
He was so excited to see what lay ahead!
John was walking through the forest when he spotted something shining in the distance.
He quickened his pace, staring intently at the shiny object.
He arrived at a tall tree, with a silver-blue vest hanging from one branch.
It was beautiful and John wanted to take it home with him.
But he knew he had to face a difficult challenge to win the vest.
John stepped up to the tree and said "I am ready!
Tell me your challenge!" The tree answered in a low rumble.
"If you want to take the vest you must display incredible strength, tenacity, and courage!" John nervously grinned.
He was ready to prove he was strong enough.
He took a deep breath and started to climb the tree, using all his strength to reach the highest branch.
When he finally made it to the top, the vest was displayed before him.
He carefully grabbed the vest and placed it carefully in his backpack, feeling a sense of pride that he had passed the difficult challenge.
John knew he could face anything with his new vest.
He set off, ready
Once upon a time, there was a big volcano.
It was far away from a small town.
People in the town knew it was there, but they did not worry.
They played and had fun every day.
One day, a man came to the town.
He wore an expensive coat.
He told the people, "I can stop the volcano from making you shiver." The people did not understand, but they wanted to see what he could do.
The man went to the volcano and talked to it.
He said, "Please stop making the people shiver." The volcano listened and stopped being scary.
The people were happy and thanked the man.
They gave him a big party and everyone danced and laughed.
John loved to play in the pond.
Every day he splashed around, feeling the cool water and smiling at all the fish he could see.
John saw the shadow of a big bird fly past and he knew something special was about to happen.
He started to swim deeper into the pond and when he looked up, he saw a dragon!
John was so scared he forgot how to swim and he started to sink.
The dragon came closer and closer and John was too scared to move.
The dragon took one last deep breath and breathed fire over John.
He screamed, but it was too late.
Everything went dark and the dragon flew away.
The other children had seen what had happened and they were all in shock.
Nothing like this had ever happened before, it was definitely not normal.
The pond was quiet and dark now and nobody felt like splashing around anymore.
Once upon a time, there was a brave lion.
He had a big fierce roar that scared all the animals in the jungle.
One day, the lion's belt broke and he felt very sad.
He couldn't go out and play with his friends because his pants kept falling down.
So, the lion decided to go to the river to fill his belly with water.
He walked for a long time until he found a big river.
The lion drank lots of water until his belly was full.
While he was drinking, he saw a crocodile with a big belt around his waist.
The lion asked the crocodile where he got the belt from.
The crocodile told him that he found it in the river.
The lion was very happy and asked the crocodile if he could have the belt.
The crocodile said yes and gave the belt to the lion.
The lion put on the belt and it fit perfectly.
Now, he could go out and play with his friends again!
Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy.
He loved to go on tours with his mommy and daddy.
One day, they went on a tour to the zoo.
Timmy was so happy to see all the animals like the little monkeys and the big elephants.
While they were walking around, Timmy saw a little girl who was crying.
He went up to her and asked her why she was crying.
She said that she lost her mommy and daddy.
Timmy knew what it felt like to be lost, so he spoke to her and told her that he would help her find her parents.
They walked around the zoo together, looking for her parents.
Finally, they found them near the lion's cage.
The little girl was so happy to see her mommy and daddy again.
They thanked Timmy for helping their little girl and gave him a big hug.
The moral of the story is that it's important to help others when they are in need, even if they are little like Timmy.
Once upon a time, there was a big fish and a small fish.
They were good friends.
They lived near the shore, where the water met the land.
One day, they felt very sleepy.
They decided to find a quiet spot to rest.
As they swam, they saw a big rock near the shore.
The big fish said, "Let's go there and rest." The small fish agreed.
They swam to the rock and lay down.
They felt the warm sun on their scales.
While they were resting, they started to discuss their day.
The big fish said, "I had so much fun today.
We played and swam all day." The small fish replied, "Yes, it was a great day.
But now, I am very sleepy." They both yawned and closed their eyes.
Soon, they were fast asleep on the shore, dreaming of more fun days together.
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily.
One day, she went to play in the park with her friends.
They were running and laughing on the grass when Lily saw a butterfly.
She stopped and gazed at it, amazed by its beauty.
Her friends asked her to come and play, but Lily didn't want to leave the butterfly.
Suddenly, she heard someone laughing.
It was a boy from her class.
He was pointing at her and saying, "Look at Lily, she's just staring at a bug!" Lily felt embarrassed and didn't know what to do.
She wanted to run away and hide.
But then, her mom came and saw what was happening.
She told the boy that it's okay to look at nature and appreciate its beauty.
Lily felt better and learned that it's important to be true to yourself and not be ashamed of what you like.
One day, a girl named Sue went to the beach with her mom.
Sue loved the sand and the water.
She played with her toys and built a big sand castle.
The sun was warm, and the water was cool.
Sue was very happy.
While playing, Sue found a small, soft oyster.
She picked it up and showed it to her mom.
"Look, Mom, I found an oyster!" Sue said.
Her mom smiled and said, "That's a pretty oyster, Sue.
Maybe there's a surprise inside.
Let's open it later." Sue put the oyster in her bag and played some more.
She swam in the water and played with her friends.
The sun began to go down, and it was time to go home.
Sue was excited to see what was inside the oyster.
At home, Sue and her mom opened the oyster.
Inside, they found a shiny pearl.
Sue's eyes lit up with joy.
"Wow, Mom, look!
We found a pearl!" Her mom said, "That's a beautiful pearl, Sue.
It's a special surprise from the oyster." Sue put the pearl in a small box and kept it in her room.
Every day, she looked at the pearl and remembered the fun day at the beach with her mom.
The pearl made her very happy, and she knew that the oyster had given her a special gift.
Once upon a time there was a fierce dragon.
He lived in the mountains and liked to sleep all day.
He had no food to eat and was very hungry.
One day a food supply was left near the dragon's cave.
The dragon was very pleased to see the food!
He gobbled it up quickly.
The food was so tasty that the dragon wanted more.
He looked around and found another food supply in a nearby village.
That night he flew to the village.
The people in the village were afraid of the fierce dragon.
He swooped down and grabbed the food supply, then flew back to his cave.
The dragon was now full and happy.
He kept eating the food supplies until they were all gone.
He was never hungry again.
The people in the village were happy too, as they were no longer scared of the fierce dragon.
Once upon a time there was a kid who loved adventures.
He never stayed still.
One day he decided to kick his heels and jump around.
He loved kicking his heels and feeling the wind.
He jumped higher and higher.
He felt so alive and free.
He was having the greatest adventure ever.
After a while he realized he should slow down.
He had been kicking his heels for a long time.
He was getting tired but he had a big smile on his face.
He was so happy about his adventurous day!
He started walking back home.
He got to the door and he kicked his heels one last time.
He jumped up and said: "Adventure time is over".
And he went to bed with a dream of having more adventures.
Once upon a time, there was a blue bird who lived in a tree.
One day, the bird saw a nut on the ground and wanted to eat it.
But the nut was too big to fit in the bird's beak.
The bird tried to break the nut with its beak, but it didn't work.
Then, the bird saw a knob on the tree and thought it could use it to break the nut.
The bird flew to the knob and tried to split the nut with it.
After a few tries, the nut split into two pieces!
The bird was so happy and ate the nut.
From that day on, the bird always looked for knobs to help it split nuts.
And every time it split a nut, it felt proud of itself.
The end.
Once upon a time, a little girl named Lily went to the zoo with her mommy.
They saw many animals like big lions, tall giraffes, and funny monkeys.
Lily was very happy and excited to see all her favorite animals.
After walking around the zoo, Lily and her mommy felt hungry.
They went to a small shop where they could bake tasty cookies.
Lily put on a little apron and helped her mommy mix the dough.
They made the cookies in the shape of the animals they saw at the zoo.
When the cookies were ready, Lily and her mommy ate the tasty treats.
They laughed and talked about all the fun they had at the zoo.
It was a very special day for both of them, and they couldn't wait to come back to the zoo again.
Once upon a time there was a little girl named Anya.
She was very polite and loved to skip around her house.
One day, Anya stepped outside of her house and she noticed something on the side of her house.
It was a small, friendly bunny!
Anya smiled and said hello to the bunny, and the bunny looked up at Anya and said, "Hi Anya!"  Anya was so excited to meet the bunny that she started skipping around the yard.
The bunny hopped around too and the two playmates soon became friends.
Anya was so polite to the bunny.
She always said hello and goodbye when she saw the bunny, and she always shared her vegetable treats with him.
They had lots of fun playing together everyday.
Anya and the bunny always skip around the side of the house together.
The bunny felt so lucky to have Anya as a friend.
There was a poor pupil.
He was always leaning over his books.
He was determined to learn everything he could.
But he was always tired and didn't understand very much.
One day, a wise old man saw the pupil and took pity on him.
He saw how tired the boy was and decided to help.
The man leaned over and gently whispered something into the pupil's ear.
Suddenly, the pupil's eyes lit up and he stood up straight.
From then on, the pupil wasn't poor anymore.
He understood his lessons and was always eager to learn more.
With the old man's help, the pupil became the smartest in his class.
Everyone marveled at how he knew so much!
Once upon a time, there was a goat.
The goat had a horn on its head.
The horn was very big and pointy.
All the other animals thought the goat was popular because of its big horn.
One day, the goat wanted to organize a party.
It wanted to invite all the animals in the forest.
The goat went around and told everyone about the party.
The animals were excited to come to the party.
The goat decorated the forest with balloons and streamers.
When the party started, everyone had a lot of fun.
They danced and played games.
The goat was happy that it could organize such a great party with its big horn.
Lily and Ben were playing in the park.
They liked to climb the big slide and go down fast.
Lily was brave and went first.
Ben followed her, but he was a bit scared.
"Look, Lily, there is a dog!" Ben said, pointing to a big, black dog that was running towards them.
Lily saw the dog and felt afraid.
She did not like dogs.
They were loud and had sharp teeth.
She grabbed Ben's hand and ran to the slide.
"Let's go up the slide and hide!" she said.
"The dog can't climb the slide.
He can't get us there." They ran up the steps of the slide and sat at the top.
The dog barked and jumped, but he could not reach them.
Lily and Ben hugged each other and waited for the dog to go away.
"Are you okay, Ben?" Lily asked.
"I'm okay, Lily.
You are very brave.
You protected me from the dog," Ben said.
"Thank you, Ben.
You are very charming.
You made me feel better," Lily said.
They smiled and looked at the park.
They saw a man coming with a leash.
He called the dog and put the leash on him.
He said sorry to Lily and Ben and walked away with the dog.
Lily and Ben felt safe again.
They decided to go down the slide and play some more.
They had fun in the park.
They were good friends.
"Please, please come out," shouted the little girl.
She wanted to see the reindeer so badly!
Suddenly, it started to rain and the girl got so wet.
She started to cry.
"Don't worry," said her mom.
"Let's go home and then the reindeers will come visit us!"  The girl was very excited and couldn't wait to get home.
But when they got home, the girl saw something outside the window.
The reindeer were in the rain, wet and shivering.
The girl was so sad.
She wanted to help the reindeer but she was too small.
She started to cry and said, "Please, please don't be wet."  But there was nothing she could do and the reindeers stayed out in the rain until morning.
The girl never saw them again and she was very sad.
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily.
One day, Lily's mom made her a peanut butter and jam sandwich for lunch.
Lily loved the sandwich, but she got some jam on her shirt.
Lily's mom said, "Oh no, Lily!
You got jam on your shirt.
We need to change it." Lily replied, "I understand, Mommy.
I'm sorry I was naughty and got jam on my shirt."  Lily and her mom went to her room to change her shirt.
They picked out a pretty pink one and Lily felt much better.
From that day on, Lily made sure to eat her sandwich carefully so she wouldn't get jam on her clothes again.
Once upon a time, in a small house, there lived a little cat named Lucy.
Lucy loved to play with her soft red ball.
She would lift the ball with her paw and chase it all around the house.
She was a very happy cat.
One day, Lucy's ball rolled under a big chair.
Lucy tried to get her ball, but her ear got stuck.
She was very upset.
She cried and cried, hoping someone would hear her and help her.
Then, Lucy's friend, a kind dog named Max, heard her cries.
Max came running to help Lucy.
He used his strong nose to lift the big chair.
Lucy's ear was free, and she got her ball back.
Lucy and Max were so happy.
They played with the red ball together, and they were the best of friends.
Tom and Lily were best friends.
They liked to play in the park and look for treasure.
Sometimes they found shiny stones, pretty feathers, or colorful leaves.
They put them in a big box and called it their treasure chest.
One day, they saw something very impressive in the park.
It was a big balloon with many colors.
It was flying in the sky and had a basket with people inside.
Tom and Lily waved at them and shouted hello.
"Wow, look at that balloon!" Tom said.
"It is so big and bright.
I wish we could fly in it." "Me too," Lily said.
"Maybe we can find a balloon treasure in the park.
Let's go and look." They ran around the park, searching for anything that looked like a balloon.
They did not find any, but they had fun anyway.
They climbed on the slide, swung on the swings, and rolled on the grass.
They were very happy and tired.
They sat down on a bench and opened their treasure chest.
They looked at their shiny stones, pretty feathers, and colorful leaves.
They smiled at each other.
"You are my best friend, Lily," Tom said.
"You make me happy." "You are my best friend, Tom," Lily said.
"You make me happy too." They hugged each other and gave each other a kiss on the cheek.
They did not know what a kiss meant, but they felt warm and fuzzy inside.
They decided that a kiss was a very nice treasure.
They closed their treasure chest and went home, holding hands.
John was three years old and he loved playing on the lawn.
Every day he would spend hours making up games and playing with all of his toys.
One day, it started to rain and John moved inside.
But then something very strange caught his eye.
He saw something strike the lawn!
He had never seen anything like it before, it was totally unknown to him.
He ran outside to take a closer look and saw the most amazing thing.
It was some kind of creature, with green wings and a long tail.
John was so excited and he spent the entire afternoon watching the mysterious creature strike around the lawn.
Eventually, it flew away and he never saw it again.
But John never forgot the experience and every time he visited his lawn, he was always looking for the unknown creature to return.
Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim.
He had a toy called Laser.
Laser was a fake robot, but Tim loved to play with him all day.
One day, Tim lost Laser.
He looked everywhere, but he could not find him.
Tim was very sad and began to cry.
His mom saw him crying and asked what was wrong.
Tim told her that he lost Laser.
Mom helped Tim look for Laser.
They looked under the bed, behind the couch, and in the toy box.
Finally, they found Laser in the yard.
Tim was so happy, he stopped crying.
He hugged Laser and played with him for the rest of the day.
One day, two little girls were at the park.
They were both very excited to see the swans swimming in the icy water.
They were both full of energy and wanted to go near the swans but their mum warned them to stay back.
The two girls slowly stepped closer and closer to the edge of the pond.
Then they saw a little baby swan all alone.
Its mommy and daddy had gone away and it looked so sad.
The two girls wanted to help the little baby swan.
So they used the bread from the picnic basket to support him.
They carefully threw the pieces towards the icy water, and the little swan was so excited.
The two girls smiled and felt proud that they had been able to support their little baby swan.
They waved goodbye as the little swan happily found his family.
Once upon a time, there was a clever snowman named Frosty.
Frosty loved to play in the winter with his friends.
He was very intelligent and always had good ideas for games to play.
One day, Frosty and his friends decided to have a snowball fight.
They all made snowballs and began to throw them at each other.
Frosty was very good at dodging the snowballs and he even displayed some fancy moves to avoid getting hit.
After the snowball fight, Frosty and his friends built a fort out of snow.
They used big blocks of snow to make the walls and decorated it with icicles.
It was a beautiful display of their creativity.
As the sun began to set, Frosty and his friends said goodbye and went home.
Frosty was happy because he had so much fun with his friends.
He couldn't wait for the next winter adventure.
Ben and Lily were playing in the park.
They liked to climb the big tree and sit on the branch.
They could see the pond and the ducks from there.
"Look, Lily, the ducks are diving in the water!" Ben said.
"They go under and then come up again.
They look so funny!" "I want to dive too!" Lily said.
"Can we dive from the branch?" Ben shook his head.
"No, Lily, that is not a good idea.
The water is too deep and too cold.
And we don't have wings like the ducks.
We could get hurt." Lily pouted.
"But I want to have fun like the ducks.
You are no fun, Ben.
You are too serious." Ben felt sad.
He wanted Lily to be happy, but he also wanted her to be safe.
He thought of a way to make her smile.
"OK, Lily, how about this?
We can pretend to dive from the branch.
We can make a big splash sound and then say 'quack, quack'.
But we don't really jump, we just stay on the branch.
Is that fun?" Lily nodded.
She liked to pretend.
She and Ben leaned over the branch and made diving noises.
They laughed and said 'quack, quack'.
They had fun like the ducks, but they were safe on the branch.
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Molly who was very excited.
She was getting a new crib for her bedroom.
She had kept it a secret from her mom, but she could not contain her joy.
That day, her mom took her to a store that had lots of cribs.
Molly wanted to pick one out for herself.
She gasped when she saw one with a canopy.
It was pink, her favorite color.
She knew it was the one for her.
Back at home, it was time to put the crib together.
Her mom was busy trying to make sure everything fit together properly.
Molly was eagerly waiting for the crib to be done.
She was really excited!
All of a sudden, they heard a squeaking noise.
It was Molly's brand new crib!
They both smiled.
Finally, Molly's room was ready and she couldn't wait to go to sleep.
She grabbed her stuffed bear, climbed in and tucked herself in.
Molly hoped that she would sleep well in her new crib.
Billy was so excited - today he was going to learn how to read!
He had a big book with pictures that were bright and colourful.
He looked at them and knew he was going to love it.
His teacher said he was a very fair reader and that made him feel proud.
After reading, he had a shower.
He loved the feeling of the warm water running down his body, and the soap bubbles smelling so nice.
It was the perfect way to end the day.
When Billy was in the shower, he thought about the book and what he had learnt.
He was sure he had learnt lots of new words and was looking forward to reading them all over again.
Billy finished his shower and dried himself off.
He couldn't wait to get back to the book and read some more.
His teacher had said that he was a very fair reader, and Billy was determined to prove it!
Once upon a time there was a little girl named Mary.
Mary was very fancy.
She had a pretty dress and fancy shoes.
On one hot day, Mary was playing in her backyard.
Suddenly, she saw a mosquito.
Mary stopped playing and began to stare.
At first, she was scared of the tiny insect.
But then, she realized the mosquito wasn't trying to hurt her.
Mary watched the mosquito fly around her garden.
She decided to follow it around, watching it carefully.
After a while, Mary became quite impressed with the fancy moves the mosquito was making.
She was amazed by the way it could fly so quickly and gracefully around her flowers and trees.
Mary and the mosquito kept playing together until it was time to go inside.
Mary went in with a big smile on her face, proud of the time spent with her new fancy friend.
Once upon a time, there was a little puppy named Spot.
Spot loved to play and chase his tail.
One day, Spot went for a walk with his owner, Sarah.
Sarah let Spot off his leash so he could run and play.
Spot was having so much fun that he didn't notice when Sarah started to leave.
"Spot, come on!
We have to go home now," Sarah called.
Spot didn't want to leave yet, but he knew he had to go with Sarah.
He wagged his tail happily and followed her home.
When they got home, Sarah gave Spot a treat.
Spot was so grateful that he licked Sarah's face.
"Thank you for the treat!" Spot barked happily.
Sarah smiled and scratched Spot's tail.
"You're welcome, Spot.
I'm grateful to have you as my puppy."
Once there was a boy named Bob who wanted to do something fun.
He had some toys, but he was looking for something special.
One day, he had an idea!
He wanted to find a cooler.
His mom said he could count down from ten and then it might appear.
He counted down from ten and waited.
Bob saw a cooler nearby and ran over to it.
The cooler was full of ice and was wet from the rain.
Bob was excited!
He opened the cooler and discovered lots of cold drinks and snacks inside.
Bob had a great time and made sure he counted all the snacks in the cooler.
With his cooler and ice, he could now do something special and fun all day long!
Once there was a zebra.
She was so excited to explore the world around her.
She started to explore and spread out across the vast land.
Everywhere she went, she saw all kinds of interesting things and creatures.
One day, she met a friendly hippo.
They got to talking, and the zebra told the hippo about her exciting journey.
The hippo was so excited that he decided to go explore with the zebra.
So, the two friends spread out further together.
They spread across the grassy land, the river, and the dry desert.
They saw so many new things together.
At the end of the day, the zebra and the hippo were so excited about all the adventures they had.
They said goodbye to one another and promised to spread out together again soon!
Once upon a time, there was a kid named Timmy.
Timmy loved to play outside in the snow.
One day, Timmy was playing with his friends when he heard his mom calling him for dinner.
Timmy didn't want to stop playing, but he knew he had to go inside.
As he was walking home, Timmy saw a bird sitting on a branch.
The bird looked cold and Timmy felt guilty for playing while the bird was freezing.
So, he went inside and got some bread to feed the bird.
The bird ate the bread and flew away, happy and warm.
Timmy felt happy too, knowing that he had helped the bird.
He went inside to have dinner with his family, feeling proud of himself for being a kind kid.
Lily and Tom were twins who liked to play with their toys.
They had many toys, but their favorite was a big train set that their dad gave them.
They liked to make the train go around the tracks and make noises.
One day, their mom said she had to go to the post office to send some letters.
She asked Lily and Tom to be good and not spoil anything while she was gone.
She said she would be back soon.
Lily and Tom said they would be good and waved goodbye to their mom.
They decided to play with the train set again.
But Tom had an idea.
He wanted to make the train go faster and faster.
He turned the knob on the controller hard and the train zoomed around the tracks.
"Look, Lily, how fast the train is!" Tom said.
But Lily did not like Tom's idea.
She thought the train was going too fast and it would crash.
She tried to stop Tom from turning the knob, but he pushed her away.
"Stop, Tom, you will spoil the train!" Lily said.
But Tom did not stop.
He turned the knob harder and harder.
The train went faster and faster.
Then, it happened.
The train jumped off the tracks and hit the wall.
It broke into pieces.
Lily and Tom gasped.
"Oh no, Tom, you spoiled the train!" Lily cried.
Tom felt bad.
He spoiled the train and made Lily cry.
He wished he had listened to Lily and not turned the knob so hard.
He said he was sorry and hugged Lily.
"I'm sorry, Lily, I spoiled the train.
I was silly.
Can you forgive me?" Tom said.
Lily was sad, but she loved Tom.
She forgave him and hugged him back.
"I forgive you, Tom, but don't do that again.
We have to be careful with our toys.
They are not hard like the wall.
They can break." Lily said.
Tom nodded.
He learned his lesson.
He and Lily picked up the pieces of the train and hoped their dad could fix it.
They waited for their mom to come back from the post office.
They hoped she would not be mad at them for spoiling the train.
Once upon a time, there was a girl called Lucy.
She was very excited to receive a present from her mum.
When she opened the present, she saw a little stair.
It was blue and shiny and sparkly.
She wanted to try it out straight away.
She ran to the garden and put it down on the grass.
Lucy began to climb the stair, step by step.
She felt peace with every step she took.
She made it to the top and felt very proud.
From the top of the stairs, she could see her house and all the beautiful flowers in her garden.
She felt happy and peaceful.
The next day, Lucy brought the stair inside the house.
She shared it with her brothers and they all had a lot of fun.
They climbed the stairs up and down, up and down.
Lucy and her brothers all agreed that the new stair was the best present ever.
They had happy and peaceful times together, playing and exploring.
The sun was shining brightly as the little boy and his dad set off on a special journey.
The boy was very excited, skipping happily down the road.
His Dad smiled, trying not to show just how heavy the load he was carrying was.
"What are you carrying Dad?" asked the boy.
His dad smiled and said "It's a surprise.
I'm going to fill something up when we get there." The boy's eyes lit up.
"What are we going to fill up Dad?" he asked excitedly.
"You'll have to wait and see," replied his Dad with a sly smile.
The boy seemed content with that answer and the two carried on their journey.
When they arrived, the boy saw an old swimming pool.
"Dad, it looks all empty!" the boy said.
"That's because it is," replied his Dad.
"Let's get to work and fill it up!" So the Dad and his son set about filling up the pool with water.
It was a long and difficult journey, but eventually they were able to fill it.
When they were finished, they both stood back and admired their work.
"It looks great, Dad" said the boy, beaming.
His Dad smiled and put his arm around him.
"It sure does.
I think this was an adventure well worth taking."
Once upon a time, there was a mommy and a little boy.
The mommy was cooking in the kitchen.
She was making something spicy.
The little boy wanted to help, but he was too small.
Suddenly, the little boy sneezed!
The mommy laughed and said, "Bless you!" The little boy smiled and felt happy.
Mommy and Daddy wanted to buy a mattress.
It was silly how many mattresses were in the store!
Mommy and Daddy looked at all the mattresses.
They wanted to find the best one.
Finally, Mommy and Daddy chose a soft, warm mattress.
It was so perfect!
They bought the mattress and stowed it in the car.
But when they got home, they realized the mattress was too big to fit in the bedroom!
So they stowed it in the living room and used it to sleep on.
Mommy and Daddy had lots of fun while they slept on the silly mattress.
In the mornings, they made funny shapes out of the mattress and pretended the living room was a jungle.
Mommy and Daddy always enjoy silly mattress days!
Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tom.
He loved cocoa.
One day, he wanted to make cocoa fast.
So, he ran to the kitchen and asked his mom, "Can we make cocoa fast, please?" His mom said, "Yes, Tom!
Let's make cocoa together." They took out milk, cocoa powder, and a pot.
They mixed the milk and cocoa powder in the pot.
Tom was so excited, he wanted to make the cocoa faster.
But his mom said, "Tom, we can't spoil the cocoa.
We have to cook it slow and careful." Tom listened and they cooked the cocoa together.
When it was done, they poured it into cups and enjoyed their yummy cocoa.
Once upon a time, there was a big garden.
In the garden, there was a tall plant with a yellow flower.
It was called a sunflower.
The sunflower was very happy because it loved to feel the sun on its face.
But one day, a little girl came to the garden.
She was frustrated because she wanted to pick the sunflower.
The sunflower said, "Please don't pick me.
I want to stay here and grow big and strong." The little girl understood and allowed the sunflower to stay in the garden.
From that day on, the sunflower grew bigger and bigger.
It was so tall that it could see over the garden fence.
The little girl was happy to see the sunflower every time she came to the garden.
And the sunflower was happy to be allowed to stay and grow.
The sky was very dark.
Big clouds came rolling in and made the sky even darker.
Suddenly, without warning, it started to rain.
The rain came down in big heavy drops.
Tommy was outside playing in his backyard with his friends.
He felt the rain on his face and ran towards his house.
He was excited; he had never seen rain before!
He ran inside to his mum and dad and asked them what was happening.
They smiled and said it was raining.
Tommy asked what was making it rain but his parents just laughed.
They told Tommy to go outside and take a look.
He went out in his pyjamas, feeling the rain on his face.
Then he saw it - a hose!
It was spraying out water quickly and loudly, making the air lively and wet.
Tommy laughed as the hose sprayed the rain around.
He felt so excited, as if he were playing in the rain for the very first time!
Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tom.
Tom had a special belt that he loved to wear.
One day, he could not find his belt and felt very sad.
Tom was so happy, and his mom gave him a big hug.
From that day on, Tom always remembered to keep his belt in a safe place.
Once upon a time, there were two friends, John and Jack.
John was always fit and active while Jack was always lazy and he rarely did anything.
One day, John was playing outside and he heard that the weather was going to be very nice in the afternoon.
He was so excited and he ran to Jack’s house and told him about the nice weather.
John asked Jack, “Want to go out and have some fun?
The weather is perfect!” But Jack just said, “Nah, I don’t feel like it.
Maybe tomorrow.” So John ran off to play and have fun.
Jack stayed inside, doing nothing.
Sometimes when you wait, you miss out on a lot of things.” Moral of the story: always make the best of a nice day!
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily.
She loved to perform for her family and friends.
One day, Lily's tooth started to hurt.
She didn't want to tell her parents because she was scared of going to the dentist.
One day, Lily's friend asked her how she was feeling.
Lily said, "My tooth hurts, but I don't want to go to the dentist." Her friend said, "It's important to take care of your teeth, so they stay perfect.
You should tell your parents." Lily listened to her friend and told her parents.
They took her to the dentist, and the dentist fixed her tooth.
Lily was happy and thanked her friend for the advice.
The moral of the story is that it's important to take care of your teeth, even if it's scary.
Once upon a time there was a young girl called Rosa.
Every day, she loved to mail her letters to her friends.
One day, Rosa wanted to mail a very special letter.
But when she arrived at the post office, it was closed.
She was so upset!
Just then, her friend Bob arrived with a brilliant idea.
He said that he could help her by putting the letter down the sink!
Rosa thought it was a good idea, so she thanked Bob and carefully put the letter down the sink.
The next day, they waited and waited.
But the letter never came out of the sink.
Rosa was so angry!
She thought Bob was being selfish, putting her letter in the sink on purpose.
But then, suddenly, the sink made a loud noise and the letter popped out!
Rosa was so happy.
She hugged Bob and thanked him for his help.
From then on, she never forgot to thank Bob for being so kind.
Lila and Ben were friends who liked to play with toys.
Lila had a doll that she loved very much.
Ben had a car that he liked to zoom around.
One day, they decided to trade their toys for a while.
Lila gave Ben her doll and Ben gave Lila his car.
They had fun with their new toys, but soon they missed their old ones.
Lila wanted to hug her doll and Ben wanted to race his car.
They felt sad and wished they had not traded.
They looked for each other, but they could not find each other.
They had gone to different places to play.
Then, they heard some music.
It was coming from the park.
They followed the sound and saw a clown.
The clown was performing for a crowd of children.
He was making funny jokes and tricks.
He had a big red nose and a colorful hat.
Lila and Ben smiled and joined the crowd.
The clown saw them and asked them if they wanted to help him.
He said he needed a doll and a car for his next trick.
Lila and Ben looked at each other and nodded.
They gave him their toys and went to the stage.
The clown thanked them and said they were very thoughtful.
He did a magic trick with their toys.
