The crane wanted to show the butterfly its bow, so it flapped its wings and flew over to the butterfly.
The butterfly thought the crane's bow was very weird, but also very cool.
The crane was happy that the butterfly liked its bow.
From then on, the crane and the butterfly became good friends and would often show off their bows to each other.
The end.
Once upon a time, there was a long journey over a big hill.
On the other side of the hill, Lucy and her mommy saw a big, exciting surprise!
It was a sparkling diamond!
Lucy said, "Mommy, what is it?" Mommy smiled and said, "It's a diamond!" Lucy was very happy and wanted to pick it up.
But Mommy said, "No, it's best to leave it here and not touch it.
We don't know where this diamond came from and we don't want to take it away from someone else."  So they kept walking but looked back to see if they could tell where the diamond came from.
Then, from far away, they heard someone shouting, "My diamond!
I've been looking for it for a long time!" They looked back and saw a woman on top of the hill, waving her hands.
The woman was very happy as she had finally found her diamond.
Mommy smiled at Lucy and said, "See, I told you not to take it away from someone else.
This diamond belongs to that woman and we should not take it from her."  Lucy learned an important lesson from this experience.
She understood that it is not nice to take something that belongs to someone else without asking.
We should always respect other people's property and reveal where it came from.
Once there was a smelly butter.
It was so smelly that everyone around it said "yuck"!
Poor butter.
It felt so sad.
It wanted to be like all the other butter.
One day the butter was so sad it started to cry.
It cried and cried until it made a big pool of water around it.
Then suddenly the sun came out from behind the clouds.
It felt really warm and made the butter happy.
The water around it started to boil and the smell of the butter changed from smelly to sweet.
Everyone breathed a sigh of relief.
The butter was happy and excited.
It had a new smell!
It was a happy end for the smelly butter.
Once upon a time, there was a small bird named Billy.
Billy loved to sing.
Every day, he would sing happy songs in the trees.
One day, Billy saw a camp in the woods.
There were kids playing and laughing.
Billy flew down to the camp and started to sing.
The kids heard Billy's song and smiled.
One little girl named Amy said, "I like your song, Billy!" Billy felt very happy and sang even louder.
As the sun went down, the kids and Billy sat by the campfire.
They all sang songs together.
Billy made many new friends at the camp.
They all had a great time, and Billy knew he would always remember the fun he had with his new friends.
Once upon a time, there was a little boy who was very curious.
He loved exploring and discovering new things.
One day, he decided to go for a walk in the forest.
He had no idea what he would find.
After exploring for a while, he heard a gentle humming sound.
He followed the noise and discovered a beautiful, humble little fox.
He was very surprised to see such a pretty creature.
He said to the fox, "Hello.
Can I stroke your hair?" The fox said, "Sure!
I like it when people give me a nice stroke on my warm fur".
So the little boy carefully stroked the fox's furry hair.
He was so happy to have discovered such a beautiful and humble creature in the forest.
Once upon a time, there was a big elephant named Ella.
Ella lived in a distant land with many trees.
She loved to play with her friends.
One sunny day, Ella and her friend, a small bird named Billy, found a swing.
They wanted to play on the swing together.
Ella said, "Let's swing, Billy!" Billy was very happy and said, "Yes, Ella!
Let's swing!" Ella and Billy took turns on the swing.
Ella pushed Billy high in the air.
Billy flew up and down, laughing.
Then, it was Ella's turn.
Billy pushed Ella the best he could.
Ella swung back and forth, her big ears flapping in the wind.
They played on the swing all day, and they were very happy.
Mum and Dad were getting ready for work.
Dad put on his smart shirt and grabbed his keys.
Mum put on her shoes and grabbed her bag.
They both went downstairs.
In the kitchen, Dad filled the coffee pot with hot water.
He then poured the coffee into it.
Mum switched on the machine and it started to make a noisy noise!
Dad pored the hot, strong coffee into two cups.
The smell of coffee was filling the kitchen.
Then they both put some milk and sugar into their coffee.
Mum and Dad smiled at each other as they both enjoyed their coffee.
They said goodbye and left for work.
Once upon a time there were two best friends, Jack and Jill.
They were always together and had lots of fun.
One day, Jack and Jill decided to do something special.
They wanted to unite and be really creative.
They got all of their craft supplies and started thinking.
Jill had a great idea - they could make a picture and hang it on the wall.
Jack loved the idea and they happily got to work.
They used bright colours and lots of glue to create the picture and soon it was done.
The picture was a sight to behold!
It was of a rainbow and sunshine, with daisies in the grass.
Jack and Jill were so proud of their work and could not believe that they had made it.
They held hands in front of the picture and knew that together, they could do anything!
Once upon a time, there was a chubby bunny named Benny.
Benny loved to eat carrots and play in the fields.
One day, Benny saw a beautiful flower and wanted to pick it.
But his mommy told him that he shouldn't pick the flower because it was not nice to take things that didn't belong to him.
Benny didn't listen to his mommy and picked the flower anyway.
Later that day, Benny's friend asked him where the flower came from.
Benny felt sad and realized that he had made a mistake.
He missed the flower and wished he could put it back where it belonged.
Benny learned that it was important to listen to his mommy and not take things that didn't belong to him.
From that day on, he promised to be a good bunny and never take anything without permission.
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily.
She loved the color pink and had a pink dress that she wore all the time.
One day, Lily went to the park to play.
She saw a boy who didn't have any friends to play with.
Lily knew it wasn't kind to leave someone alone, so she went over to him and asked if he wanted to play with her.
The boy was happy and they played together for a while.
Lily noticed that the boy's shirt was also pink, just like her dress!
She thought it was funny and they laughed together.
After a while, it was time for Lily to go home.
She said goodbye to the boy and gave him a big hug.
Lily was happy that she could be kind to someone who needed a friend.
She skipped all the way home, thinking about her new friend and how they both liked the color pink.
It was a wonderful day at the park!
Once upon a time there was a powerful man.
He had a special treasure.
He wanted to protect it very much.
He built a strong box and put it inside.
Every day he chose the best locks to keep it safe.
One day, a dragon flew by and saw the treasure.
He wanted it very much and looked for ways to get it.
He tried to break the locks, but they held strong.
He then tried to dig through the ground, but it was too strong.
So the dragon went away and he never came back.
The man kept protecting his treasure so that no one else would ever get it.
To this day, it's still safe in the special box.
Once upon a time, there was a mild hero.
He slept soundly through the night, but in the morning he woke.
He jumped out of bed and put on his cape.
Then, he grabbed his sword and shield, ready for adventure.
He went outside and looked around.
It was a beautiful day - the sun was shining, and the birds were singing.
He felt brave and strong.
He followed a path that led to a castle.
There, it seemed the King and Queen were in trouble.
The hero decided to save them!
He fought off the villains, with the help of his sword and shield.
In the end he had been victorious and saved the King and Queen - and even the castle!
The King and Queen thanked him.
Everyone cheered and celebrated the hero's victory - it was a happiest day ever!
Once upon a time, there was a generous family.
They had a tall tree in their garden and they loved the windy days that blew around it.
One day, the wind was especially strong and it made the branches of the tree turn in all kinds of directions.
The family watched in delight, feeling as though the wind was giving them a big hug!
The family embraced the windy days and every time the wind blew, their tree would turn and wave at them.
They felt so happy, their hearts filled with joy.
The generous family thanked the wind for its beautiful gift and the wind seemed to smile back.
The family enjoyed their windy days so much that they moved the tree to the front of the house so they could see it turn even more.
What a generous family!
They were always grateful for the gifts the wind gave them!
Once there was a man who had a hammer.
He was always using his hammer to fix things around the house.
One day, he wanted to fix the sink, but his wife disagreed.
"But it needs to be done," said the man.
"It's ok, we can live with the messed up sink," replied the wife.
The man was feeling very helpless.
He didn't know what to do and he really wanted to fix it.
So he asked his daughter for help.
"If mommy won't let you use your hammer, what should you do?" asked the daughter.
The man thought for a moment and then said, "I guess I will just have to fix it another way." The daughter smiled at her dad and said, "There, now you don't have to disagree with mommy!"
Once upon a time, there was a lazy mint.
She liked to lay around and do nothing all day.
She lived in a meadow filled with yummy treats and sunny skies.
One day, the mint heard about a magical machine that would make her something special.
She got up from her sunny spot and hopped over to the machine.
She put in coins and pushed the buttons.
There was a loud humming noise and then out came a yummy green minty treat!
The lazy mint was so happy and ate it all up.
It was delicious!
From that day on, she used the magical machine every day to make her special mint treats.
The end.
Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy.
Timmy loved to play in the park, but he was always in a hurry.
He would run around so fast that he would sometimes bump into other kids and make them cry.
One day, Timmy saw a shiny gold necklace on the ground.
He picked it up and thought it was so pretty that he wanted to keep it for himself.
But he knew that it wasn't his, and that it belonged to someone else.
So, he decided to ask around and see if anyone had lost it.
After asking many people, Timmy finally found the owner of the necklace.
The owner was so happy to have it back, and thanked Timmy for being honest.
Timmy felt good inside, knowing that he did the right thing and didn't steal the gold necklace.
The moral of the story is that it's always better to be slow and honest, than to be fast and steal.
Once there was a little girl who wanted to practice balancing.
She thought it would be fun.
She tried to balance on one foot while her other foot was in the air.
It was tough, but she kept trying.
With lots of practice, she started to get better and better.
The girl asked her friends for their opinion.
They said balancing was really tricky and she was doing a great job.
She was so proud of herself.
The little girl kept practicing and soon she was able to stay balanced on one foot for a long time.
She was amazed at what she had achieved.
This little girl showed that she was tough and with lots of hard work and practice, she was able to do something amazing.
Once upon a time, there was a gentle wagon.
It was red, with big, round wheels.
The wagon liked to go on adventures.
One day, the wagon went to the park with its friend, a little girl named Ali.
Ali was excited to use the wagon, so she filled it with her toys.
As Ali began to pull the wagon, it made a loud noise.
People started to frown.
But Ali kept pulling the wagon.
She smiled and she was gentle.
Before long, Ali and the wagon were all the way around the park.
They had had a great adventure together.
The wagon was happy and Ali was happy, so she gave the wagon a big hug.
The wagon would always remember the gentle adventure it had with Ali.
Once upon a time, there was a horse named Dull.
Dull lived in a stable.
He was not very happy because he had a bad leg.
Dull's leg made him suffer a lot.
One day, a girl named Sue came to see Dull.
She said, "Hi, Dull!
Why are you sad?" Dull told her about his bad leg.
Sue wanted to help Dull feel better.
Sue brought Dull a soft blanket to put on his leg.
She said, "This will help your leg feel better, Dull." Dull felt happy that Sue cared about him.
Soon, Dull's leg did not hurt as much.
Dull and Sue became good friends and played every day.
Once upon a time there was a boy named Joe.
Joe wanted to go for a ride in a taxi, but it was far away.
Joe asked his mom if he could go for a ride.
Mom said he could if he folded his blankets.
So Joe did exactly what his mom said and he folded the blankets.
He was very proud of himself.
Once the blankets were folded, Joe and his mom got into the taxi.
The taxi driver drove them a very long way.
It seemed like they drove for miles and miles.
When they reached their destination, Joe was so excited.
He had never been anywhere so distant before.
The taxi driver let them out and they began their journey.
Joe was happy he had listened to his mom and folded the blankets.
It had made his trip in the taxi possible.
Once upon a time, there lived a small and shy cat.
His name was Tom.
He wanted to go and explore the world, but he was too scared.
One day, Tom came across a sparkling gem.
He was amazed and wanted to explore it more.
He took the gem and went towards the forest.
Suddenly he heard a loud boom.
Tom became very scared and started running back home.
He saw a big and friendly dog in the forest.
The dog wanted to encourage Tom and show him the fun in exploring.
Tom was still shy and didn't want to go.
But the dog gently took him to the forest and showed him how amazing and beautiful nature was.
Tom was so happy and excited.
He thanked the dog for encouraging him.
Now he visits the forest often and loves to explore the new things he finds.
The sun was shining brightly, so Mommy took Charlie to the pond.
He was so excited!
Charlie started splashing in the water with his hands.
He was having so much fun!
Then Daddy came over with a net.
He scooped it through the water and pulled it up.
There were some little fish inside.
He said “these fish are all mine!” Charlie was so excited, he splashed even more.
Even Mommy was getting wet!
Charlie had a great day at the pond, splashing and playing with the fish in the water.
Once upon a time, there was a little duck named Ducky.
Ducky liked to play in the pond with his friends.
One day, it started to rain really hard.
Ducky and his friends got upset because they couldn't play in the pond anymore.
Ducky had an idea.
He said, "Let's make a raft and go on an adventure!" His friends thought it was a great idea.
They found some sticks and leaves and made a raft.
They went on the raft and floated down the river.
It was still raining, but they didn't mind.
They were having so much fun on their adventure.
They saw lots of animals and even a rainbow!
When they got back to the pond, they were all wet and tired, but they were happy because they had such a fun time.
Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy.
One day, Timmy was playing with his toy car when he accidentally broke it.
"Oh no!" cried Timmy.
"My car is broken!" Just then, a wild storm started outside.
The wind was blowing and the rain was pouring down.
Timmy's mom came into the room and saw that Timmy was upset.
"What's wrong, Timmy?" she asked.
"My car is broken," Timmy said sadly.
"But don't worry, we can fix it together," his mom said.
They worked on the car while the storm raged outside, and soon it was as good as new.
Timmy was so happy that he forgot all about the wild storm.
Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy.
Timmy loved to play with his toys, especially his toy cars.
One day, Timmy's dad brought home a new toy car that was very cool.
It had big wheels and could go very fast.
Timmy wanted to test out his new toy car, so he brought it outside to play.
He put the car on the ground and watched it go.
It went so fast that it hit Timmy's arm!
Timmy wasn't hurt, but he knew he needed to be careful when playing with his new toy.
From that day on, Timmy always made sure to keep his arms out of the way when testing out his cool toy cars.
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily.
She loved the color pink and had a lucky teddy bear that she always kept with her.
One day, Lily went to the park with her mommy and daddy.
At the park, Lily saw a big slide that she wanted to go on.
But it was too high and she was scared.
Her mommy said, "You can do it, Lily!
Just hold on tight and you will manage to slide down safely." Lily took a deep breath and climbed up the ladder.
She held on tight to her lucky teddy bear and slid down the big slide.
When she got to the bottom, she felt so happy and proud of herself.
Her mommy and daddy clapped and said, "Good job, Lily!
You are so brave and lucky to have your teddy bear with you."
Once upon a time, there was a little girl who was very adventurous.
She wanted to find something fun to do, so she decided to go outside to find some friends to play with.
When she went outside, she saw the sun shining in the sky and smiled.
She loved how warm and bright it was!
She saw two other children playing in the park nearby, so she ran to join them.
She said "Hi!
My name is Sally, what are you doing?" The two children said "We're sharing our toys!
We have a lot of fun.
Why don't you come and join us?" Sally was so happy and said "Yes please!
I love saying hello, and playing with toys." The children smiled and said "Great!
We can be adventurous and share the sun too!" Sally and the other children had so much fun sharing toys and the sun together.
They laughed, played, and enjoyed the warm sunny day.
And that's how Sally and her friends shared the sun and had an adventurous day in the park.
One day, a big cat and a little mouse were in a race.
The cat had a strong urge to win, so he ran very fast.
The mouse was light and quick, so he could hurry too.
They both wanted to be the best.
As they raced, the cat and the mouse saw a big hill.
The cat thought he could climb it fast, but the mouse was scared.
The cat started to climb up the hill, but the mouse stayed down.
The cat said, "Hurry, little mouse!
We need to finish the race!" The mouse felt the urge to climb the hill, so he started to go up.
He hurried and hurried, trying to catch up to the cat.
At the top of the hill, the cat and the mouse saw a big, bright light.
They both wanted to reach it first.
The cat and the mouse ran as fast as they could towards the light.
The cat was ahead, but the mouse hurried and caught up.
They both reached the light at the same time.
They were both winners!
The cat and the mouse were happy and became friends.
Lily and Ben were playing in the garden.
They liked to look at the flowers and smell them.
Lily saw a big flower that was pink and white.
She ran to it and said, "Look, Ben, this flower is so pretty!
It is blooming!" Ben followed her and nodded.
He liked the flower too.
He touched it gently and said, "It is soft and smooth.
And it smells good too.
What is its name?" Lily shrugged.
She did not know the name of the flower.
She said, "I don't know.
Maybe we can ask Mom.
She knows a lot of flower names." They ran to the house and found Mom in the kitchen.
They showed her the flower and asked, "Mom, what is this flower called?
It is blooming and it is pink and white." Mom smiled and said, "This flower is called a peony.
It is a very special flower.
It only blooms for a short time in the spring.
You are lucky to see it." Lily and Ben were happy.
They thanked Mom and ran back to the garden.
They wanted to see more flowers.
They saw yellow ones, blue ones, red ones, and purple ones.
They had fun naming them and picking some for Mom.
But then the sky became dark and cloudy.
They heard a loud noise.
It was thunder.
They saw a flash.
It was lightning.
They felt a drop.
It was rain.
They were scared.
They did not like the dark and the noise and the wet.
They ran to the house again.
They were wet and muddy.
Their pants were dirty.
They said, "Mom, Mom, we are sorry.
We made a mess.
The sky is dark and scary.
Can we come in?" Mom hugged them and said, "Don't worry, my loves.
You are not in trouble.
You can come in and change your pants.
The rain will stop soon.
And then you can see a rainbow.
A rainbow is a very beautiful thing.
It has many colors, like the flowers.
Do you want to see a rainbow?" Lily and Ben nodded.
They wanted to see a rainbow.
They changed their pants and waited for the rain to stop.
They hoped the flowers would still be blooming.
They hoped the sky would be bright again.
They hoped to see a rainbow.
Once upon a time, there was a chubby girl named Sally.
She lived on a beautiful island and loved to explore the big world around her.
One morning, Sally found a magical steam train in the forest.
She was so excited she couldn't help but hop in and take a ride!
The train chugged through the countryside, passing over bridges, through tunnels, and crossing rivers.
Finally, it came to a stop.
In front of the train was a little dragon.
The dragon smiled and asked Sally a question: "Where do you want to go?" Sally thought and thought, but she couldn't decide.
So, she just said "Wherever the steam takes me!" The dragon smiled again and the train started up again.
Sally waved goodbye and finally took off, the beautiful steam trailing behind her.
Sam and Lily were friends.
They liked to play with dolls and cars.
One day, they went to the park with their moms.
They saw a big slide and a swing.
They wanted to get on them.
"Let's play on the slide first," Sam said.
"OK," Lily said.
They ran to the slide and waited for their turn.
Sam went first.
He climbed up the ladder and slid down.
He laughed and said, "That was fun!" Lily followed him.
She climbed up the ladder and slid down.
But she slid too fast and fell off the slide.
She hurt her knee and cried.
"Ow, ow, ow!
That was terrible!" Sam ran to her and helped her up.
He said, "I'm sorry, Lily.
Are you OK?" Lily nodded.
She said, "It's OK, Sam.
It's just a scratch.
Let's play on the swing instead." They went to the swing and took turns pushing each other.
They had fun and forgot about the slide.
They played until their moms called them.
They said goodbye and hugged each other.
They were still friends.
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily.
One day, she was very hungry and wanted to eat something yummy.
She looked in the kitchen and saw a big pot of rice.
She decided to make some rice for herself.
Lily took a wide bowl and put some rice in it.
She added some water and put the bowl in the microwave.
When the rice was ready, she took it out and ate it all up.
After she finished eating, Lily had to decide what to do next.
She thought about playing with her toys or going outside to play.
She decided to go outside and have some fun in the sunshine.
Once upon a time there was a jolly animal.
It wanted to fly on a big adventure.
So it stretched out its wings and began to flap.
Up, up, up it flew into the sky!
The animal flew and flew, higher and higher.
It saw lots of interesting things on its journey.
It saw mountains and trees, birds and rivers.
Soon the animal started to feel tired, so it flew back down, and then it landed back where it started.
That was the end of its big flying adventure.
The jolly animal was so happy!
It had lots of fun flying and seeing so many wonderful things!
Once upon a time, there was a big train.
It went chugga chugga choo choo all day long.
One day, the train got tired and needed to rest.
The train found a nice spot under a tree and took a nap.
It felt much better after a good rest.
Later, a kind man came by and gave the train some water and snacks.
The man was very generous and the train was very happy.
From then on, the train made sure to rest and take breaks when it needed to.
And it always remembered the generous man who helped it when it was tired.
Once upon a time there was a bee called Sarah.
She lived in a hive in the ground.
One day, Sarah wanted to go explore the world outside her hive.
She waved at her mum and dad and flew off into the big, wide world.
But Sarah found the world outside very cold.
She shivered and huddled up.
But she was brave and kept flying.
Then she arrived at a park!
There were lots of children playing, but they didn't notice Sarah.
But then one of the children noticed Sarah and pointed at her.
He shouted to the other children, "Look a bee!
Can I catch it?" The other children shouted back yes, and they all chased after Sarah.
Sarah felt embarrassed that they were all chasing her, so she flew up higher and higher!
The children soon gave up and ran away.
Sarah was relieved and flew back to her hive, happy and tired.
The End.
Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tim.
Tim loved to play outside with his friends.
One day, they played catch with a ball.
Tim caught the ball and felt very happy.
Tim's mommy and daddy were getting married soon.
Tim was nervous about the big day.
He didn't know what to wear or what to say.
But his mommy and daddy said they loved him no matter what.
On the day of the marriage, Tim wore a nice suit and stood next to his mommy and daddy.
He was still nervous, but he felt happy too.
When his mommy and daddy said "I do," Tim caught a flower that the bride threw.
He smiled and felt proud to be a part of the special day.
One day, Sam went out to a park.
He wanted to play and have a snack too.
As he was walking, he felt a bit weak.
He saw some other kids running and playing so he wanted to join them.
The kids were playing a game.
They were trying to run and get to a tree before the other kids.
Sam joined in, but he was too weak.
He tried, but he couldn't keep up and he came last.
The other kids laughed at him, but Sam didn't care.
He felt sad, but he kept smiling.
The game was over now and it was time for a snack.
Sam had brought some apples and other treats.
He shared his snacks with his new friends.
As he handed out the snacks, he saw some of his friends become stronger and happier.
Sam was happy to yield his snacks.
He felt good to know it made everyone stronger and happier.
After everyone had their snacks, Sam and his new friends were ready to play some more.
They all ran away, laughing and playing.
Sam was happy, he had found a new way to yield: with snacks!
Lily loved to eat chicken.
She liked it with rice, with bread, with soup, or by itself.
She always asked her mom for more chicken when she finished her plate.
But sometimes, her mom said no.
She said Lily had enough chicken and she needed to eat other things too, like fruits and veggies.
One day, Lily saw a big bowl of chicken on the kitchen table.
It smelled so good and looked so yummy.
She wanted to have some right away.
She climbed on a chair and reached for the bowl.
But her mom saw her and said, "Lily, stop!
That chicken is for dinner.
You can't have it now.
You need to wait." Lily did not want to wait.
She wanted chicken now.
She tried to grab the bowl, but her mom held it away from her.
Lily started to cry and kick and scream.
She tried to resist her mom, but her mom was stronger.
She said, "Lily, calm down.
You are being very naughty.
You need to listen to me.
If you behave, you can have some chicken later.
But if you keep acting like this, you will have no chicken at all." Lily did not like to hear that.
She loved chicken too much.
She did not want to have no chicken at all.
She looked at her mom and saw that she was serious.
She did not want to make her mom angry.
She decided to stop crying and kicking and screaming.
She said, "Sorry, mom.
I will be good.
I will wait for dinner." Her mom smiled and hugged her.
She said, "That's my good girl.
I'm proud of you.
You can have some chicken later, but first you need to eat some salad and some carrots.
They are good for you.
They will make you healthy and strong.
And not too chubby." Lily nodded and got off the chair.
She did not like salad and carrots, but she knew they were good for her.
She wanted to be healthy and strong.
And not too chubby.
She followed her mom to the dining room and sat on her seat.
She waited for dinner and hoped there would be enough chicken for her.
She still loved chicken very much.
Lily and Ben are twins.
They like to play with their toys in the living room.
They have a big rug on the floor.
The rug is soft and colorful.
They have a lot of fun on the rug.
One day, their mom says, "It's time to bathe, kids.
You are dirty and smelly.
Come on, let's go to the bathroom." Lily and Ben do not want to bathe.
They want to play more.
They say, "No, mom.
We are not dirty.
We are not smelly.
We want to play on the rug." Mom says, "Yes, you are.
Look at your hands and feet.
They are black and sticky.
And look at your hair.
It is messy and greasy.
And you smell like a fat pig.
You need to bathe, or you will get sick." Lily and Ben do not like to be called fat pigs.
They do not like to be sick.
They say, "OK, mom.
We will bathe.
But can we bring our toys with us?" Mom says, "Sure, you can.
But only the ones that can get wet.
Not the ones that have batteries or fur.
And you have to wash them too." Lily and Ben agree.
They pick up their toys that can get wet.
They have a rubber duck, a plastic boat, a sponge ball, and a soap bar.
They follow mom to the bathroom.
They fill the tub with water and bubbles.
They put their toys in the tub.
They take off their clothes and get in the tub.
They splash and scrub and rinse and giggle.
They have fun in the tub.
Mom says, "See, bathing is not so bad.
It is fun and good for you.
You are clean and fresh now.
And you smell like flowers and fruits.
You are my sweet and lovely twins." Lily and Ben smile and hug mom.
They say, "Thank you, mom.
We love you.
And we love bathing.
Can we do it again tomorrow?"
One day, on a Tuesday, the sun began to rise.
It was a very bright and happy day.
The birds were singing loud songs, and the big yellow sun made the sky very pretty.
In a small house, a little boy named Tim woke up.
He heard the loud birds and saw the sun rise.
He was excited to play outside with his friends.
Tim put on his shoes and went out to have fun.
Tim and his friends played all day on Tuesday.
They laughed and ran under the big, bright sun.
They had so much fun.
When the sun started to go down, they said bye to each other.
Tim went back to his house, tired but happy.
He couldn't wait for the next day to play again.
Lily and Max were playing in the garden.
They liked to dig in the dirt and look for shiny things.
Sometimes they found coins, buttons, or rocks.
But today, they found something very special.
"Look, Lily, look!" Max shouted.
He held up a clear, sparkly thing in his hand.
"It's a crystal!" Lily ran over to see.
She gasped.
The crystal was so pretty.
It had many colors inside it, like a rainbow.
She wanted to touch it.
"Can I see, Max?
Can I hold it?" she asked.
Max nodded.
He gave the crystal to Lily.
She smiled and rubbed it with her fingers.
It felt smooth and cold.
But then, something bad happened.
Lily tripped over a root and fell down.
She dropped the crystal.
It landed on the grass and got dirty.
"Oh no!" Lily cried.
"The crystal is all dirty!
It's not pretty anymore!" Max helped Lily get up.
He saw the crystal on the ground.
He picked it up and wiped it with his shirt.
He tried to make it clean again.
"Don't cry, Lily," he said.
"The crystal is still pretty.
Look, it still sparkles.
It's just a little dirty.
That's normal.
Everything gets dirty sometimes.
We can wash it later." Lily sniffed.
She looked at the crystal.
She saw that Max was right.
The crystal still sparkled.
It was still pretty.
She felt better.
"Thank you, Max," she said.
"You are a good friend.
Can we share the crystal?" Max smiled.
He hugged Lily.
He was happy that she was happy.
"Of course we can share the crystal," he said.
"It's our special find.
We can keep it in our treasure box.
Come on, let's go show Mom and Dad." They ran to the house, holding the crystal.
They were very proud of their discovery.
They had a lot of fun playing in the garden.
Once upon a time, there was a dark handle.
It was a very old handle that was made of metal.
One day, two children found the handle and they were so excited.
They decided they would sign the handle so they would always remember it.
So, each child put a sign on the dark handle, one with their name and the other with a picture.
From then on, the handle with the signs on it was only for the two children.
Whenever they saw it, they knew it was special.
Once upon a time, there was a baby bird that wanted to escape from her nest.
She was tired of seeing the same sky every day and wanted to explore the world.
So one night, she began flapping her wings and hopped out of the nest.
But the journey was not always easy.
Everywhere she flew, she encountered danger.
Sometimes she even got lost.
Still, she kept on going because she wanted to find a place where she could be free and find peace.
Finally, one day she found what she had been searching for.
It was a rare place in the mountains where she could be safe and happy.
She settled down in the wilderness and stayed there, feeling content and peaceful.
The baby bird was so happy to have escaped and found a special spot of her own.
She could barely believe it when she realized she had found the peace she had been looking for.
Once upon a time there was a train.
It looked very good.
It had big wheels that moved around and around.
One day, a girl named Jane wanted to go on a ride on the train.
She jumped on the train and was so excited to go.
Jane asked the train driver, "Where are we going?" The train driver said, "We are going to wrap around the mountains." Jane was so happy.
She watched out of the window as the train wrapped around the mountains.
She could see trees, rivers, and birds everywhere she looked.
It was a wonderful ride.
At the end of the ride, Jane thanked the train driver and jumped off the train.
She was so happy from the train ride that she couldn't wait to go on another one.
She knew that the next time she was on the train, it would be just as good as before.
Once upon a time, there was a little bunny who wanted to go on an adventure.
He hopped around his home, but he couldn't find anything exciting to do.
Suddenly, he had an idea!
He wanted to explore the underground tunnels that he had heard about.
The bunny put on his fancy hat and hopped outside.
He saw a big hole in the ground and he knew that was the entrance to the underground tunnels.
But he was scared to go alone, so he requested his friend, a little bird, to come with him.
Together, they hopped down the hole and into the underground tunnels.
It was dark and spooky, but they had each other to keep them company.
They found lots of interesting things like rocks, bugs, and even a shiny treasure!
After their adventure, the bunny and the bird were tired but happy.
They had so much fun exploring the underground tunnels together.
Once upon a time, there was a hairy monster who lived in the sand.
He was very lonely, so he decided to rise up out of the ground to look for a friend.
The monster rose up higher and higher out of the sand, until he stopped at the top of a hill.
From there, he could see the whole beach.
He saw a child playing in the sand and it made him very happy.
The monster waved his hands and he smiled his monster smile, but the child was too scared to come near him.
He kept running away but he kept looking back at the monster.
Finally, the monster was so happy, he flew up and up in the sky.
With a big smile on his face, he waved goodbye to the child and flew away to find new friends.
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily.
Lily loved to play in the pool.
She liked to splash and make big waves.
One day, Lily's mommy put lotion on her skin to protect her from the sun.
Lily thought the lotion felt funny and slimy.
Lily went back to playing in the pool, but then a boy came and splashed her.
Lily got mad and thought the boy was rude.
She wanted to splash him back, but her mommy told her not to be rude.
So, Lily just kept playing and having fun in the pool.
After a while, Lily got out of the pool and her mommy put more lotion on her skin.
Lily smiled and said, "Thank you mommy, I love you." Then, Lily went to eat some yummy snacks with her mommy.
The end.
Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tim.
He had a guitar.
He loved to play it every day.
Tim also liked to joke and be a little naughty.
One day, Tim saw a cat.
The cat was naughty too.
Tim thought, "Maybe the cat wants to joke with me." So, he played his guitar to make the cat laugh.
The cat liked the music but did not laugh yet.
Tim played the guitar louder and made a funny face.
The cat laughed!
They joked and played together.
The cat was not naughty anymore.
Tim and the cat became good friends.
And they lived happily ever after.
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily.
She loved to bake cakes with her mommy.
One day, her mommy brought out a big mixer to use.
Lily was so excited to help.
She watched as her mommy mixed all the ingredients together.
But then, Lily's little brother came into the kitchen.
He was jealous that Lily got to help with the baking.
He wanted to help too.
So, Lily's mommy let him use the mixer for a little bit.
Lily and her brother took turns using the mixer to mix the cake batter.
They had so much fun!
And when the cake was done baking, they both got to eat a big slice.
It was the best cake ever!
Mia and Ben are twins.
They like to play with their toys and books.
One day, they find a big box in the living room.
They wonder what is inside.
"Let's open it!" Mia says.
"OK!" Ben says.
They lift the lid and see a small, furry animal.
It has long ears, a pink nose and a fluffy tail.
It looks at them with big, brown eyes.
"A bunny!" Mia says.
"It's so charming!" Ben says.
They take the bunny out of the box and hug it gently.
The bunny makes a soft noise and wiggles its nose.
Mia and Ben laugh.
"Can we keep it, Mom?" Mia asks.
Mom comes into the living room and smiles.
She sees the bunny and the twins.
"Of course, you can keep it.
It's a gift from Grandma.
She knows you love animals.
But you have to take good care of it.
It needs food, water and a clean cage," Mom says.
"What does it eat?" Ben asks.
"It eats carrots, lettuce and hay.
I have some in the kitchen.
Come on, let's feed it," Mom says.
Mia and Ben follow Mom to the kitchen.
They give the bunny some food and water.
The bunny eats happily and makes a crunching noise.
Mia and Ben watch it with joy.
They decide to name the bunny Fluffy.
They play with Fluffy every day and make sure it has everything it needs.
Fluffy is a charming and friendly bunny.
It loves Mia and Ben and they love it too.
They are very happy with their new pet.
Once upon a time there were two friends, Jack and Sam.
They loved to go outside and play.
One day, they wanted to go to the river to play in a raft.
So, they got the raft ready and set off.
As they were floating down the river, they noticed something cool.
It was a giant fish!
They were so excited but the fish was scared of their raft.
It kept swimming away.
Jack and Sam were so sad.
Then, they had to fight each other because they both wanted to catch the fish.
Jack cried and said he wanted to catch the fish.
But Sam tried to tell him that it wasn't possible.
They shouted back and forth until finally they stopped arguing and decided to go home.
The two friends never caught the big fish, but they had a cool adventure in their raft.
They both learned a valuable lesson about friendship and that sometimes it is better to talk than fight.
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily.
She loved to play outside in the park with her friends.
One day, Lily went to the park with her mommy.
It was very cold outside, so she wore her warm jacket.
Lily's mommy told her to be careful and not to wander off too far.
"I trust you to stay close to me," her mommy said.
Lily nodded and held her mommy's hand tightly.
They walked around the park and looked at all the pretty flowers.
Suddenly, Lily saw her friend, Emma.
"Look, mommy!
There's Emma!" she shouted.
Her mommy smiled and they walked over to say hello.
Emma was happy to see Lily and they played together on the swings.
Lily's mommy watched them and felt happy that she could trust Lily to stay safe.
Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy.
Timmy loved to go to the store with his mommy to buy toys.
One day, Timmy saw a toy airplane that he really wanted.
He begged his mommy to buy it for him.
His mommy said yes and Timmy was so happy!
As they were leaving the store, Timmy saw a big truck drive by and it made a loud noise.
The noise was so loud that it gave Timmy a shock!
He held onto his mommy tightly and she hugged him to make him feel better.
After they got home, Timmy played with his new airplane and flew it high in the sky.
He was having so much fun!
Timmy was grateful that his mommy bought him the toy and he felt so happy.
The end.
Once upon a time, there was a grumpy cat.
The cat didn't like anything that the owner did.
The owner tried to make the cat happy by giving him milk and fish, but the cat still looked grumpy.
One day, the owner decided to change the menu and made the cat's favorite food.
The cat ate the food and started to purr.
The owner was happy to see the cat happy.
Later that day, the owner saw that the cat was sleeping soundly.
The owner thought that the cat's grumpiness had come to an end.
From that day on, the cat was happy and playful.
Once upon a time, there was a little mouse who lived in a big forest.
One day, he met a friendly rabbit who said, "Hello, little mouse!
Do you want to become my friend?" The little mouse was happy and said, "Yes, please!
I want a friend." The rabbit and the mouse played together every day and had lots of fun.
But one day, the little mouse got lost in the forest and fell into a trap.
He was scared and cried for help.
The rabbit heard his friend's cries and came to rescue him.
"Don't worry, little mouse.
I'll get you out of this scary trap," said the rabbit.
And he did!
The little mouse was so happy to have such a brave and kind friend.
They continued to play together in the forest, always watching out for each other.
Tim had a pet cat named Spot.
Spot was very popular with the other cats in the street.
He liked to play and chase and smile.
Tim loved Spot very much and gave him food and water and hugs every day.
One day, Tim and Spot went for a walk in the park.
They saw many birds and flowers and people.
Spot ran after a butterfly and Tim followed him.
They had a lot of fun.
Tim smiled and Spot smiled.
But then, a big dog came out of nowhere.
He was angry and loud and mean.
He saw Spot and wanted to catch him.
He barked and ran towards him.
Spot was scared and tried to run away.
Tim was scared too and shouted for Spot.
The dog was faster than Spot.
He bit him hard and shook him.
Spot cried and hurt.
Tim cried and hurt too.
He ran to Spot and tried to help him.
But it was too late.
Spot was gone.
Tim hugged him and sobbed.
He did not smile and Spot did not smile.
The dog ran away and left them alone.
Tim and Spot never played and chased and smiled again.
Tim was very sad and missed Spot very much.
He wished he could see him again.
He wished the dog never came.
He wished he could smile and Spot could smile.
But they could not.
The end.
Once upon a time, a little girl named Lily went to the park with her mommy.
They saw a tall tree and decided to sit under it.
Lily's mommy brought a book and began to read to her.
Lily loved to listen to stories.
Suddenly, a boy came over and asked if he could use Lily's microscope.
Lily didn't want to share because it was her favorite toy.
The boy got mad and took the microscope away from her.
Lily started to cry and her mommy tried to help her.
The boy didn't give the microscope back and ran away.
Lily was sad and her mommy hugged her.
They went home without the microscope.
Lily learned that sharing is important and not everyone is nice.
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily.
She loved to explore the forest near her house.
One day, she found a big cave.
She was scared at first, but then she remembered her mom's words: "Don't be afraid to try new things, Lily." Lily went inside the cave and found a glowing rock.
It was so pretty!
She picked it up and put it in her pocket.
As she was leaving the cave, she saw a little bunny stuck in a hole.
"Oh no!" she said.
"How did you get stuck in there?"  Lily tried to pull the bunny out, but she couldn't.
She felt frustrated.
Then she remembered the glowing rock in her pocket.
She took it out and it shined so bright that it helped her see where the bunny was stuck.
She was able to pull the bunny out and they became best friends.
From that day on, Lily always carried the glowing rock with her, just in case she needed it again.
Once upon a time there was a small boy called Sam.
One day Sam found some white clay at the beach.
He was so excited to see what he could make from the clay.
He got to work making things, like shapes and animals.
He worked so hard that he soon forgot anything else around him.
But then he heard someone say: "Thank you Sam, that is the most wonderful thing I have ever seen."  Sam was so surprised and he looked around to see who spoke.
He couldn't see anyone so he looked down and saw a white rabbit smiling right at him.
The rabbit thanked Sam again and ran off.
Sam was so happy that he had made something that the bunny liked so much.
He gave a big smile and thanked the bunny too!
Once upon a time there was a mighty cable.
The cable was bright and shiny and it belonged to everyone in the world.
It went through cities, towns, fields and rivers.
All the people on the planet belonged to the cable.
The cable connected everyone and everything.
People could talk to each other, share secrets and exchange thoughts no matter how far apart they were.
The cable was strong and mighty and it kept everyone together.
One day, a giant storm came in.
The cable was shaken and it started to break apart.
Everyone was scared and the whole world was in danger.
But luckily, the people all banded together.
Everyone started to fix the cable and soon it was back to its mighty and strong state.
Everyone rejoiced, because they all belonged to the cable once again.
Mama and Toby were in the kitchen, getting ready for dinner.
Toby was helping to put the items on the table.
"Mmm, the turkey smells so yummy," said Toby.
Mama smiled and said, "We should be thankful for everything we have." Toby nodded and said,"Yeah, I'm thankful for the turkey and for everything else."   After dinner, Toby went outside to play.
He saw a pile of sticks and picked one up, wondering what he could do with it.
He thought and thought, and then he had an idea.
He started to arrange the sticks together.
Before long, he had made a house!
He was proud of himself and ran inside to show Mama what he had done.
Mama was amazed when Toby showed her the house.
"This is wonderful!
You are so creative.
Sticks can be very useful.
We can use them to build things and create things.
And tonight we will use them to roast marshmallows." Toby was filled with joy.
He said, "Thank you, Mama!
I'm really glad I found the sticks."  Mama smiled, feeling thankful for a moment like this with her son.
Together they roasted the marshmallows and ate them with delight.
They thanked the turkey for giving them enough energy to be able to play and have fun.
It was a sweet evening filled with thankfulness.
Once upon a time, a boy named Jack had a blue guitar.
He loved to play it every day.
One day, Jack's friend Lily came to his house.
She asked, "Can I play your guitar, Jack?" Jack said, "Sure, but be careful.
It's heavy.
It weighs a lot."  Lily picked up the guitar and started to play.
She played a song that made Jack happy.
He said, "You're really good, Lily!" Lily smiled and said, "Thanks, Jack.
Your guitar is so pretty and blue.
I love it!"  Jack was happy to hear that Lily liked his guitar.
He said, "You can play it anytime you want, Lily.
Just be careful because it's heavy and weighs a lot." Lily nodded and said, "I will.
Thank you, Jack!"  From that day on, Jack and Lily played the guitar together.
They loved the sound it made and how it looked.
They were happy to have each other as friends and to share their love for music.
Once upon a time, there were two best friends called Lucy and Joe.
They were so excited because they were going on a picnic.
Joe said, "I can't wait to show you the beautiful waffle I made!"  Lucy smiled.
"Oh, I can't wait to see it!
What will it look like?" Joe grinned.
"It's going to be so cool.
It's shaped like a diamond, with lots of delicious toppings!" When they reached the park, Joe put the waffle down on a table for them both to see.
Lucy gasped in amazement.
"Wow, it looks so beautiful!" Joe was so proud of himself.
He smiled and said, "Yes, I made it all by myself!" They enjoyed their picnic and the delicious waffle.
It was the best day ever!
Peter was excited.
Today he was going to play with water.
He ran to the backyard and saw a delicate little pond filled with water.
He reached out and touched it with his tiny hands.
The water was cold and wet.
He smiled and asked his mom, "Can I play with the water?" "Yes, but be careful.
Water is delicate and you need to be gentle," his mom replied.
So Peter got on his hands and knees and began to touch the water.
He felt the cold droplets on his fingers.
Then he started to splash the water and laughed with joy.
He continued to touch the water and soon he was playing a game where he had to find the pebbles hidden underneath the surface.
Peter was having a lot of fun.
He continued to play in the water until it was time to go inside.
He felt a bit sad to leave but he promised himself that he would come back tomorrow.
The sun shone brightly in the sky.
John and his dad were going to the park.
They walked to the park and when they arrived, they saw lots of tall trees and grass.
John liked the park very much.
He ran over to the big wood and saw who was there.
It was a fierce tiger!
John was scared but his dad wasn't scared.
His dad was brave.
He took a big step towards the tiger and the tiger ran away.
John and his dad were now alone in the park.
They walked through the wood and saw lots of different animals.
John and his dad had a great time.
When it was time to go home, they said goodbye to the park.
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily.
She had a leather backpack that she loved to wear.
One day, Lily's mommy took her to the store to buy a different backpack.
Lily saw many backpacks, but she didn't like any of them.
She wanted a backpack with her name on it.
So, her mommy found a store that could put Lily's name on a leather backpack.
Lily was so happy and she wore her new backpack everywhere she went.
Once upon a time, there was a little bear named Benny.
Benny loved to play in the woods with his friends.
One day, Benny and his friends went on an adventure to find a hidden treasure.
They searched high and low, but they couldn't find it.
Benny thought they should tell the truth and ask for help.
Suddenly, they saw a glow in the distance.
They followed the glow and found the treasure.
Benny was so happy that he jumped up and down!
Once upon a time, there was a violin.
It was delicate and shiny and it made a sound like no other.
Every day, the violin rolled around the house, and wherever it went, it sang a happy song.
One day, a little girl came to the house.
She was three years old and she loved the sound of the violin.
She followed it around the house, dancing and singing along.
The little girl begged the violin to come and play with her.
The violin could roll around the room and the girl could keep up with it.
They rolled together, back and forth, and they had so much fun!
The little girl laughed and the violin made music.
When it was time to say goodbye, the violin rolled away, but the little girl still remembered the happy music it made.
The delicate, shiny violin had made her day so special.
Once upon a time, there was a clever little boy named Timmy.
Timmy loved playing with his toy cars and trucks.
One day, he was playing with his favorite red truck when it got stuck in a box.
“Help, help!” cried Timmy.
“My truck can’t exit the box!” Timmy’s mom came to help him.
She saw that the truck was stuck and needed to be released.
She carefully took the truck out of the box and gave it back to Timmy.
“Thank you, Mommy!” said Timmy.
“You’re so clever.” Timmy and his truck were happy again and continued to play together.
The end.
Billy enjoyed the sound of the birds whistling in the trees.
He would whistle along with them when he had time.
Billy was looking at a map of the world, wanting to explore all the different countries.
He looked so carefully at the map, but he was a bit careless.
A gust of wind suddenly pushed the map away, and it flew up into the sky.
Billy gasped.
"Oh no!" He had to find that map!
Without it, he couldn't explore the world.
He ran around trying to find it, but it seemed hopeless.
Another gust of wind brought the map back down from the sky, but it was ruined.
The edges were all frayed, and the colours were fading.
Billy cried when he saw it.
He wanted to explore the world, but he couldn't do it with this torn map.
Billy never found a way to explore the world after that.
He was sad about being careless, but he still enjoyed watching the birds whistle in the trees every day.
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily.
She loved to play outside and look for pretty rocks.
One day, she found a shiny mineral that sparkled in the sun.
She picked it up and showed it to her mom.
"Mommy, look what I found!" Lily said, holding up the mineral.
"It's so pretty!" Her mom smiled and said, "That's a beautiful rock, Lily.
But be careful, kneeling on the ground for too long can be uncomfortable." Lily nodded and put the mineral in her pocket.
She continued to play outside, but this time she made sure to stand up and stretch her legs every once in a while.
She was happy to have found such a pretty rock and couldn't wait to show her friends.
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily.
She loved to play outside with her friends.
They would run and jump and laugh together.
One day, while they were playing, they found a big pile of junk.
It was old and rusty and broken.
But Lily had an idea.
She thought they could use the junk to build a fort.
So they started to work.
They stacked the junk and made a big pile.
It was hard work, but they didn't give up.
When they were finished, they sat inside their fort and felt calm.
They were proud of what they had made.
From that day on, they played in their junk fort every day.
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily.
One day, she was playing with her toys when her mom called her on the phone.
"Hi Mommy!" said Lily.
"Hi sweetie, did you clean up your toys like I asked you to?" asked Mommy.
"No, I forgot," replied Lily, feeling a little bit ignorant.
"Well, you know what happens when you don't listen to Mommy.
I have to punish you," said Mommy.
Lily didn't like being punished, but she knew she had to listen to her Mommy.
So she put away her toys and promised to be a good girl from now on.
And that's exactly what she did!
One day, Daisy was feeling lonely.
She didn't have anyone to play with, but she looked at the sky and saw a wonderful sunrise.
Suddenly, a magical sparkle flew from the sky and landed in front of her.
It was a sparkle fairy!
The sparkle fairy said she was lost and needed help.
Daisy said she would rescue her.
Daisy used her hand to carefully pick up the sparkle fairy and took her to a safe place.
The sparkle fairy thanked Daisy with a happy smile and flew away.
Daisy waved goodbye and watched until the sparkle fairy had disappeared into the sky.
As Daisy looked back at the beautiful sunrise, she felt proud of herself for rescuing the sparkle fairy.
She knew that she had made a difference and hadn't been so lonely after all.
Once upon a time, there was a big, deep forest.
In the forest, there lived a little bunny.
One day, the bunny was hopping around when he saw a broken tree.
The bunny knew he had to repair the tree, so he got to work.
He gathered some sticks and leaves and fixed the tree.
As the bunny was hopping away, he saw a wise old owl.
The owl gave the bunny a wink and said, "Good job repairing the tree." The bunny felt happy and proud of himself.
From that day on, the bunny knew that he could do anything he put his mind to.
And whenever he saw something that needed repairing, he would hop right to it!
There was a package on the table.
It was weird and shiny.
The little girl wanted to grab it.
She wanted to know what was inside.
She reached for it, but it was too high for her to reach.
The girl was sad.
She stood on her tippy-toes but she still couldn't stretch far enough.
Then she had an idea.
She grabbed a chair and used it to help her reach the package.
She was so excited when her fingers touched the package.
She cradled it in her hands and pulled it close to her chest.
She was also very curious.
She carefully lifted the lid and peeked inside.
It was full of candy!
The girl's eyes lit up with excitement.
She quickly snatched one and popped it in her mouth and enjoyed it.
She felt so happy.
She couldn't wait to share her sweet surprise with all her friends.
One day, a boy and a girl were playing in the garden.
They saw a big red fox hiding behind a bush.
The fox looked hungry and angry.
"Let's go away, the fox is scary!" the girl said.
"No, let's stay and watch, maybe the fox will do something funny!" the boy said.
They stayed and watched, but the fox did not do anything funny.
The fox jumped out of the bush and ran towards them.
The boy and the girl were very scared.
They ran to the house, but the door was not open.
"Help, help, the fox is coming!" they shouted.
Their mom heard them and came to the door.
She opened the door and let them in.
She saw the fox and said a magic word.
The fox started to shrink and shrink until it was very small.
"Look, the fox is tiny now!" the boy said.
"Yes, the fox is tiny and harmless now.
Mom is very clever!" the girl said.
The mom smiled and hugged them.
She said, "Don't worry, the fox will not bother you anymore.
But next time, be careful and don't go near wild animals.
They can be dangerous." The boy and the girl nodded and said, "Yes, mom, we will be careful.
Thank you for saving us!" They went inside and had some cookies and milk.
The fox ran away and never came back.
The end.
Once upon a time there was a happy dog named Bob.
Bob loved the dark because that was when he could do all his fun games.
One night Bob went into the dark, but he forgot something very important - to listen!
He stumbled around quietly, hoping not to wake anyone up.
Suddenly he heard a small voice.
It said, “Hello there!
Who are you?” Bob was so surprised!
It was a little mouse peeking out from a crack in the wall.
The mouse said, “Why don't you come and play with me in the dark?
I can show you all sorts of fun things.” Bob was really excited and said yes!
He followed the mouse and they began to play.
Bob and the mouse had so much fun in the dark together.
Through the night they laughed and played together until it was time to go home.
Bob thanked the mouse and smiled a happy goodbye.
Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim.
Tim was very happy because it was his birthday.
He knew he would get a big present from his mom and dad.
In the morning, Tim found a big box with a lock on it.
His mom said, "Tim, you need to unlock the box to find your present." Tim was excited and used a key to unlock the box.
Inside, he found a new shirt.
The shirt was very fit on Tim.
He wore it all day and showed it to all his friends.
They all liked the shirt and said it was a great present.
Tim was very happy and said thank you to his mom and dad.
And they all lived happily ever after.
Once upon a time there was a big, strong lion.
It lived in a very big and rich jungle.
Every day the lion would take a long nap in the sun.
One day, while the lion was napping, a cheeky monkey spotted a bright and shiny tie.
The monkey just had to have it!
He ran over to the lion and tugged at the tie but it was too tight.
The lion woke up with a start and roared so loudly that the monkey flew away in fright!
Once the lion realised what the monkey was trying to do, he laughed.
He knew the monkey just wanted to look as rich and fancy as the lion did!
He never saw the monkey again, but he never forgot its beautiful bright tie.
Lily and Sam like to create things with paper and glue.
They cut and stick and make animals and flowers and cars.
They have fun and talk and laugh.
But one day, it rains a lot.
The rain makes the paper wet and the glue runny.
Lily and Sam's creations get ruined.
They feel sad and worry.
"What can we do?" Lily asks Sam.
"Our things are all wet and bad." Sam thinks for a moment.
He has an idea.
He smiles and says, "We can create something new.
Something that likes the rain." "What is it?" Lily asks.
Sam shows her a paper boat.
He folds and sticks and makes a boat.
He gives it to Lily.
"We can make more boats and sail them in the water.
The rain will not hurt them.
It will make them go fast." Lily likes the idea.
She makes a paper boat too.
They go outside and find a puddle.
They put their boats in the puddle and watch them float and move.
They have fun and talk and laugh again.
They do not worry about the rain anymore.
They create something new and enjoy the wet.
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily who loved to play hide-and-seek.
One day, she found a great hiding spot behind a big tree.
She was so hidden that no one could find her!
As she sat there, she blinked her eyes and thought about her opinion on the game.
She decided that it was the best game ever because it was so much fun.
Suddenly, she heard her friend calling out her name.
"Where are you, Lily?" her friend asked.
Lily giggled and replied, "I'm hidden behind the big tree!" Her friend found her and they both laughed and played together.
From that day on, they played hide-and-seek every day and Lily's opinion never changed.
It was still the best game ever!
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily.
She wanted to pick a toy to play with, but she couldn't choose which one.
She looked at her dolls and her stuffed animals, but she couldn't decide.
Suddenly, she heard a noise outside.
She looked out the window and saw a parade!
People were marching and playing music.
Lily felt so happy and cheerful.
She ran outside to join the parade.
As she marched and danced with the people, she saw a clown holding a balloon.
The clown asked Lily if she wanted a balloon.
Lily had to choose which color she wanted.
She picked a pink balloon and held it tight as she continued to march in the parade.
The end.
Once there was a lovely little crab.
Every day he went down to the beach and looked for food.
He found lots of tasty treats and was very happy.
One day, he saw a little fish chasing a big fish.
He was so surprised, he almost forgot about eating.
He watched them swimming around together and realized it was a game.
The crab started to play with the two fish, swimming back and forth like them.
It was so much fun!
He didn't even realize that the sun was setting.
When the moon came out, he realized it was time to go home.
As he walked on the sand, he felt happy knowing that he'd had a lovely day at the beach.
Once upon a time, there was a little boy who loved to collect things.
He would go around his house every day looking for something special to keep.
One day, he found a very special place.
It was a very serious place with lots of things to collect.
He spent lots of time there searching for treasures.
He found a shiny rock, feathers, and many other things.
He put them all in a bag and took them home.
He was so happy with all the things he collected.
The little boy kept collecting from the serious place.
He added so many things to his bag that it became heavy to carry.
He would go back over and over again, always finding something new to take home.
He eventually made so many trips to the serious place that all his special things filled up his room.
The end.
Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy.
Timmy loved to bake cakes with his mommy.
They would use a big mixer to mix the flour and sugar together.
Timmy loved to help his mommy mix the batter.
One day, Timmy's mommy had to go to the store.
She told Timmy not to touch the mixer while she was gone.
But Timmy didn't listen.
He started to play with the mixer and accidentally turned it on.
The batter flew everywhere and made a big mess.
When Timmy's mommy came back, she saw the mess and felt very ashamed.
She told Timmy that he should have listened to her.
Timmy felt bad and said sorry.
In the end, Timmy and his mommy had to clean up the mess and didn't get to eat any cake.
Timmy learned to always listen to his mommy and not to play with the mixer.
Once upon a time, there was a little girl who had a smooth doll.
Every day, she would take her doll on a trip and learn new things.
But one day, she wanted to go on a longer trip than usual and her parents said no.
The little girl was so sad and wanted to learn more, so she kept asking and asking.
Finally, the little girl's parents agreed that she could go on the special trip if she promised to be careful.
She was so excited and promised to be extra careful.
On the day of the trip, the little girl was surrounded by new things.
She did not know where to look first.
The little girl had a smooth and wonderful time.
She ate new and strange types of food and tried new things she had never seen before.
She even found a new game to play, and she was excited for more trips like that one.
At the end of the day, the little girl learned a lot.
She had a great adventure and she was so happy.
The little girl learned that when she works hard, she can go on special trips and have fun.
Once there was a little boy who was very lucky.
He had a brand new x-ray toy at his house and he loved to play with it.
He was playing with it one day, running around and imagining himself as an x-ray doctor.
His mom came in to check on him and reminded the little boy not to be too rough with his toy.
He nodded and promised he would be careful.
The little boy kept playing, but then he had an idea.
He ran to his mom and asked if he could take his x-ray toy to show his friends.
His mom thought about it and said yes.
She reminded him to enjoy his toy, but always be careful with it.
The little boy thanked his mom and raced off to show his friends.
They were so excited to see the model x-ray that the little boy had.
He was so lucky to have such a cool toy!
He reminded himself that he was lucky and he thanked his mom for reminding him to be careful with it.
Once upon a time, a little girl named Lily went to the zoo with her mom.
Lily was very excited to see all the animals.
She was a bit impatient and wanted to see them all at once.
Her mom told her, "Slow down, Lily.
We have all day to see the animals." At the zoo, Lily saw a big elephant.
She wanted to touch it, but it was too tall.
Lily's mom said, "Kneel down, Lily.
The elephant will come to you." So Lily kneeled down, and the elephant came closer.
She gently touched its trunk and smiled.
Later, they saw a group of kids running and shouting near the animals.
The zookeeper told them, "Please be quiet and calm.
The animals will be scared if you are loud." The kids listened and soon, the animals came closer.
Lily learned that being patient and kind was the best way to enjoy the zoo.
Anna and Ben are friends.
They like to play in the park.
One day, they see a big animal with a long neck.
It is a giraffe.
"Wow, look at that!" Anna says.
"It has a long, long neck.
How can it eat the leaves?" Ben says, "Maybe it can stretch its neck very high.
Or maybe it can bend its neck very low.
Let's go and see." They run to the giraffe.
The giraffe is friendly.
It lowers its neck and lets them touch it.
It feels soft and warm.
"Hello, giraffe," Anna says.
"You have a nice neck.
Can you tell us how you eat the leaves?" The giraffe says, "I can eat the leaves in different ways.
Sometimes I stretch my neck high and reach the top of the trees.
Sometimes I bend my neck low and nibble the grass.
Sometimes I eat the leaves that people give me.
I like all kinds of leaves." Anna and Ben are happy.
They spend a long time with the giraffe.
They give it some leaves and some water.
They hug it and thank it.
"Goodbye, giraffe," they say.
"We had fun with you.
You are a good friend." The giraffe says, "Goodbye, Anna and Ben.
You are good friends too.
Come and visit me again." Anna and Ben wave to the giraffe.
They go back to their parents.
They tell them about the giraffe and its long neck.
They say they want to see it again.
Their parents smile and say they will.
Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a friendly dog named Spot.
Spot loved to play outside and taste all the yummy treats his owner gave him.
He liked to chase birds and run around in the park.
One day, Spot saw a big truck.
It was stuck in traffic.
The truck had a big box in the back.
Spot was curious and wanted to see what was inside the box.
He thought it might be full of treats for him to taste.
Spot went to the truck and the driver opened the box.
Inside, there were lots of friendly puppies!
They all jumped out and played with Spot.
They tasted treats together and had a great time.
The traffic cleared and the truck drove away, but Spot and his new friends played all day long.
One hot day, Sita was walking in the park.
She saw an elephant.
She wanted to go closer, but she was scared.
Then, Sita decided to be brave.
She took one step closer to the elephant.
The elephant was very big and it was breathing hard, but it was very quiet.
Sita was still scared, but she decided to keep going.
She took one more step and the elephant moved away.
Sita was so happy.
She wanted to thank the elephant for not scaring her.
So she gave him a big hug.
The elephant felt happy and wanted to play with Sita.
They had lots of fun together.
They played in the park until it was too hot.
Then they decided it was time to go home.
Sita gave the elephant one final hug before she left.
She knew she would miss him.
Once upon a time, there was a man named Tom.
Tom had three children: Susie, John and Jack.
All three of them loved to borrow food from the neighbours.
One day, Tom's children wanted to borrow some food from their neighbour.
So Tom went with them to the neighbour's house.
The neighbour was very happy to see them and he gave them some delicious food.
The children were very excited and thanked their neighbour.
When they got home, Tom and the children shared the food and it was brilliant!
They all had a lovely meal together.

Katy was three years old and liked learning.

Katy tried using steam too.
She put some water in a pot and boiled it.
She noticed that the steam was hot and hard to keep in the pot.

Tim and Sam are friends.
They like to play in the park.
They see a big tree with many branches.
They want to make a fort with the branches.

He runs to the branch and picks it up.

He tries to put it on the ground, but it is difficult.
He drops it and it makes a loud noise.

He goes to help Tim.
They lift the branch together and put it on the ground.
They find more branches and put them next to each other.

She comes to the park to see them.
She smiles and gives them a hug.
"You made a nice fort with the branches.
Do you want a snack?" "Yes, please, Mom!" Tim and Sam say.

Tweetie had a broken wing and could not fly high like the other birds.
One day, Tweetie saw some smoke coming from a nearby tree.
Tweetie was scared and did not know what to do.
Then, a group of birds came and started to tease Tweetie.
They said mean things like "You can't fly, you can't help us!" But one kind bird named Blue saw that Tweetie was in trouble and flew to get help.
Soon, the firemen came and put out the fire in the tree.
They also saw that Tweetie had a broken wing, so they took Tweetie to the vet.
After a few weeks, Tweetie's wing was all better and Tweetie could fly high again.
The mean birds felt bad for teasing Tweetie and apologized.
From that day on, they all became friends and looked out for each other.
Once there was a dog named Sam.
He was very fast and every day he would practice running.
One day, pretending he was in a race, he started running as fast as he could through the park.
Sam saw a fence at the end of the park and got an idea; he wanted to see if he could jump over it!
He smiled and kept running.
When he got to the fence he started to jump, but he didn't make it.
He fell to the ground and frowned.
Just then, a rabbit hopped by and saw what had happened.
He said to Sam, "Try again!
If you want success, you can't give up!" Sam smiled and got up quickly.
This time he jumped higher and higher and made it over the fence!
He was so proud and happy.
Sam ran back to the rabbit, who smiled, and said, "You did it!
Success!" Sam smiled and started running around the park again, happy and proud of his success.
Once upon a time, there was an old man who wanted to win a crystal.
He was very serious about his goal.
One day, he went to a nearby mountain to look for it.
He searched for a long time but couldn't find it.
He was about to leave when he heard a voice from above.
"I know where you can find a crystal!" He looked up and saw a fairy hovering above him.
She looked serious.
"Follow me," she said, "and you will find the crystal you are looking for." The old man followed the fairy and soon they found the crystal.
The old man was so happy, he let out a cry of joy.
"Thank you so much!" he said to the fairy.
She smiled.
"You're welcome," she said.
"Now you have won your crystal." And with that, she flew away.
Jack looked from his window and noticed a gun.
It was lying in a mud puddle.
He was scared but he decided to take it to his mom.
His mom was dependable and he knew she would tell him what to do.

The little boy was so excited as he bounced into the room.
He had been asking for a drum for days and today his wish had come true!
His dad explained to him what it was and how powerful the sound can be.

His dad soon joined in, playing a beat to accompany the little boy's playing.

Once there was a boy named Tom.
Tom was 3 years old and very curious.
He'd spend long days playing and having fun with his friends and family.

He said, "The cat will find a way down - don't worry!" And eventually, he did.

One day Grandma and Grandpa went to work.
They worked in a plant.
They worked hard all day to make things.

Once upon a time, a 3 year old boy named John was playing in the garden.
He went to the pretty flower bed and rubbed the soft petals of the roses.

While he was rubbing the petals, he heard a loud noise.

Once upon a time, there was a small baby called Chris.
Chris was three years old and very tidy.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Anna.

Tom and Mia are friends.
They like to play in the park.

One bright morning, Daisy went out to the backyard with her mom.
Her mom pointed at the well and told her to look.
Daisy was mesmerized by the well.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily.
She loved to read books with her mommy and daddy.

Once upon a time, a little girl called Anna loved the beach.
She would dream of the amazing sand and the calming blue sea.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily.

She searched everywhere, but it was nowhere to be found.

Thank you so much for helping me find it."  Maria smiled.

Lily and Tom were playing with their toys in the living room.
They liked to share and have fun together.
But then Lily saw a shiny car that Tom had.

"No, it's mine.
You have your own toys," Tom said.
Lily felt angry and sad.
She tried to grab the car from Tom, but he held it tight.
They started to pull and push each other.
They both began to cry.
Mom heard the noise and came to see what was wrong.
She saw Lily and Tom fighting over the car.
She was not happy.
"Stop, stop!
What are you doing?" Mom said.
"Why are you crying?" "Lily wants my car, but it's mine!" Tom said.
"I want the car, but Tom won't let me!" Lily said.

She took the car from them and put it on the shelf.
She hugged Lily and Tom and said, "Listen, my loves.

They wiped their tears and said, "Sorry, Mom.

Sorry, Tom." Mom smiled and said, "That's OK.

Once upon a time there was a fancy key.

She was only three years old and was so excited by the fancy key.
She picked it up and started to look for the door that it opened.

Then the little girl had an idea and put the key in her pocket, so she could take it with her wherever she went.

Once upon a time there was a wild figure.
He lived in the forest and liked to explore.
One day he heard a strange noise.
He stopped and wondered, "What is that?" He followed the noise and found a little girl playing in the field.
She had bright eyes and a big smile.
The figure said hello and the girl looked up and smiled.
The girl pointed to the sky and asked "What is that?" The figure looked up and saw a bird flying above.
He told the girl it was a bird and watched as she twirled and laughed in delight.
The figure was curious and asked the girl lots of questions.
He wanted to know all about her.
The girl talked about her day and the wild animals she had seen.
They laughed together and became friends.
At the end of the day the girl waved goodbye to the figure with a happy smile.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Mia.

She put it on and said, "Thank you, Mommy!

Once upon a time, there was a jolly little girl who loved to go for adventures.
She had a red bicycle and she would ride it far and wide, exploring the world.
One day, the little girl hopped onto her red bicycle and started pedaling away.
She rode and rode until her tummy started to rumble.
She decided to stop and looked around for something to eat.
Suddenly, she spotted a small, round fruit sitting on a tree branch.
The girl stepped off her red bicycle and went over for a closer look.
The little girl plucked the fruit off the branch and took a bite.
It tasted sweet like candy!
She was so delighted, she quickly ate the rest of it.
Just then, a big, fat bee flew past her.
The bee was angry because the little girl had stolen its snack!
It started buzzing really loudly and shooting out angry puffs of beesmoke.
The girl was scared, so she jumped back on her red bicycle and started pedaling as fast as she could.

The little girl pedaled faster until the bee disappeared and she was safe again.

They decided to be good and share their toys from then on.
Once there was a cool little girl named Sarah.

Binny wanted to stay warm, so she put on her coat and hat.

Grinning, she started walking.

Suddenly, she slipped and nearly fell, but then she remembered her mom’s words.

After a few seconds, she opened her eyes and realized that she was still standing.
She had yielded to the cold ground and stayed safe.
With a satisfied nod, she continued her adventure.

She touched it and it sparkled.
