Lily felt sad because she didn't want to leave Sarah out, but she had promised Timmy they would go together.
They all talked and worked it out, and in the end, they all went to the planet together and had a great adventure.
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily.
Lily loved to eat dessert, especially ice cream.
One day, Lily's mom made her a big bowl of ice cream with lots of toppings.
Lily was so happy and ate it all up.
After eating her dessert, Lily felt very full and tired.
She decided to rest on the couch and watch her favorite TV show.
But then, she remembered that she didn't finish her homework yet.
Lily felt ashamed because she forgot to do it earlier.
So, Lily got up from the couch and went to her room to finish her homework.
After she finished, she felt proud of herself and went back to the couch to rest again.
This time, she fell asleep and had sweet dreams of more ice cream.
The end.
One day, a little girl named Sara went outside to play.
She was having a great time when she noticed a cute little bunny hopping around.
Sara smiled and decided to bring it some food.
She went to the kitchen and found some meat.
She carefully put the meat in her pocket and went back outside to give it to the bunny.
The little bunny happily munched away.
After it had finished, Sara smiled happily.
Suddenly, the bunny got scared and hopped away.
Sara had a moment of realization.
She understood that giving food to animals was nice, but if she wanted to keep them around, she needed to be gentle.
Sara learnt a great lesson that day.
Being kind and gentle can bring so much joy, not only to animals, but also to people!
Once upon a time, there was a tall musician.
He played music with his guitar and sang songs that made everyone happy.
One day, he went to the park to play his guitar.
Children gathered around him and listened to his music.
Suddenly, a gust of wind came and scatter his music sheets.
The musician quickly picked them up and continued playing.
The children clapped and danced to his music.
The end.
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily.
One Wednesday, she went to the park with her mom.
She was very happy and played on the swings and the slide.
But then, she saw a little boy who looked worried.
He had lost his toy car and couldn't find it anywhere.
Lily wanted to help the boy, so she pulled her mom's hand and took her to the boy.
Her mom asked the boy what his toy car looked like and they all started looking for it together.
After a while, they found the toy car under a bush.
The little boy was very happy and thanked Lily and her mom.
Lily felt proud that she could help someone who was worried.
She realized that it's important to be kind and helpful to others.
From that day on, Lily always looked out for others and helped them when they needed it.
Once upon a time there was a turkey who cared about his family.
He decided to take them on an adventure, so he led them to the mountain.
As they travelled, the turkey felt a bit scared.
But he kept going, for he cared for his family.
At the mountain, they found a beautiful meadow filled with flowers.
The turkey was so happy and he wanted to show his family the great view.
But suddenly they heard some noise, it sounded like thunder!
The turkey was scared and quickly gathered his family and started running away.
After they ran for a while, they suddenly stopped: they had reached a warm and cozy cave.
The turkey felt safe now, he had thought ahead and found shelter for his family.
The turkey was so proud of himself.
He had been scared, but he didn't give up and had taken care of his family.
They all stayed in the cave, warm and safe.
It was perfect!
Once there was a pretty girl named Jill.
One day she went out to play at night with her friends.
She was having a lot of fun.
Suddenly, there was a bright light from the sky.
It lit up the whole place.
Jill and her friends were so amazed and excited.
When they looked closer, they realized it was a switch.
It was shiny and fit perfectly into the ground.
Jill turned on the switch and out popped a rainbow of colors.
It was so beautiful!
Jill and her friends laughed and danced around in the bright light.
They even made up a new game to play.
They called it the "switch game".
The switch made everything oh so pretty.
Jill and her friends will remember that night forever.
Once upon a time, there was a little chicken named Chirpy.
Chirpy was very silly and loved to play.
One day, Chirpy found a big egg in the grass.
Chirpy didn't remember where it came from, but she wanted to play with it.
Chirpy rolled the egg around and around, but then she accidentally broke the egg!
Oh no!
Chirpy felt very sad and didn't know what to do.
But then, she remembered that her mommy had told her that sometimes eggs break and it's okay.
Chirpy felt better and went to find her mommy.
She told her mommy what happened and her mommy gave her a big hug.
Chirpy learned that it's okay to make mistakes and that even silly little chickens can be brave and tell the truth.
Once there was a young bird, who wanted to soar in the sky.
But no matter how hard she tried, she couldn't seem to fly.
One day, the bird heard about a magical chamber.
Inside the chamber was a secret that would help the bird soar.
The bird flew up to the chamber and knocked on the door.
"Who's there?" said a voice from inside.
The bird replied, "Its me, the young bird who wants to soar in the sky.
May I come in and learn the secret to flying?" "Yes, come on in," the voice said.
The bird entered the chamber, and was amazed by what she saw.
She saw a beautiful feather and a golden hourglass.
The voice said, "This feather is your ticket to flying.
Use the independent spirit within you to soar.
Put the feather in your hair, close your eyes and imagine yourself flying as high as you can." The bird followed the instructions and felt her heart soar.
Miraculously, she was able to fly!
From that day forward, the young bird became an independent flyer who was able to soar through the sky.
John was in the kitchen making dinner for his family.
He was making a spicy ranch dish.
He opened a bag of potatoes and started to fold them up into slices.
Suddenly, he heard a voice from behind him.
"Daddy, what are you doing?" asked John's 3 year old daughter, Emily.
John smiled and said, "I'm making spicy ranch potatoes.
It's going to be so tasty!" Emily's eyes lit up.
She couldn't wait to try them.
John finished folding the potatoes and put them in the honey pan.
He added some butter, spices and ranch seasoning.
Then he put it all in the oven.
While the potatoes were cooking, Emily and John went outside to play catch.
After a while, they came back in to the smell of a hot, delicious dish.
They were both excited to eat it.
After dinner, Emily said, "Daddy, these potatoes were so tasty and spicy!
Did you fold them up?" John laughed and said, "Yes, I did!
I folded them up special for you." Emily smiled and hugged her dad.
She was so happy and full after a delicious spicy ranch meal.
Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy.
Timmy loved to play by the ocean and watch the fish swim.
One day, he saw an octopus in the water.
The octopus was confused because he lost his way home.
The octopus was very happy and said, "Thank you for helping me.
You are a good friend." Timmy smiled and replied, "I am happy to help.
Friends help each other."
Once upon a time, there was a funny car.
It was blue and had big wheels.
The car liked to drive fast and make people laugh.
One day, the car was driving down the road when it hit a bump and got stuck.
The wheels wouldn't move anymore!
The car felt sad and didn't know what to do.
But then, a kind person came along and helped the car reverse out of the bump.
The car was so happy and grateful!
It drove away, feeling silly and funny once again.
The end.
Once there was a farmer who had a big flock of sheep.
Every day, the farmer would wake up early and go and check on his sheep.
One day when he went to check on his sheep, he was worried.
None of the sheep were there!
He looked around, but no sheep were in sight.
The farmer was very worried, so he called out for his sheep.
He shouted, "Sheep!
Where are my sheep?" He listened for a response, but all he heard was silence.
He searched everywhere, but still no sheep!
The farmer got very angry and started to demand that his sheep return.
"Sheep!
I demand that you come back to the farm this instant!" he shouted.
Suddenly, he heard some noises coming from the nearby woods.

He kicked the tree with all his might, but it wouldn't move.
So he pulled out his axe and started chopping away.

Finally, he chopped it down and it fell to the ground.
The woodcutter was proud of his work.

Once upon a time, there was a family with a little girl.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily.

Lily noticed that Emily was upset and realized that she should have shared her flute.

Once upon a time, there was a man with a big mustache.

Once upon a time there was a cool jeep.
It liked to splash in puddles.
Every day it would go out and find the biggest puddle it could find.
It would drive right in and splash its wheels.
The jeep was so happy splashing and spinning around.
The people in the nearby town could hear the jeep's happy revving whenever it found a puddle.

It revved its engine and drove right in.
The splash was really big and it made the jeep feel so cool.
People came out of the town to watch the jeep and its big splashes!
They watched the jeep for a long time and it never seemed to tire of playing in the puddles.
It stayed in the biggest puddle and kept splashing around!
That cool jeep kept splashing until it was time to go home.
Everyone laughed and clapped as it drove away.
Once upon a time, there was a family with a mom, a dad, a big sister, and a little brother.
They lived in a small house with a big tree in the yard.
The family was broken because they didn't talk to each other.
They were always sad and didn't play together.
One day, the big sister said, "I want to solve this problem.
Let's talk and play together." The little brother said, "Yes, I want to be happy." So, they went to their mom and dad and asked them to join them.
The family started to talk and play together.
They laughed and had fun.
The broken family became happy again.
They learned that talking and playing together can solve problems and make everyone happy.
And they lived happily ever after.
Once there was a generous princess who had a special gift.
She had a magic arrow that made things move when she shot it.
One day the princess went outside to use her magic arrow.
She looked around for something to shoot.
Suddenly, she noticed a little bird sitting on a tree.
The princess thought it would be fun to make the bird move with her arrow.
She took aim, held her breath and shot her arrow.
As soon as the arrow hit the tree, the bird flew away.
The princess was delighted.
She said to herself," That was so much fun!"  Then she saw a group of other birds sitting in the field.
She took aim and shot another arrow at the group of birds.
Suddenly, all the birds flew away, but one.
The bird refused to move.
The princess was surprised and asked," Why don't you fly away like the others?
Are you not scared?".
The bird replied,"No, I'm not scared.
You have been very generous to us today."  The princess was touched by the bird's kind words.
She smiled and said," You are very brave.
You can stay here as long as you want."  The bird thanked her and sat in the field with the other birds.
The princess smiled and returned home with her magic arrow.
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily.
One day, Lily's mommy asked her to help pick some berries in the garden.
Lily was happy to help because she loved berries.
As she was picking the berries, she saw a small teaspoon on the ground.
She picked it up and showed it to her mommy.
Her mommy was happy that Lily found it because she had been looking for it for a long time.
Lily felt proud of herself for finding the teaspoon.
She didn't know what the word "ignorant" meant, but she knew she wasn't that because she was able to help her mommy.
From that day on, Lily loved helping her mommy pick berries and finding lost things.
Tommy was excited.
He was going to play hockey for the first time.
Tommy grabbed his hockey stick and skated onto the rink.
He was impressed with how fast he could skate and how well he could handle his stick.
He saw some other kids already playing and he wanted to join them.
Tommy spotted the puck right away and he when he tried to get it he realized it was on the other side of the rink.
He couldn’t skate that fast yet so he had to think of another way.
He put his hockey stick down and used his hands to shoot the puck across the ice.
All of the kids turned to watch in amazement.
He had thrown the puck in one smooth shot and it zoomed across the ice.
For only playing hockey for the first time, it was pretty impressive.
Tommy loved playing hockey and smiled proudly.
He was happy that he had found his new favorite sport.
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lucy.
She loved to eat spaghetti.
One day, her mom made a big plate of spaghetti for dinner.
Lucy was so happy and excited to eat it.
But when Lucy sat down to eat, she saw something strange.
The spaghetti started to wiggle and move!
Lucy was very confused.
The spaghetti was trying to escape from the plate!

Lucy's mom saw what was happening and laughed.
"Don't worry, Lucy," she said.
"The spaghetti just got a little too hot.
It's not really trying to escape." Lucy felt better and enjoyed her spaghetti dinner.
And from that day on, Lucy always remembered to let her spaghetti cool down before eating it.
Jan and Jack were best friends.
One day they were playing outside and decided to go down the slide.
They giggled as they took turns slipping down.
"Faster, faster!" Jan shouted.
Jack then had an idea.
"Let's use some fuel to make the slide even faster!" Jack said.
Jan thought it was a great plan, so they grabbed a bucket of fuel.

The slide was becoming quite dirty.
But finally, they were ready to go.
"Let's slide!" Jan said.
So they took turns sliding down the faster, dirtier slide.
It was a lot of fun and they both shouted, "Yay!" at the end.
Once upon a time, there was a funny man who liked to joke around.
He wore a cozy bathrobe all day long because he thought it was very comfortable.
One day, he went to the store to buy a new bathrobe.
He saw many bathrobes, but only one was very attractive to him.
He tried it on and it felt very soft.
The man thought it was a joke that he found the perfect bathrobe so easily.
From that day on, he wore his new attractive bathrobe all the time and continued to make people laugh with his jokes.
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily.
She was an independent girl who liked to do things by herself.
Lily loved to play with her toys and wear her favorite top with a big, yellow sun on it.
One day, Lily wanted to reach a toy on a high shelf.
She tried to climb but it was too high for her.
She said, "Please, can someone help me?" Her mommy heard her and came to help.

Mommy got the toy for her and said, "Lily, you are a good girl for asking for help when you need it." From that day on, Lily knew that being independent was good, but asking for help when needed was important too.
She always remembered to say "please" when she needed help.
And she always wore her favorite top with the big, yellow sun, because it reminded her of the warm love her mommy gave her.
Once upon a time, there was a boy named Joe.
Joe was very curious.
He wanted to see what was beyond his little world.
So he pushed his way through the door.
When he stepped outside, he had a gentle view of the world.
He saw trees and a big pond.
He waited patiently and soon he saw a bird fly by.
Joe was so excited and started to run.
He was amazed with all the wonderful things he saw.
He went back home and told his mommy all the wonderful things he saw.
She was so happy that her boy was so curious.
She hugged Joe and said, “You have a gentle view of the world and I am so proud of you.”
Once upon a time, there was a little brown dog named Spot.
He loved to play with his ball in the park.
One sunny day, Spot saw a big goal on the other side of the park.
He wanted to get his ball into the goal.
Spot ran fast with the ball in his mouth.
He tried to kick the ball into the goal, but he was too small.
Spot started to struggle.
He tried again and again, but the ball would not go in.
Then, Spot had an idea.
He asked his friend, a big brown horse named Buddy, for help.
Buddy kicked the ball with his strong legs.
The ball flew into the goal!

He and Buddy played together all day long.
Peter was floating out in the ocean, further and further away from shore.
He couldn't see anybody, only the endless blue of the sea.
He was starting to feel scared.
Suddenly, he noticed a white anchor bobbing in the current.
He felt reassured that he was not alone as he held onto the anchor.
He felt the weight of the anchor and enjoyed the steady feeling it gave him.
Little by little, he was carried closer and closer to shore.
Soon enough, he could see the white sand of the beach.
With strength, the anchor pulled Peter to the beach and he was safe.
Feeling happy again, Peter waved goodbye to the white anchor and ran to the shore.
Once upon a time, there was a little monkey named Mimi.
Mimi loved to eat bananas.
One day, Mimi saw a big, yellow banana in the tree.
Mimi wanted to eat it, but it was too high.
Mimi said, "Banana, come down to me!" But the banana didn't move.
Mimi was frightened.
Mimi asked a friendly bird, "Can you help me get the banana?" The bird said, "Sure, I can fly up and get it for you."  The bird flew up and got the banana for Mimi.
Mimi was very happy and said, "Thank you, bird!
Now I can eat my banana." And they all lived happily ever after.
Jack and Mommy walked to the church.

Yay!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily.

Once there was a person who was very weak.
They were too weak to walk very far or play in the park.
So, the person decided to do something different.
The person started to balance different things on their head!

Sara has a comb.
She likes to comb her hair every day.
She makes her hair shiny and smooth.
She is happy with her comb.
Ben is Sara's brother.
He does not have a comb.
He has short hair that is curly and messy.
He does not like his hair.
He is jealous of Sara's comb.
One day, Sara leaves her comb on the table.
Ben sees it and takes it.
He tries to comb his hair, but it hurts.
The comb gets stuck in his hair.
He cries and pulls the comb.
He breaks the comb.
Sara hears Ben cry.
She runs to him and sees her broken comb.
She is angry and sad.
She yells at Ben and takes the comb.
She says it is her comb and he should not touch it.
Ben is sorry and scared.
He says he is sorry and he wanted to have nice hair like Sara.
He says he will not take her comb again.
Sara sees Ben's tears and feels bad.
She says she is sorry too and she will share her comb with him.

She hugs him and gives him a kiss.
They are happy and make up.
They play together and forget about the comb.
Once there was a bear.
He was very stubborn.
He liked to wander in the woods, and disturb all the other animals.
One day, the bear came upon a pond.
He wanted to drink, so he went in.
But he was so stubborn that he wouldn't stop swimming, even when the water was too deep.
But the bear did not realize that there was a big fish just beneath the surface.
The fish was bigger than the bear and much stronger.
The fish caught the bear in its jaws and dragged him underwater.
The bear kept struggling, but it was no use.
He could not free himself.
Eventually, the bear stopped moving.
The stubborn bear was never seen again.
Once upon a time there was a gifted boy, Jack.
He loved telling stories and playing games with his friends.
One day he noticed a pigeon in the sky.
He mentioned it to his friends and they were all amazed at how it flew so gracefully.
The friends decided to follow the pigeon and see where it flew.
They were sure the pigeon had a special and special place.
After some time they found the bird landed in a tall tree.
Unfortunately, the bird was stuck and could not get down.
Jack tried to rescue it but the bird was too scared and flew away.

He knew it was a sad ending but he also knew better than to try and find the bird again.
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily.
She loved Christmas time because she got to decorate the tree with pretty ornaments.
One day, she found a shiny red ornament that she really liked.
She asked her mom if she could put it on the tree, but her mom said she had to wait until they finished putting up all the other decorations.
Lily was patient and waited.
Later that day, Lily's friend came over to play.
They had lots of fun playing with toys and singing songs.
But then, Lily's friend asked her a question.
She asked, "Can we put the red ornament on the tree now?" Lily smiled and said, "Yes, let's do it!" They ran to the tree and carefully hung the red ornament on a branch.

Lily was very happy that she had waited patiently for the perfect time to put it on the tree.
Anna liked to help her mom bake cakes.
She liked to crack the eggs, pour the milk, and measure the flour.
But her favorite part was using the mixer.
The mixer was new and shiny and made a loud noise.
It mixed the batter very fast and made it smooth and fluffy.
One day, Anna and her mom were baking a cake for dad's birthday.
Anna was very excited.
She wanted to surprise dad with a yummy cake.
She helped mom with all the steps, and then it was time to use the mixer.
Anna reached for the mixer, but mom said, "Wait, Anna.
Remember, the mixer is very powerful.
You have to be careful and hold it with both hands.
And don't touch the blades, they are very sharp." Anna nodded and said, "OK, mom.
I remember." She took the mixer with both hands and turned it on.
It made a loud noise and started to mix the batter.
Anna smiled and watched the batter swirl and change color.
She felt proud and happy.
But then, something went wrong.
The mixer was too strong for Anna.
It pulled her hands and made her lose her balance.
She dropped the mixer and it fell on the floor.
The batter splashed everywhere.
It got on the table, on the chairs, on the walls, and on Anna and mom.
The mixer made a louder noise and then stopped.
Anna and mom looked at each other and at the mess.
They were covered in batter.
Anna felt scared and sad.
She thought mom would be angry and dad would be disappointed.
She started to cry and said, "I'm sorry, mom.
I'm sorry, dad.
I ruined the cake." Mom hugged Anna and said, "It's OK, Anna.
Don't cry.
It was an accident.
You didn't mean to do it.
I'm not angry and dad won't be disappointed.
He loves you no matter what.
And we can still make a cake.
We have more ingredients and we can clean up the mess.
Remember, the most important thing is that we are together and we have fun.
That's what makes a cake special." Anna smiled and said, "Thank you, mom.
I love you.
And I love dad.
And I love the mixer.
But maybe next time, you can hold it for me." Mom laughed and said, "Sure, Anna.
Next time, I'll hold it for you.
Now, let's get some towels and start over." They wiped the batter off their faces and clothes and started to bake a new cake.
They had fun and made a beautiful cake for dad.
Dad was very happy and gave them both a big hug and a kiss.
He said, "This is the best cake ever.
Thank you, Anna and mom.
You are the best." They all ate the cake and enjoyed it.
Anna felt proud and happy again.
She remembered this day and smiled.
Once upon a time, in a jolly forest, there lived many happy animals.
They all liked to play together.
One day, they wanted to have a big party.
They were all very excited.
There was a little mouse who lived in the forest too.
The other animals did not like to play with him.
They would ignore him when he tried to join them.

The day of the party came, and all the animals were having fun.
They were dancing and eating yummy food.
Then, it started to rain.

But the little mouse had a big umbrella.
He shared it with all the animals, and they all stayed dry.
The animals learned not to ignore the little mouse, and they all became friends.
The party was a big success, and they all lived happily ever after.
Once upon a time, there was a bunny named Bindu.
Bindu liked to speed around in circles.
He was fast like the wind!
He loved to zip around so much that he made a loop all around the garden.
One day, Bindu was confused.
His loop had gone too far and he was now in a strange place.
He stopped and looked around.
He was ashamed.
Suddenly, he heard a voice.
It was a friendly voice, it was a voice he recognized.
It was his friend, Bobo the bear.
Bobo had come to find him and bring him home.

Bindu said he was sorry for running so fast and making a loop.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily.
One day, Lily was eating a yummy cookie when she felt a strange pain in her tooth.
She screamed and her mommy came running to see what was wrong.
Lily's mommy looked at her tooth and saw that it was just a harmless little cavity.
She told Lily that she needed to brush her teeth every day to keep them healthy.
Lily learned her lesson and started brushing her teeth every day.
She never wanted to scream again because of a toothache!
The end.
Once upon a time, there was a deep forest.
In the deep forest there lived a deer.
The deer loved to explore the forest and play around the trees.
One day the deer was so tired it decided to quit running.
It went to the deepest part of the forest and lay down.
While it was lying there, the deer saw something.
It was a beautiful pond with many little fish swimming around in it.
The deer was so mesmerized that it forgot all about wanting to quit running.
The deer hopped and ran around the pond.
It jumped over the logs and played with all of the animals in the forest.
Soon, the deer wasn't so tired anymore.
It hadn't quit running - it had just taken a break!
The deer had lots of fun for the rest of the day, and when it was time to go home the deer was sad to leave the beautiful deep forest.
It was so excited to come back and explore another day.
Lily was a very independent girl.
She liked to do things by herself, without asking for help.
She had a big box of toys in her room, and she loved to play with them.
She had dolls, cars, blocks, and a shiny gold key.
One day, she decided to lock her door with the gold key.

She tried to open the door, but it was locked.

She heard a knock on the door.
It was her mom.

Once upon a time, there was a little bird named Tweety.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim.
Tim had a toy that could shoot.

Once upon a time there lived a small mouse.

Once upon a time, a nosy fireman lived in a big city.

So, he ran across the street to talk to her.

Once upon a time, there was a little fish named Fin.

Fin had an idea to add sand to the rough rock.
He thought that if he added sand, the rock would become smooth.
So, he swam around and gathered sand in his mouth.
He then swam back to the rock and blew the sand on it.
But the rock was still rough.
Fin tried again and again, but the rock would not become smooth.
He felt sad about the rock not being smooth.
Then, a big fish swam by and saw Fin.
The big fish told Fin that it was okay and that some rocks are meant to be rough.

It was a beautiful summer day, and Bob was out in his yard playing.
He loved playing in the grass and chasing around the garden gnomes.
Suddenly, Bob heard a strange sound coming from his neighbor's backyard.
He ran over to take a look and saw his neighbor Bill cooking on a huge grill.
The smell of the grilled food was mouthwatering, and Bob's mouth started to water.
He asked Bill, "What are you cooking?" but Bill didn't answer him.
He looked at Bob with a stern look and said, "Go away!" Bob felt so sad and he started to cry.
Then, Bill softened his face and said, "I'm sorry I was so rude.
I'm cooking some hot dogs and hamburgers for a party and I'm worried about spilling the secret ingredient.
Can you keep a secret?" Bob nodded and said, "I promise I won't tell anyone - I'll trust you." Bill thanked Bob and said, "The secret ingredient is a bit of bitter chili sauce.
Just a pinch of this sauce can turn burgers into something delicious!"  Bob grinned and said, "Thanks, Bill.
I'll never forget your secret ingredient!
I can trust you with this information".
Bill smiled, proud of having taught Bob a lesson in trust.
He handed Bob a hamburger and said, "Here, enjoy this!
Remember, friends can always trust each other."
Ben and his mom went to the store.
Ben was so excited!
When he saw the muffins, he smiled.
His mom told him he could pick one.
He looked around at all of the colors and shapes.
He liked the muffin that was gray the best.
He picked it up and said "Mommy, I want this one!" His mom said "OK, let's take it home." On the way back, Ben held the muffin very carefully in his hands.
When he got home he started to eat it.
It was so delicious!
He was so excited.
He kept on eating until it was gone.
He licked his fingers and smiled.
When his mom saw him she said "I'm so happy you enjoyed your muffin!" Ben smiled and said "It was so yummy!" His mom smiled right back at him.
Lily and Ben are friends.
They like to play with chalk on the sidewalk.
They draw flowers, stars, and animals.
Lily has many colors of chalk.
Ben only has white chalk.
One day, Lily draws a big rainbow with her chalk.
She uses red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and purple.
Ben looks at her rainbow.
He thinks it is very pretty.
He wants to draw a rainbow too.
But he only has white chalk.
He feels jealous of Lily.
He notices a pink chalk on the ground.
It is not Lily's chalk.
It is from another kid who left it there.
Ben picks up the pink chalk.
He thinks he can use it to draw a rainbow.
He starts to draw on the sidewalk next to Lily's rainbow.
Lily sees Ben drawing with the pink chalk.
She is angry.
She thinks Ben took her chalk.
She says, "Hey, that is my chalk!
Give it back!" Ben says, "No, it is not your chalk.
I found it.
It is mine!" They start to argue.
They are not friends anymore.
A lady walks by.
She sees Lily and Ben fighting over the chalk.
She says, "What is going on here?
Why are you not sharing?" Lily and Ben tell her their story.
The lady says, "That is not nice.
You should not be jealous or angry.
You should be kind and generous.
You can both use the chalk and draw together.
There is enough for everyone." She gives them a smile.
Lily and Ben feel sorry.
They say sorry to each other.
They decide to share the chalk and draw together.
They finish their rainbows.
They also draw hearts and smiles.
They are friends again.
They thank the lady for her help.
They are happy.
The sun was shining brightly and it made Tommy smile.
he wanted to go play outside, so he put on his running shoes and went out into the backyard.
He could feel the soft grass tickle his feet and he started to jog around the garden.
His dad saw him and smiled.
He said "Look at you little man, giving it your best!" and Tommy giggled.
Tommy loved going outside and he thought of new ways to play each time.
This time, he decided to make jam.
He picked some strawberries and put them in a bowl with a delicious spoonful of sugar.
His dad saw what he was doing and shouted "That looks delicious Tommy!" Tommy was delighted and he quickly mixed the mixture into a jam.
He took his jam to a delicious picnic outside.
As he was jogging home, he saw his friends making some clay animals.
Tommy gave them some of the jam and they all smiled.
"That's so delicious," one of them said.
Tommy smiled proudly.
He had made his own delicious jam and he was very proud.
Once upon a time, there was a clumsy mailman named Tim.
He wore a blue uniform and carried a big bag of letters.
One day, as he was walking down the street, he accidentally dropped a letter in a mailbox.
Tim felt very embarrassed because he knew he had made a mistake.
He tried to reach inside the mailbox to get the letter back, but he couldn't.
Then, a little girl who was passing by saw what happened and offered to help.
The little girl was very kind and managed to retrieve the letter from the mailbox.
Tim was so grateful that he gave her a big hug.
From that day on, Tim was more careful when delivering letters and never dropped any more in the mailbox again.
Tom and Mia liked to play in the pool.
They had a big ball and a small ring.
They threw the ball and dived to catch it.
They put the ring on their heads and pretended to be sharks.
They had a lot of fun.
But then, Sam came.
Sam was Mia's big brother.
He was spoiled and mean.
He wanted to play with the ball and the ring.
He did not ask.
He just took them from Tom and Mia.
He threw the ball far away and hid the ring under the water.
He laughed at Tom and Mia.
Tom and Mia were sad and angry.
They wanted their toys back.
They tried to get them, but Sam was bigger and faster.
He pushed them and splashed them.
He said they were babies and could not play in the pool.
Then, something bad happened.
Sam dived to get the ring, but he hit his head on the bottom of the pool.
He came out of the water and cried.
He had a big cut on his forehead.
He needed a stitch.
He ran to his mom and asked for help.
Tom and Mia felt sorry for Sam.
They got their ball and their ring.
They went to Sam and his mom.
They gave him their toys and said they were sorry.
They asked if he was okay.
Sam said he was sorry too.
He said he was mean and selfish.
He said he wanted to be their friend.
They hugged and said they were friends.
They played together in the pool.
They shared their toys and had fun.
Once upon a time, there lived a leopard in the jungle.
He saw a different animal, and he wanted to introduce himself.
So, he said,"Hi!
I'm the leopard!
What is your name?"  The other animal looked different and said,"Hi!
I'm a tiger!" The leopard was so excited to meet a new friend.
They began to play together in the jungle.
The leopard taught the tiger different skills and showed him around the jungle.
The tiger showed the leopard how to wrestle and play in the dirt.
They became best friends and would play in the jungle every day.
They were different, but that didn't stop them from being friends.
They had lots of fun and laughter.
The end.
Once upon a time, there was a little rabbit named Benny.
Benny loved to eat herbs that grew in the meadow.
One day, Benny noticed that his favorite herb was not growing anymore.
He asked his friend, a wise owl, why the herb was not growing.
The owl said, "Maybe the herb needs more water to grow." Benny decided to water the herb every day.
He was very alert and made sure the herb was getting enough water.
But one day, Benny saw a big deer eating the herb!
Benny was sad and angry.
He said to the deer, "Why did you eat my herb?
Now it cannot grow anymore!" The deer replied, "I am sorry, little rabbit.
I was hungry and did not know the herb was yours.
I will not eat it again." Benny forgave the deer and they became friends.
Benny continued to water the herb and it grew bigger and stronger than ever before.
Benny was happy and proud of his herb.
Tom and Lily were twins who liked to play with their toys.
One day, they found a big box of blocks in the basement.
They decided to build a castle with the blocks.
They worked hard and made a tall and strong castle.
"Look at our castle, Lily!
It is so big and nice!" Tom said.
"Yes, Tom, it is.
But we have to be careful.
Do not destroy it!" Lily said.
They played with their castle for a long time.
They pretended to be kings and queens and knights and dragons.
They had a lot of fun.
But then, their mom called them.
"Tom and Lily, it is time for your shower!
Come upstairs, please!" Tom and Lily did not want to stop playing.
They wanted to stay with their castle.
They ignored their mom.
"Tom and Lily, I am waiting for you!
Come on, get ready for your shower!" their mom said again.
Tom and Lily still did not listen.
They kept playing with their castle.
But then, they heard a loud noise.
They turned around and saw their dog, Rex, running towards them.
Rex was big and playful.
He saw the castle and thought it was a toy.
He jumped on the castle and destroyed it.
He knocked down all the blocks and made a big mess.
"Rex, no!" Tom and Lily shouted.
They ran to their castle and tried to save it.
But it was too late.
Their castle was gone.
They felt sad and angry.
"Look what you did, Rex!
You destroyed our castle!
Bad dog!" Tom said.
Lily started to cry.
"Our castle was so beautiful!
Why did you do that, Rex?" Rex did not understand.
He wagged his tail and licked their faces.
He thought they were playing with him.
Their mom came downstairs and saw what happened.
She was not happy.
"Tom and Lily, what is this?
Why did you not come for your shower?
And why did you make such a mess?" she asked.
Tom and Lily looked at their mom.
They felt sorry.
They knew they did something wrong.
"We are sorry, mom.
We did not listen to you.
We wanted to play with our castle.
But Rex destroyed it.
He did not know it was ours." Tom said.
"We are sorry, mom.
We should have come for our shower.
We should have put away our blocks.
But we were having fun.
We did not think about Rex." Lily said.
Their mom hugged them.
She was not angry anymore.
She was glad they were honest.
"I understand, Tom and Lily.
I know you love your castle.
But you have to listen to me when I call you.
And you have to be careful with your toys.
You have to share them with Rex.
He is part of our family.
He does not mean to destroy your things.
He just wants to play with you." she said.
Tom and Lily nodded.
They learned their lesson.
They said sorry to Rex.
They gave him a hug and a treat.
They helped their mom clean up the mess.
Then they went upstairs for their shower.
They were ready to be clean and cozy.
The end.
Moral value: The story teaches the children to listen to their parents, to be responsible for their toys, and to be kind to their pets.
Once upon a time there was a little girl.
Her name was Anna.
Anna was three years old.
She was playing outside when she noticed a twig.
She decided to pick it up.
She started to visit different places with the twig.
She went to her neighbour's garden, a park and even the beach.
Everywhere she went, she waved her twig and said hello to everyone.
At the park, Anna saw a spicy snack stand.
She went up to it and said to the vendor, "Hello, can I have a snack please?"  The vendor smiled and handed her a spicy snack.
Anna smiled, said thanks and ran off with her twig and her snack.
Anna had a lot of fun visiting new places with her twig.
From then on, she always kept her twig with her and used it to meet new people.
Tom and Lily were playing with their toy planes.
They liked to make them fly in the air and land on the port.
The port was a big box with some holes and stickers on it.
Tom had a red plane and Lily had a blue plane.
They were having fun.
But then, Ben came along.
Ben was a big boy who liked to take things from others.
He saw Tom and Lily's planes and wanted them.
He said, "Give me your planes, or I will break them.
They are ugly and small.
My plane is better." He showed them his plane.
It was a black plane with sharp wings and a loud noise.
Tom and Lily were scared of Ben.
They did not want to give him their planes, but they did not want him to break them either.
They tried to run away, but Ben was faster.
He grabbed Tom's plane and threw it on the ground.
It broke into pieces.
Tom cried.
Lily was angry.
She loved her plane and her brother.
She did not like Ben.
She had an idea.
She said, "OK, Ben, you can have my plane.
But first, let me show you how it flies.
It can fly very high and fast." She took her plane and threw it in the air.
But she did not throw it straight.
She threw it sideways, towards Ben's face.
The plane hit Ben's nose.
It hurt.
Ben screamed.
He dropped his plane and held his nose.
He ran away, crying.
Lily picked up his plane and gave it to Tom.
She said, "Here, Tom, you can have this plane.
It is not ugly and small.
It is big and strong.
And it can fly very well." She smiled.
Tom smiled too.
He hugged Lily and thanked her.
He said, "You are the best sister ever.
You are brave and smart.
And you can fly very well too." They took their planes and went back to the port.
They played happily.

Once upon a time, there was a nice little boy named Timmy.
He liked to play with his toys and run around outside.
One day, Timmy saw his mom washing the dishes in the kitchen.
She looked tired and Timmy wanted to help her.
Timmy asked his mom if he could wash the dishes for her.
She was surprised but happy that Timmy wanted to help.
Timmy washed the dishes very carefully and made sure they were all clean.
His mom was very proud of him and said he was a hero for helping her.
From that day on, Timmy always helped his mom with the dishes and other chores around the house.
He learned that being a hero doesn't always mean fighting bad guys, sometimes it just means helping others.
Tom and Lily were twins who liked to play outside.
One day, they saw a big truck on the street.
It was shiny and loud and had many colors.
Tom and Lily wanted to see it closer.
"Let's go to the truck!" Tom said.
He ran to the street without looking.
Lily followed him.
But a car was coming fast on the street.
It honked and braked.
Tom and Lily were scared.
They stopped in the middle of the street.
A man came out of the car.
He was angry.
He pointed at Tom and Lily and said, "You are selfish!
You could have been hurt!
You should not run to the street without looking!
Go back to the sidewalk now!" Tom and Lily felt bad.
They knew they did wrong.
They ran back to the sidewalk.
They said sorry to the man.
The man nodded and drove away.
The truck was gone too.
Tom and Lily missed it.
But they learned a lesson.
They decided to be more careful and not selfish.
They hugged each other and went home.
Once upon a time there was a little girl called Sophie.
She was three years old and loved to play.
Every day, Sophie would go outside and look for things to add to her collection of toys.
One day, she went outside and saw a big pile of leaves.
She was so excited!
She put her hands in the leaves and added some to her collection.
When Sophie was finished adding the leaves to her collection, she went to get a closer look.

The leaves were so colourful and felt so comfortable.
She just wanted to keep looking at them.
Then, Sophie went home with her collection of leaves.

Once upon a time, there was a big dog.
He loved to run and play all day long.

He tried to stand up, but he couldn't.
He was scared and alone.
His owner was distant, and he didn't know how to find him.
But then, a little girl saw him and came to help.
She petted him and gave him some water.
She even called his owner on her phone!

He realized that even when you slip and fall, there are always kind people who will help you.
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily.
She loved to play outside and chase butterflies.
One day, she saw a big dog with a mask on its face.
The mask looked funny, but Lily was scared of the dog.
Lily ran away, but the dog followed her.
She didn't know what to do, so she hid behind a tree.
Suddenly, she heard a loud noise.

She realized she was hungry and had forgotten to eat her lunch.
Lily remembered her mom's advice to always carry a tasty snack.
She searched her pockets and found a granola bar.
She opened it and took a bite.
The dog smelled the tasty snack and came closer.
Lily gained the courage to share her snack with the dog, and they became friends.
From that day on, Lily and the dog played together every day.
Once there was a wild squirrel.
He lived in a tree and liked to act silly.
He would run up the trunk and around the branches, then be daring and jump across the gap to another tree.
He would act very brave and shake his tail wildly.
Every day, he would act curious and search for tasty nuts to eat.
He looked up and down the tree, sniffing and tapping the bark.
He scampered down the trunk to see if there were any hidden nuts on the ground.
One day, the squirrel spotted a delicious looking nut on the ground - it was big and wild.
He quickly grabbed it with his little claws and ran back up the tree.
He was so happy with his prize that he acted very proudly.
He shook his tail in victory and settled down to enjoy his snack.
The squirrel was so pleased that he decided to act happy and climb another tree.
He was determined to find more wild nuts and have more tasty treats!
Ben and Lily were playing in the park with their ball.
They liked to kick the ball to each other and run after it.
But then the fog came.
The fog was thick and white and made it hard to see.
Ben and Lily could not find their ball or each other.
"Ben, where are you?" Lily called out.
"Lily, I'm here!" Ben answered.
He tried to follow her voice, but the fog was too strong.
They were scared and cold.
They wanted to go home, but they did not know which way to go.
They wished the fog would go away.
Then they heard a loud noise.
It was a big truck.
The truck had a big hose.
The hose sprayed water into the air.
The water made the fog go away.
The truck was a fire truck.
The fire truck was helping to release the fog.
Ben and Lily saw the fire truck and the firemen.
They also saw their ball and each other.
They ran to the fire truck and thanked the firemen.
"Thank you for releasing the fog!" Lily said.
"You're welcome, little girl.
We're glad you're safe," one fireman said.
"Can we see your hose?" Ben asked.
"Sure, little boy.
Do you want to try it?" another fireman said.
He gave Ben a helmet and a coat and let him hold the hose.
Ben felt very brave and happy.
He sprayed water into the air and made a rainbow.
Lily clapped and cheered.
She also got a helmet and a coat and took turns with Ben.
They had fun with the fire truck and the firemen.
The fog was gone and the sun was shining.
Ben and Lily were not scared and cold anymore.
They were warm and glad.
They hugged the firemen and said goodbye.
They took their ball and went home with their mom.
They told her about their adventure in the park.
They said the fire truck and the firemen were very nice.
They said they liked to release the fog.
Once there was a helpful girl named Lucy.

Tom was sad.
"Why are you sad?" Lucy asked.

Lucy and Tom looked all around the park.

Lucy said, "Let's play with bubbles!" They played with bubbles and had a fun day at the park.
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily.

Lily didn't want to, so she just shrugged her shoulders.

Once upon a time, there was a nice little girl named Emma.
Her family drove her to the beach to have some fun!
At the beach, Emma ran around, playing in the sand, picking up shells and splashing in the water.
But then it started to rain.
Emma’s mom called for her to come back to the car but Emma grabbed something from the sand - it was a shell shaped like an angel.
Her mom yelled, “Emma, come now, it’s wet outside!”  The entire drive home, Emma held the angel tight.
When they got home, the sky opened up with rain and Emma’s mom said, “Emma, did you know that angels are protectors?
I’m glad you found it.
It was a sign that your angel was watching over you and kept you safe at the beach.”  Emma smiled, feeling very lucky.
She knew she had found her very own angel.
Ben likes to play with his hat.
He has a red hat with a star on it.
He puts it on his head and runs around the yard.
He feels good and happy.
One day, he sees a big dog on the street.
The dog is brown and furry.
It has a collar with a bell.
Ben likes dogs.
He wants to pet the dog.
He urges his mom to let him go.
"Mom, mom, can I go to the dog?" he asks.

She does not know the dog.
She does not know if the dog is nice or mean.
She shakes her head.
"No, Ben, you can't go to the dog.
The dog is not ours.
The dog may bite you.
You have to stay here with me." Ben feels sad and mad.
He does not want to stay.
He wants to go to the dog.
He thinks the dog is good and friendly.
He takes off his hat and throws it on the ground.

"I want to go to the dog!
I want to go to the dog!" Mom picks up the hat and puts it back on Ben's head.
She hugs him and kisses him.
"Ben, I know you like dogs.
But you have to be careful.
Not all dogs are good.
Some dogs are bad.
They can hurt you.
You have to ask the owner first.
You have to be safe.
Do you understand?" Ben nods.
He understands.
He still likes dogs.
But he loves his mom more.
He says sorry to his mom.
He says sorry to his hat.
He smiles and hugs his mom back.
"OK, mom.
I'm sorry.
I love you.
I love my hat.
Can we go home and play with my hat?" Mom smiles and nods.
She loves Ben.
She loves his hat.
She says yes.
They go home and play with the hat.
They feel good and happy.
Once upon a time, there was a big bear named Benny.
Benny loved to eat honey from the beehive.
One day, Benny found out that he had a cavity in his tooth.
His friend, a wise owl named Ollie, told him that eating too much honey was not good for his teeth.
Ollie suggested that Benny should eat more minerals to prevent cavities.

Benny asked, "What are minerals?"  Ollie replied, "Minerals are things like rocks and stones that are good for your body." Benny listened to Ollie's advice and started eating more minerals like rocks and stones.
He also ate less honey and his cavity went away.
Benny was happy and thanked Ollie for his help.
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Abigail.
One day, she found a box in the garden.

It was a sparkly necklace.
Abigail was so excited!
She asked her mum if she could accept the treasure.
Her mum said yes!

Once upon a time, there was a little crab who lived by the sea.
He loved to play in the sand and watch the waves.
One day, he saw a big fish swimming in the distant sea.
The crab wanted to be friends with the fish, but he was too scared to swim out there.
The crab asked his seagull friend for help.
The seagull said he would help the crab, but only if the crab helped him first.
The seagull needed the crab to find a shiny shell for his collection.

They played together and had fun in the sea, and the crab was happy he overcame his fear.
Josh and his dad were walking in the park.
The sun was so warm and bright that Josh was feeling very happy.
Suddenly, his dad pointed to a rotten apple on the ground and said to him, "Josh, look at this apple.
You see how important it is to do your work?" Josh understood what his dad meant.
He looked at the apple and nodded, saying, "Yes Dad." His dad nodded too and they kept walking.
But Josh did not like his dad's lesson.
So the next day, when it was time to start his work, he decided to do something else.
He did not do his work and the day passed by in leisure.
Later that night, his dad came home from work.
He had a sad look on his face.
Josh wanted to know what had happened.
His dad told him, "The apple was rotten because you did not do your work.

Once upon a time, there was a big man named Jack.

Suddenly, he grew bigger and bigger until he was back to his normal size.
After that, Jack realized that he didn't need to be rich to be happy.
He was just happy to be back to his normal size and to have his big house and garden.

Lily and Ben were playing in the garden.

He wanted to reach the highest branches so he could find something yummy to eat.
"I'm so hungry!" Tommy said to himself as he kept climbing.
Just then, an eagle flying in the sky called out to Tommy, "Hey little panda, why don't you come and soar with me?" At first, Tommy was scared and he was hesitant to go.
He wasn't sure if he could trust the eagle.
"What if I get hurt?" he asked the eagle.
The eagle saw Tommy's hesitation and said, "Don't worry, I will hold you tight the entire time.
Come soar with me and you'll start feeling better." Finally, Tommy decided to trust the eagle and they soared through the sky together.
Tommy was filled with joy and he forgot he had ever been so hungry.
The eagle took Tommy all the way to a clearing in the forest.
There, Tommy saw a berry bush he had been wanting to eat from.
He thanked the eagle for taking him on the soaring journey, before running to the bush to eat his fill.
Tommy had found a delicious snack and his hunger was gone.
He felt brave and happy that he had trusted the eagle.
Once upon a time there was a man and a little girl.
The man wanted to support the girl and make her happy.
One day the man saw a apple tree.
He thought this might make the little girl smile.
He picked a apple for the girl and gave it to her.
The little girl was so excited to have the apple!
She took a bite, expecting it to be sweet, but quickly found out it was sour.
She made a yucky face and handed it back to the man.
The man laughed and said "Don't worry.
I'll support you no matter what." He threw the apple away and gave the little girl a big hug.
The little girl smiled and they went on their way.
She knew that the man would always be there to support her, even when things didn't go as planned.
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily.
She had a red cup she liked to drink from.
One day, she was playing in the park when she saw an interesting bug.
It was small and had shiny wings.
She wanted to touch it, but her mom said not to.
Suddenly, the bug flew towards her and bit her finger.
Lily cried and her mom hugged her.
They went to the doctor and he gave her some medicine.
From then on, Lily knew to be careful around bugs.
Tom and Sam are friends.
They like to play catch with a ball.
They also like to play with flags.
They have red flags and blue flags.
They make two teams.
Tom is on the red team.
Sam is on the blue team.
One day, they play catch and flag.
They have to catch the ball and run to the other team's flag.
If they touch the flag, they win.
If the other team catches them, they lose.
Tom and Sam run fast and throw the ball.
They have fun.
But then, Tom sees a big dog.
The dog is black and white.
It has a collar.
It looks friendly.
Tom likes dogs.
He wants to pet the dog.
He drops the ball and runs to the dog.
Sam sees Tom.
He is angry.
He shouts, "Tom, come back!
We have to play catch and flag!" But Tom does not hear Sam.
He reaches the dog.
He pets the dog.
The dog licks Tom.
Tom smiles.
He says, "Hello, dog.
You are nice.
What is your name?" The dog has a tag.
The tag says, "Spot".
Tom says, "Your name is Spot.
I like Spot." Sam runs to Tom.
He is still angry.
He says, "Tom, you are not loyal.
You left your team.
You made us lose.
You are a bad friend." Tom looks at Sam.
He is sad.
He says, "I'm sorry, Sam.
I like you.
You are my friend.
But I also like Spot.
He is a good dog.
Can we be friends with Spot?" Sam looks at Tom.
He looks at Spot.
He sees that Tom and Spot are happy.
He feels sorry.
He says, "I'm sorry, Tom.
I was mean.
You are not a bad friend.
You are a good friend.
And Spot is a good dog.
Can we play catch and flag with Spot?" Tom smiles.
He says, "Yes, Sam.
We can play with Spot.
He can be on our team.
He can catch the ball.
He can run fast.
He can be loyal.
He can be our friend." Sam smiles.
He says, "OK, Tom.
Let's play with Spot.
He can be our friend." They hug.
They pick up the ball.
They run to the flags.
They play catch and flag with Spot.
They have fun.
They are happy.
They are loyal.
They are friends.
Once upon a time, in a small village, there was a modest temple.
The temple was pretty, with a big tree outside.
People liked to visit the temple and say "hello" to the kind man who took care of it.
One day, a little girl named Lily went to the temple with her mom.
They saw the kind man and said, "Hello, can we mark the tree with our names?" The kind man smiled and said, "Yes, you can." Lily and her mom took a small rock and marked the tree with their names.
They were happy to see their names on the tree.
They said "thank you" to the kind man and went back to their home.
Now, every time they visited the temple, they would see their names on the tree and remember that special day.
Once upon a time, a little girl named Lily had a plate of warm cookies.
She was so happy and excited to eat them.
But then, a big, mean dog came and bit her hand.
Lily dropped her plate and cried.
The dog ran away with the plate in his mouth.
Lily's hand hurt so much, and she couldn't eat her cookies anymore.
She went home to her mommy, who took care of her hand and gave her a new plate of cookies.
But when Lily went back outside, she saw the dog had eaten all of her cookies on the warm plate.
Lily was sad and angry that the dog had taken her cookies.
She learned to be careful around dogs and to always hold on tight to her plate.
Once upon a time, there was an empty house.
Suddenly, an emergency happened.
This emergency was very scary.
The door to the empty house started to shake.
The emergency tried to enter, so it could help the people inside the house.
It pushed the door open and entered.
But the emergency found something strange.
The house was actually empty!
There was nothing inside.
The emergency left, but it learned something important.
We should be careful, even in an empty house.
Once there was a little girl named Bea who liked to go for walks in the woods.
On one of her walks she found something special, a stick.
She picked it up and held it tightly.
Suddenly the stick started to bite her!
Bea was surprised and scared.
"What's wrong stick?" said Bea.
"Why are you biting me?" The stick stayed silent.
So, Bea tried to put it down on the ground, but it wouldn't let go.
Finally, she put it in her pocket and continued on her walk.
Bea went further into the woods and soon came to an empty lake.
She could see the stick in her pocket, and it started to move around.
Bea opened up her pocket to see what was going on, and found the stick swimming around in the lake!
Bea was so happy to see her stick swimming around in the lake.
She got down on her knees and watched it move around, until the stick was empty again.
Bea took the stick out of the lake, waved goodbye and went back home.
She loved her stick, and never went for a walk without it from that day on.
Lilly was walking around the park, when she spotted her friend Jack playing in the sand with his bucket and spade.
She walked over to him and smiled.
"Hi Jack," said Lilly.
Jack looked up and grinned.
"Hello Lilly, I'm making a sandcastle." "It looks great!
What else have you been doing today?" "Oh I've been playing with my airplane and filling up my pail with water.
I also made a joke with my Mommy and Daddy, they laughed really loud." Lilly smiled.
"That must have been fun.
What was the joke?" Jack giggled.
"I asked them, why did the chicken cross the playground?
And then I said, to get to the other slide!" Lilly and Jack cracked up laughing.
Lily suddenly looked worried.
"What's the matter, Lilly?" asked Jack.
"I'm starting to get thirsty, Jack.
Let's find some water to drink." "Good idea!" said Jack.
"Let's look for some water." The two friends went looking for some water in the park.
In the end, they found a fountain and filled their water bottles up.
Lilly and Jack smiled, relieved to have found the water.
The two of them laughed and joked as they walked back home.
Once upon a time, there was a chubby bunny named Bun Bun.
Bun Bun loved to eat carrots and hop around in the grass.
One day, Bun Bun went to a picnic with all of his animal friends.
They had sandwiches and cookies on a big tray.
Bun Bun was very hungry and ate a lot of sandwiches.
His tummy was so full!
After they ate, their friend, a singing bird, sang a beautiful song.
All of the animals applauded and Bun Bun clapped his paws together too.
The picnic was so much fun!
Bun Bun was very happy and felt so full and content.
He couldn't wait for the next picnic with his friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily.
She loved to play outside with her friends.
One day, Lily and her friends were playing hide and seek when they saw a hot air balloon in the sky.
Lily was so excited, she ran to her mom and asked if they could go for a ride.
Her mom said yes, and they went to the park where the hot air balloon was landing.

Once there was a little girl.
She liked to play outside and one day she found a bucket.

Eventually, she got so dizzy she fell down onto the grass.

Jane had been feeling very sleepy all morning.
She was so sleepy that she couldn't help but yawn.
Finally, when her mom said it was time to go, Jane got into the car and closed her eyes.
When she woke up again, she was there already.
Jane looked around and saw a huge stable.
She had never seen one this big before!
She was so excited that she forgot about how sleepy she was.
She ran inside the stable and went up to every horse she saw.
She patted them, hugged them and even gave them a few treats.
The horses were so happy to see her.
Jane had a great time at the stable and soon it was time to go home.
She was sad to leave, but she was also very tired.
As they drove home, Jane yawned and fell asleep.
Once upon a time, there was a poor little mouse named Timmy.
Timmy lived in a small hole in the wall of a big house.
Every day, Timmy would go outside to find a snack to eat.
One day, while Timmy was looking for a snack, he saw a big piece of cheese on a table.
Timmy was so hungry that he couldn't resist the cheese.
He climbed up onto the table and started to eat the cheese.
Suddenly, the owner of the house came into the room and saw Timmy eating the cheese.
The owner picked up a broom and said, "You naughty mouse!
You shouldn't steal my snack!" Timmy was so scared that he bowed his head and ran back to his hole.
From that day on, Timmy was too scared to leave his hole and find food.
He became weaker and weaker until one day he passed away from hunger.
The end.
Once upon a time, there lived two friends called Lucy and Jack.
They both loved to play in an oak tree in Lucy's garden.
Every day, Lucy and Jack would climb the big oak tree, pass the leaves and giggle.

One day, when Lucy and Jack were playing, they saw a baby bird struggling to fly.
At first they felt sad, but then they decided to help teach the baby bird how to fly.
They patiently showed him how to flap his wings.
It couldn't fly right away, so they taught him again and again.

The baby bird flew away while Lucy and Jack waved goodbye.
From that day on, they were the best of friends!

That old makeup isn't for playing with." So, the little girl happily went outside.

Once upon a time, there was a cow named Betsy.
Betsy was very old, she was an ancient cow.
One day, Betsy was walking in a field when she met a little girl named Lily.
Lily loved cows and wanted to pet Betsy.
Lily said, "Hello Betsy, you are an ancient cow.
Can I pet you?"  Betsy replied, "Yes, you can pet me, but be careful.

Betsy started to melt!

What do we do?"  Betsy said, "Don't worry, just get me to some shade and I will cool down.
Thank you for being careful with me."  Lily helped Betsy to some shade and she eventually stopped melting.
They became good friends and would often visit each other in the field.
Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy.
Timmy had a favorite toy car that he loved to play with every day.

Timmy was in a rush to finish cleaning so he could play with his toy car again.

Timmy knew he was in trouble because he wasn't supposed to touch the ashtray.
Timmy's mom came into the room and saw the broken ashtray.
She asked Timmy what happened and Timmy told her the truth.

She helped Timmy clean up the mess and then they sat down to eat dinner together.
Timmy learned that it's important to be careful with things that are high up and to always tell the truth when something goes wrong.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy.
Timmy loved playing outside and making new friends.

As the sun started to set, Timmy realized he had to go home.
He said goodbye to Billy and started walking home.
But as he walked, he began to worry.
He couldn't remember where his house was!
He started to feel scared and sad.
Luckily, Timmy had a good memory and remembered that his house was near the big tree.
He found his way home and was so relieved.
From that day on, Timmy always paid attention to his surroundings and never got lost again.
The moral of the story is that it's important to pay attention and be aware of your surroundings so you don't get lost and feel tired from worry.
Once upon a time, there was a little boy called Tim.
He was only three years old.
One day, Tim and his mom had an adventure.
They entered a mine.
Tim felt uncomfortable.
"Mom, I'm scared," he said.
"It's alright, Tim, I'm here with you," she replied.
"Let's keep going."  They walked deeper and deeper into the mine.
Suddenly, Tim saw lots of twinkling lights in the dark!
He smiled and asked, "Mom, what is this?"  "It's the treasure in the mine," said Mom.
Tim and his Mom found lots of treasures and spent some time exploring the mine.

Once there was a large sailor who went to sea in his boat.
He had all the supplies he needed and he was ready to set sail.
He opened the sail and it began to move with the wind.
The sailor smiled as he felt the wind on his face.
The sailor sailed past tall mountains, small islands, and sparkling oceans.
He saw all sorts of creatures in the water.
He watched as dolphins and sharks swam around his boat.
The sailor smiled as he realized how small he was in comparison to the grand ocean.
Suddenly, the sailor spotted a large island.

When he reached the island, he opened the sail and jumped onto the shore.

He also found lots of fruit and colourful seashells.
The sailor was so happy to have gone on his voyage and explore the large island.

Once upon a time, there was a young girl named Penelope.
One day, Penelope wanted to paint something special.
She had lots of paint, but she only had an old brush.
Penelope's mom saw her and said, "Don't worry, I have something that can help." Penelope's mom took her to her ears.
Penelope happily said, "What did you bring me?" Her mom replied, "I brought you my reliable paintbrush." Penelope said, "It looks perfect!
Now I can start painting!" Penelope began to paint.

She created a beautiful painting.
When she finished, Penelope said, "Mom, I made something special with your reliable paintbrush." Penelope's mom smiled and hugged her.
